text.english: Almost all of them. This kind of event has a great impact on business. As long as you organize a "Collect the Stickers, Receive the Gifts" type of event, the number of customers will increase a lot.

text.traditional: 聽起來真有趣！以後我也要注意可以換什麼小禮物，這會是我在台灣生活的紀念。
text.simplified: 听起来真有趣！以后我也要注意可以换什么小礼物，这会是我在台湾生活的纪念。
text.pinyin: Tīngqǐlái zhēn yǒuqù! Yǐhòu wǒ yě yào zhùyì kěyǐ huàn shénme xiǎo lǐwù, zhè huì shì wǒ zài Táiwān shēnghuó de jìniàn.
text.english: Sounds really interesting! Later I'll also pay attention to what little gifts I can get. It can be a souvenir of my life in Taiwan.

text.traditional: 沒錯。不過，現在請你把貼紙給我，讓我去換史努比吧！
text.simplified: 没错。不过，现在请你把贴纸给我，让我去换史努比吧！
text.pinyin: Méicuò. Búguò, xiànzài qǐng nǐ bǎ tiēzhǐ gěi wǒ, ràng wǒ qù huàn Shǐnǔbǐ ba!
text.english: Right. But now please give me the sticker and let me exchange them for Snoopy!

items.title: Grammar 6–7 · Give Me the Stickers, please. I Want to Exchange Them for Snoopy!

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Give Me the Stickers, please. I Want to Exchange Them for Snoopy!
grammarPages.titleTraditional: V 上：V 上了 / 沒 V 上 / V 得上 / V 不上
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 上 after a verb to show successful contact or reaching a target.
grammarPages.explanation: The verb complement “上” has three meanings: (A) add something to another thing, e.g., “穿上” and “加上”. (B) to reach, e.g., “趕上” and “追上” (zhuīshàng, to catch up). (C) a certain status occurs, e.g., “愛上” and “看上”.
grammarPages.pattern: Verb + 上（了） / 沒 + Verb + 上 / Verb + 得上 / Verb + 不上

text.traditional: 天氣冷了，快把外套穿上吧！
text.english: It is cold; quickly put on your coat!
text.pinyin: Tiānqì lěng le, kuài bǎ wàitào chuān shàng ba!
text.simplified: 天气冷了，快把外套穿上吧！

text.traditional: 便利商店的門貼上了「買咖啡送貼紙」的海報。
text.english: The convenience store put a “Buy coffee, get a sticker” poster on its door.
text.pinyin: Biànlì shāngdiàn de mén tiē shàng le “mǎi kāfēi sòng tiēzhǐ” de hǎibào.
text.simplified: 便利商店的门贴上了「买咖啡送贴纸」的海报。

text.traditional: 我要早點兒出門，才趕得上公車。
text.english: I need to leave early so I can catch the bus.
text.pinyin: Wǒ yào zǎodiǎnr chūmén, cái gǎn de shàng gōngchē.
text.simplified: 我要早点儿出门，才赶得上公车。

text.traditional: 爸爸走得太快，我跟不上。
text.english: Dad walks too fast; I cannot keep up with him.
text.pinyin: Bàba zǒu de tài kuài, wǒ gēn bú shàng.
text.simplified: 爸爸走得太快，我跟不上。

text.traditional: 莫以凡一到台灣就喜歡上了台灣文化。
text.english: As soon as Mo Yifan arrived in Taiwan, he fell in love with Taiwanese culture.
text.pinyin: Mò Yǐfán yí dào Táiwān jiù xǐhuān shàng le Táiwān wénhuà.
text.simplified: 莫以凡一到台湾就喜欢上了台湾文化。

text.traditional: 那瓶香水很便宜，味道也不好，李小姐一定看不上。
text.english: That bottle of perfume is cheap and smells bad, so Ms. Li definitely will not want it.
text.pinyin: Nà píng xiāngshuǐ hěn piányí, wèidào yě bùhǎo, Lǐ xiǎojiě yídìng kàn bú shàng.
text.simplified: 那瓶香水很便宜，味道也不好，李小姐一定看不上。

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The verb complement “上” has three meanings: (A) add something to another thing, e.g., “穿上” and “加上”. (B) to reach, e.g., “趕上” and “追上” (zhuīshàng, to catch up). (C) a certain status occurs, e.g., “愛上” and “看上”.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The verb complement “上” has three meanings: (A) add something to another thing, e.g., “穿上” and “加上”. (B) to reach, e.g., “趕上” and “追上” (zhuīshàng, to catch up). (C) a certain status occurs, e.g., “愛上” and “看上”.

practice.title: Complete the sentences with the words in the box.

segments.traditional: 眼鏡才看得清楚是什麼字。
segments.simplified: 眼镜才看得清楚是什么字。

repairs.note: 穿上 is for clothes and shoes. Glasses, hats and watches take 戴上.
加上 adds one amount or thing to another. Putting glasses on is 戴上.
看上 means taking a liking to something. Putting glasses on is 戴上.

items.fallbackRepair: Glasses are put on with 戴上.

result.traditional: 報紙上的字太小，我要戴上眼鏡才看得清楚是什麼字。
result.simplified: 报纸上的字太小，我要戴上眼镜才看得清楚是什么字。
result.pinyin: Bàozhǐ shàng de zì tài xiǎo, wǒ yào dàishàng yǎnjìng cái kàn de qīngchǔ shì shénme zì.
result.english: The print in the newspaper is too small; I have to put on my glasses to see clearly what the characters are.

segments.traditional: 合歡山真美，山本良介一去就
segments.simplified: 合欢山真美，山本良介一去就

repairs.note: 趕上 is being in time for something (趕上公車). Starting to love a place is 愛上.
跟上 is keeping up with someone who is ahead. Starting to love a place is 愛上.
追上 is catching up with someone who is ahead. Starting to love a place is 愛上.

items.fallbackRepair: The mountain is beautiful, so he came to love it: 愛上.

result.traditional: 合歡山真美，山本良介一去就愛上了那個地方。
result.simplified: 合欢山真美，山本良介一去就爱上了那个地方。
result.pinyin: Héhuān Shān zhēn měi, Shānběn Liángjiè yí qù jiù àishàng le nàge dìfāng.
result.english: Mount Hehuan is really beautiful; Yamamoto Ryosuke fell in love with the place the first time he went.

segments.traditional: 第一班到花蓮的太魯閣號。
segments.simplified: 第一班到花莲的太鲁阁号。

repairs.note: 跟上 is keeping up with a person who walks ahead. Being in time for a train is 趕上.
穿上 is putting on clothes. Being in time for a train is 趕上.
愛上 is starting to love someone or something. Being in time for a train is 趕上.

items.fallbackRepair: The speaker was late and missed the train: 沒趕上.

result.traditional: 我遲到了，沒趕上第一班到花蓮的太魯閣號。
result.simplified: 我迟到了，没赶上第一班到花莲的太鲁阁号。
result.pinyin: Wǒ chídào le, méi gǎnshàng dì yī bān dào Huālián de Tàilǔgé Hào.
result.english: I was late and didn't make the first Taroko Express to Hualien.

segments.traditional: 你一個月的房租要多少錢？
segments.simplified: 你一个月的房租要多少钱？

segments.traditional: 電費和網路費，差不多要一萬塊錢。
segments.simplified: 电费和网路费，差不多要一万块钱。

repairs.note: 寫上 is writing something onto a page. Adding more costs to the rent is 加上.
戴上 is putting on glasses or a hat. Adding more costs to the rent is 加上.
坐上 is getting onto a bus or train. Adding more costs to the rent is 加上.

items.fallbackRepair: The rent plus the other bills: 加上.

result.traditional: 房租七千塊，加上電費和網路費，差不多要一萬塊錢。
result.simplified: 房租七千块，加上电费和网路费，差不多要一万块钱。
result.pinyin: Fángzū qīqiān kuài, jiāshàng diànfèi hé wǎnglùfèi, chàbùduō yào yíwàn kuài qián.
result.english: The rent is seven thousand; adding electricity and internet, it comes to about ten thousand dollars.

segments.traditional: 為什麼最近李先生常常約張小姐一起吃飯？
segments.simplified: 为什么最近李先生常常约张小姐一起吃饭？

repairs.note: 他 is Mr. Li. The one he has come to like is the woman he keeps inviting: 張小姐.
跟上 is keeping up with someone who is ahead. Starting to like someone is 喜歡上.
寫上 is writing something onto a page. Starting to like someone is 喜歡上.

items.fallbackRepair: 喜歡上, then the person: 喜歡上張小姐.

result.traditional: 因為他喜歡上張小姐了。
result.simplified: 因为他喜欢上张小姐了。
result.pinyin: Yīnwèi tā xǐhuānshàng Zhāng xiǎojiě le.
result.english: Because he has taken a liking to Miss Zhang.

segments.traditional: 請問，這份資料我要寫些什麼？
segments.simplified: 请问，这份资料我要写些什么？

repairs.note: 看上 means taking a liking to something. Putting your name on a form is 寫上.
坐上 is getting onto a bus or train. Putting your name on a form is 寫上.
B is telling A what to fill in, so it is A's own name: 你的名字.

items.fallbackRepair: 寫上, then what to write: 寫上你的名字.

result.traditional: 請在這裡寫上你的名字。
result.simplified: 请在这里写上你的名字。
result.pinyin: Qǐng zài zhèlǐ xiěshàng nǐ de míngzi.
result.english: Please write your name here.

summary: 上 after a verb can mean putting something on, reaching a goal, or entering a new state.
The verb and the sentence show which meaning it is, as with 穿上 for putting on.
Forms: V上了 means done, 沒V上 not done, V得上 can, and V不上 can't.

grammarPages.lessonTitle: 請給我貼紙，我要換史努比！
grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Give Me the Stickers, please. I Want to Exchange Them for Snoopy!
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Give a cause using 因為……的關係.
grammarPages.explanation: The pattern “因為……的關係” is used when the speaker would like to state a brief cause rather than going into details. Thus, in this pattern, “因為” is followed only by nouns or phrases.
grammarPages.pattern: (Subject) + 因為 + Cause + 的關係，+ Result

text.traditional: 因為工作的關係，他決定搬到公司附近去住。
text.english: Because of work, he decided to move closer to his company.
text.pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò de guānxì, tā juédìng bān dào gōngsī fùjìn qù zhù.
text.simplified: 因为工作的关系，他决定搬到公司附近去住。

text.traditional: 因為放春假的關係，去高雄的高鐵票都賣光了。
text.english: Because of spring break, all the high-speed rail tickets to Kaohsiung sold out.
text.pinyin: Yīnwèi fàng chūnjià de guānxì, qù Gāoxióng de gāotiě piào dōu mài guāng le.
text.simplified: 因为放春假的关系，去高雄的高铁票都卖光了。

text.traditional: 因為沒時間化妝的關係，金小姐不想去參加舞會。
text.english: Because she has no time to put on makeup, Ms. Jin does not want to go to the dance.
text.pinyin: Yīnwèi méi shíjiān huàzhuāng de guānxì, Jīn xiǎojiě bù xiǎng qù cānjiā wǔhuì.
text.simplified: 因为没时间化妆的关系，金小姐不想去参加舞会。

text.traditional: 她到韓國留學是因為男朋友的關係。
text.english: She went to study in Korea because of her boyfriend.
text.pinyin: Tā dào Hánguó liúxué shì yīnwèi nánpéngyǒu de guānxì.
text.simplified: 她到韩国留学是因为男朋友的关系。

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The pattern “因為……的關係” is used when the speaker would like to state a brief cause rather than going into details. Thus, in this pattern, “因為” is followed only by nouns or phrases.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The pattern “因為……的關係” is used when the speaker would like to state a brief cause rather than going into details. Thus, in this pattern, “因為” is followed only by nouns or phrases.

segments.traditional: 你為什麼來台灣學中文？
segments.simplified: 你为什么来台湾学中文？

repairs.note: 的時候 says when something happens. A short reason is 因為 + noun + 的關係.
所以 starts the result, in the second half. The short reason starts with 因為.
雖然 needs a turn with 可是 after it. A short reason is 因為…的關係.

items.fallbackRepair: 因為 first, then the reason in a word, then 的關係: 因為工作的關係.

result.traditional: 因為工作的關係，我得學中文。
result.simplified: 因为工作的关系，我得学中文。
result.pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò de guānxì, wǒ děi xué Zhōngwén.
result.english: Because of work, I have to learn Chinese.

segments.traditional: 你們為什麼常常去那家餐廳吃飯？
segments.simplified: 你们为什么常常去那家餐厅吃饭？

repairs.note: 所以 starts a result. Here the reason comes last, after 是因為.
的時候 says when something happens. A short reason is 因為 + noun + 的關係.

items.fallbackRepair: After 是 comes 因為, then the reason in a word, then 的關係: 是因為朋友的關係.

result.traditional: 我們常去那家餐廳是因為朋友的關係，老闆是我朋友。
result.simplified: 我们常去那家餐厅是因为朋友的关系，老板是我朋友。
result.pinyin: Wǒmen cháng qù nà jiā cāntīng shì yīnwèi péngyǒu de guānxì, lǎobǎn shì wǒ péngyǒu.
result.english: We often go to that restaurant because of a friend; the owner is my friend.

segments.traditional: 這個社區環境很好，你趕快跟房東簽約吧！
segments.simplified: 这个社区环境很好，你赶快跟房东签约吧！

repairs.note: B has just said the surroundings are fine. After 可是 comes the thing that holds B back: 房租.
所以 starts the result. The short reason starts with 因為.
的時候 says when something happens. A short reason is 因為 + noun + 的關係.

items.fallbackRepair: 因為 first, then the reason in a word, then 的關係: 因為房租的關係.

result.traditional: 環境是不錯，可是因為房租的關係，我還要再想一想。
result.simplified: 环境是不错，可是因为房租的关系，我还要再想一想。
result.pinyin: Huánjìng shì búcuò, kěshì yīnwèi fángzū de guānxì, wǒ hái yào zài xiǎng yì xiǎng.
result.english: The surroundings are nice, true, but because of the rent, I still need to think it over.

summary: 因為……的關係 gives a short reason. Use a noun or short phrase, not a full sentence, in the middle.
The reason can come before or after the result.
Don't swap in 為了. 因為 gives the cause, and 為了 gives the purpose.

text.traditional: 陳可欣發現她的同學方靜文最近變了，不但上課的時候打瞌睡，連作業也不寫。可欣以為靜文發生了什麼事，下課以後就找她聊聊。原來她最近愛上了韓國連續劇，每天都花很多時間看，有時候還為了看韓劇不睡覺，當然就沒時間寫作業了。
text.simplified: 陈可欣发现她的同学方静文最近变了，不但上课的时候打瞌睡，连作业也不写。可欣以为静文发生了什么事，下课以后就找她聊聊。原来她最近爱上了韩国连续剧，每天都花很多时间看，有时候还为了看韩剧不睡觉，当然就没时间写作业了。
text.pinyin: Chén Kěxīn fāxiàn tā de tóngxué Fāng Jìngwén zuìjìn biàn le, búdàn shàngkè de shíhòu dǎ kēshuì, lián zuòyè yě bù xiě. Kěxīn yǐwéi Jìngwén fāshēng le shénme shì, xiàkè yǐhòu jiù zhǎo tā liáo liáo. Yuánlái tā zuìjìn àishàng le Hánguó liánxùjù, měitiān dōu huā hěn duō shíjiān kàn, yǒushíhòu hái wèile kàn Hánjù bú shuìjiào, dāngrán jiù méi shíjiān xiě zuòyè le.
text.english: Chen Kexin found out that her classmate, Fang Jingwen, has recently changed. Not only does she doze off during classes, but she doesn't even do her homework. Kexin thought something had happened to Jingwen, so she went to her after classes to chat. It turned out that she has recently been in love with Korean drama series. She spends a lot of time watching them every day, and sometimes she doesn't even sleep watching Korean dramas. Of course she had no time to do her homework.

text.traditional: 因為韓劇的關係，靜文常去韓式餐廳吃飯，也常上網看韓國最流行的服裝，還買了很多像帽子、毛衣、裙子、化妝品這樣的商品。連韓國小姐化妝的樣子跟保養的方法，她都學會了。她還計畫後年到韓國去遊學，因為這樣不但可以學韓國話，也可以去連續劇裡的那些地方看看。
text.simplified: 因为韩剧的关系，静文常去韩式餐厅吃饭，也常上网看韩国最流行的服装，还买了很多像帽子、毛衣、裙子、化妆品这样的商品。连韩国小姐化妆的样子跟保养的方法，她都学会了。她还计划后年到韩国去游学，因为这样不但可以学韩国话，也可以去连续剧里的那些地方看看。
text.pinyin: Yīnwèi Hánjù de guānxì, Jìngwén cháng qù Hánshì cāntīng chīfàn, yě cháng shàngwǎng kàn Hánguó zuì liúxíng de fúzhuāng, hái mǎi le hěn duō xiàng màozi, máoyī, qúnzi, huàzhuāngpǐn zhèyàng de shāngpǐn. Lián Hánguó xiǎojiě huàzhuāng de yàngzi gēn bǎoyǎng de fāngfǎ, tā dōu xuéhuì le. Tā hái jìhuà hòunián dào Hánguó qù yóuxué, yīnwèi zhèyàng búdàn kěyǐ xué Hánguó huà, yě kěyǐ qù liánxùjù lǐ de nàxiē dìfāng kànkan.
text.english: Because of the Korean drama series, Jingwen often dines out in Korean restaurants. She also often looks at the most popular Korean clothing on the Internet. Besides, she bought many commodities such as hats, sweaters, skirts and cosmetics. She has even learned the make-up style and skincare routine of Korean women. She also plans to go to Korea for a study tour the year after next year. This way she can not only learn Korean, but also go take a look at the places shown in the drama series.

text.traditional: 其實，很多台灣人為了跟上流行，除了看韓劇，還會看日劇或是美國影集。去 KTV 唱日文歌、去美國餐廳吃飯，也都是很平常的活動。可欣想，原來流行會讓人的生活方式有這麼大的改變！現在有「韓流」，以後會有什麼呢？
text.simplified: 其实，很多台湾人为了跟上流行，除了看韩剧，还会看日剧或是美国影集。去 KTV 唱日文歌、去美国餐厅吃饭，也都是很平常的活动。可欣想，原来流行会让人的生活方式有这么大的改变！现在有「韩流」，以后会有什么呢？
text.pinyin: Qíshí, hěn duō Táiwān rén wèile gēnshàng liúxíng, chúle kàn Hánjù, hái huì kàn Rìjù huòshì Měiguó yǐngjí. Qù KTV chàng Rìwén gē, qù Měiguó cāntīng chīfàn, yě dōu shì hěn píngcháng de huódòng. Kěxīn xiǎng, yuánlái liúxíng huì ràng rén de shēnghuó fāngshì yǒu zhème dà de gǎibiàn! Xiànzài yǒu “Hánliú”, yǐhòu huì yǒu shénme ne?
text.english: In fact, many people also watch Japanese dramas or American TV series in order to keep up with the trends. Going to karaoke bars to sing Japanese songs or eating at American restaurants are both very common activities. Kexin thought: “So fashion really can change people's lives that much! Now we have the Korean wave, and then what will come next?”

items.title: Grammar 1–6 · Are You Afraid of Taking Exams?

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Are You Afraid of Taking Exams?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use a negative statement plus 嗎 to point out an assumed fact, often with a confrontational tone.
grammarPages.explanation: A sentence using this pattern is not a real interrogative sentence. Instead, this pattern, which indicates what the speaker says is a known fact, forms a rhetorical question with a more impolite tone. The structure is “S+不/沒+V（+O）+嗎？”.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: A sentence using this pattern is not a real interrogative sentence. Instead, this pattern, which indicates what the speaker says is a known fact, forms a rhetorical question with a more impolite tone. The structure is “S+不/沒+V（+O）+嗎？”.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: A sentence using this pattern is not a real interrogative sentence. Instead, this pattern, which indicates what the speaker says is a known fact, forms a rhetorical question with a more impolite tone. The structure is “S+不/沒+V（+O）+嗎？”.
grammarPages.pattern: S + 不／沒 + V（+ O）+ 嗎？

text.traditional: A：這個週末我不知道要做什麼。B：你下個禮拜就要出國留學了，不用準備行李嗎？
text.english: A: I don’t know what to do this weekend. B: You’re going abroad to study next week; don’t you need to prepare your luggage?
text.simplified: A：这个周末我不知道要做什么。B：你下个礼拜就要出国留学了，不用准备行李吗？
text.pinyin: A: Zhège zhōumò wǒ bù zhīdào yào zuò shénme. B: Nǐ xià ge lǐbài jiùyào chūguó liúxué le, búyòng zhǔnbèi xínglǐ ma?

text.traditional: A：明天的中文課要考第幾課？B：老師剛剛上課的時候說了好幾次，你沒聽到嗎？
text.english: A: Which lesson will tomorrow’s Chinese test cover? B: The teacher said it several times in class. Didn’t you hear?
text.simplified: A：明天的中文课要考第几课？B：老师刚刚上课的时候说了好几次，你没听到吗？
text.pinyin: A: Míngtiān de Zhōngwén kè yào kǎo dì jǐ kè? B: Lǎoshī gānggāng shàngkè de shíhòu shuō le hǎojǐ cì, nǐ méi tīngdào ma?

text.traditional: A：我晚上要看那部很有名的韓國連續劇。B：你不是以前看過了嗎？值得再看一次嗎？
text.english: A: I’m going to watch that famous Korean drama tonight. B: Haven’t you seen it before? Is it worth watching again?
text.simplified: A：我晚上要看那部很有名的韩国连续剧。B：你不是以前看过了吗？值得再看一次吗？
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ wǎnshàng yào kàn nà bù hěn yǒumíng de Hánguó liánxùjù. B: Nǐ búshì yǐqián kàn guo le ma? Zhídé zài kàn yí cì ma?

segments.traditional: 姐姐，我想吃的冰淇淋蛋糕，你

repairs.note: The older sister says 又忘了買: it is about something that did not happen, so it takes 沒: 你沒買嗎？
This pattern challenges with a yes/no question, so it ends in 嗎, not 呢.
The older sister answers 忘了買, so the question is about buying, not eating.

items.fallbackRepair: 沒 before the verb, and 嗎 at the very end: 你沒買嗎？

result.traditional: 姐姐，我想吃的冰淇淋蛋糕，你沒買嗎？
result.simplified: 姐姐，我想吃的冰淇淋蛋糕，你没买吗？
result.pinyin: Jiějie, wǒ xiǎng chī de bīngqílín dàngāo, nǐ méi mǎi ma?
result.english: Sis, the ice cream cake I wanted, didn't you buy it?

segments.traditional: 我不會上網訂票，怎麼辦？
segments.simplified: 我不会上网订票，怎么办？

segments.traditional: 我教過你好幾次了，你還
segments.simplified: 我教过你好几次了，你还

repairs.note: Something that has not happened yet takes 沒: 還沒學會.
This pattern challenges with a yes/no question, so it ends in 嗎, not 呢.
B is the one who taught. What A has or has not done is learn it: 學會.

items.fallbackRepair: 沒 before the verb, and 嗎 at the very end: 你還沒學會嗎？

result.traditional: 我教過你好幾次了，你還沒學會嗎？
result.simplified: 我教过你好几次了，你还没学会吗？
result.pinyin: Wǒ jiāo guò nǐ hǎo jǐ cì le, nǐ háiméi xuéhuì ma?
result.english: I've taught you several times. Haven't you learned it yet?

segments.traditional: 便利商店「拿貼紙換禮物」的活動結束了，真的嗎？
segments.simplified: 便利商店「拿贴纸换礼物」的活动结束了，真的吗？

repairs.note: Telling A is something that already happened or did not, so it takes 沒: 我沒告訴你嗎？
This pattern challenges with a yes/no question, so it ends in 嗎, not 呢.

items.fallbackRepair: 沒, then the verb, then the person, and 嗎 at the very end: 我沒告訴你嗎？

result.traditional: 你不知道？我沒告訴你嗎？
result.simplified: 你不知道？我没告诉你吗？
result.pinyin: Nǐ bù zhīdào? Wǒ méi gàosu nǐ ma?
result.english: You don't know? Didn't I tell you?

summary: A sentence ending in 嗎 with 不 or 沒 before the verb can be a challenge, not a real question.
The speaker is not asking for information. They treat the fact as already known, so it can sound impolite.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Are You Afraid of Taking Exams?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Tell someone to do an action faster or more slowly.
grammarPages.explanation: The pattern “快/慢（+一）點兒+V” is an imperative sentence. It is used when the speaker asks others to put aside what they are doing because there is not enough time or an emergency takes place. The pattern aims to hurry someone up. In addition, “慢（+一）點兒+V” indicates that the speakers consider the time is sufficient, and no need to hurry to do something. Wait for a moment and do it later and the result may be better.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The pattern “快/慢（+一）點兒+V” is an imperative sentence. It is used when the speaker asks others to put aside what they are doing because there is not enough time or an emergency takes place. The pattern aims to hurry someone up. In addition, “慢（+一）點兒+V” indicates that the speakers consider the time is sufficient, and no need to hurry to do something. Wait for a moment and do it later and the result may be better.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The pattern “快/慢（+一）點兒+V” is an imperative sentence. It is used when the speaker asks others to put aside what they are doing because there is not enough time or an emergency takes place. The pattern aims to hurry someone up. In addition, “慢（+一）點兒+V” indicates that the speakers consider the time is sufficient, and no need to hurry to do something. Wait for a moment and do it later and the result may be better.
grammarPages.pattern: 快／慢（+ 一）點兒 + V

text.traditional: 下雨了，你別在外面玩，快（一）點兒進來！
text.english: It’s raining. Don’t play outside; come in quickly!
text.simplified: 下雨了，你别在外面玩，快（一）点儿进来！
text.pinyin: Xiàyǔ le, nǐ bié zài wàimiàn wán, kuài (yì) diǎnr jìnlái!

text.traditional: 已經八點了，你快（一）點兒起床，要不然上班會遲到！
text.english: It’s already eight. Get up quickly, or you’ll be late for work!
text.simplified: 已经八点了，你快（一）点儿起床，要不然上班会迟到！
text.pinyin: Yǐjīng bā diǎn le, nǐ kuài (yì) diǎnr qǐchuáng, yàobùrán shàngbān huì chídào!

text.traditional: 茶還很熱，你慢（一）點兒喝吧！
text.english: The tea is still hot. Drink it slowly.
text.simplified: 茶还很热，你慢（一）点儿喝吧！
text.pinyin: Chá hái hěn rè, nǐ màn (yì) diǎnr hē ba!

practice.title: Read each situation and complete what is said.

segments.traditional: 時間不早了，可是孩子還在玩，不寫作業。你會跟他說什麼？
segments.simplified: 时间不早了，可是孩子还在玩，不写作业。你会跟他说什么？

repairs.note: It is getting late and the child is still playing, so the child must hurry: 快一點兒.
有一點兒 goes before a feeling or quality (有一點兒累). Hurrying someone is 快一點兒 + the action.
一下 goes after an action (等一下). Hurrying someone is 快一點兒 + the action.

items.fallbackRepair: 快 first, then 一點兒, then the action: 快一點兒去寫作業.

result.traditional: 快一點兒去寫作業。
result.simplified: 快一点儿去写作业。
result.pinyin: Kuài yìdiǎnr qù xiě zuòyè.
result.english: Hurry up and go do your homework.

segments.traditional: 明天要考試，弟弟還在看電視。媽媽會對他說什麼？
segments.simplified: 明天要考试，弟弟还在看电视。妈妈会对他说什么？

repairs.note: The exam is tomorrow, so he must hurry: 快點兒.
Mom has just said 別看了. With an exam tomorrow, what he should hurry to do is study.
一下 goes after an action (等一下). Hurrying someone is 快點兒 + the action.

items.fallbackRepair: 快 first, then 點兒, then the action: 快點兒去念書.

result.traditional: 別看了，快點兒去念書。
result.simplified: 别看了，快点儿去念书。
result.pinyin: Bié kàn le, kuài diǎnr qù niànshū.
result.english: Stop watching. Hurry up and go study.

segments.traditional: 下課了，大家準備要回家時，老師要請山本良介寫一下資料，她會怎麼跟良介說？
segments.simplified: 下课了，大家准备要回家时，老师要请山本良介写一下资料，她会怎么跟良介说？

repairs.note: The teacher wants him to stay a little longer, not to leave sooner: 慢一點兒走.
有一點兒 goes before a feeling or quality (有一點兒累). Asking someone to wait is 慢一點兒 + the action.
The teacher wants him to wait before leaving: 慢一點兒走. The writing comes after 先.

items.fallbackRepair: 慢 first, then 一點兒, then the action: 慢一點兒走.

result.traditional: 良介，你慢一點兒走，先寫一下資料。
result.simplified: 良介，你慢一点儿走，先写一下资料。
result.pinyin: Liángjiè, nǐ màn yìdiǎnr zǒu, xiān xiě yíxià zīliào.
result.english: Ryosuke, don't leave just yet. Fill in this form first.

summary: Put 快 before a verb to tell someone to hurry up.
Put 慢 before a verb to ask someone to slow down.
You can add 一 before 點兒 or leave it out.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Are You Afraid of Taking Exams?
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Marking a Destination or Endpoint with 到
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say where an action ends, when it lasts until, or how far a range or quantity reaches.
grammarPages.explanation: The pattern “V 到” is followed by a destination to which the subject does an action. The destination can be a place, a point of time, a range or a number.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The pattern “V 到” is followed by a destination to which the subject does an action. The destination can be a place, a point of time, a range or a number.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The pattern “V 到” is followed by a destination to which the subject does an action. The destination can be a place, a point of time, a range or a number.
grammarPages.pattern: V + 到 + Place／Time／Range or quantity

text.traditional: 這張書桌，我想搬到房間去。
text.english: I want to move this desk into the room.
text.simplified: 这张书桌，我想搬到房间去。
text.pinyin: Zhè zhāng shūzhuō, wǒ xiǎng bān dào fángjiān qù.

text.traditional: A：我的中文書，你拿到哪裡去了？B：我拿到客廳去了。
text.english: A: Where did you take my Chinese book? B: I took it to the living room.
text.simplified: A：我的中文书，你拿到哪里去了？B：我拿到客厅去了。
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ de Zhōngwén shū, nǐ ná dào nǎlǐ qù le? B: Wǒ ná dào kètīng qù le.

text.traditional: A：請問從這裡走到台北101去要多久？B：不太遠，大概十分鐘就走到了。
text.english: A: How long does it take to walk from here to Taipei 101? B: Not far; about ten minutes.
text.simplified: A：请问从这里走到台北101去要多久？B：不太远，大概十分钟就走到了。
text.pinyin: A: Qǐngwèn cóng zhèlǐ zǒu dào Táiběi 101 qù yào duōjiǔ? B: Bú tài yuǎn, dàgài shífēn zhōng jiù zǒu dào le.

text.traditional: 爸爸昨天工作到晚上九點才回家。
text.english: Dad worked until nine last night before coming home.
text.simplified: 爸爸昨天工作到晚上九点才回家。
text.pinyin: Bàba zuótiān gōngzuò dào wǎnshàng jiǔ diǎn cái huíjiā.

text.traditional: 我們今天要去逛街，打算逛到晚上十點。
text.english: We are going shopping today and plan to shop until ten tonight.
text.simplified: 我们今天要去逛街，打算逛到晚上十点。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen jīntiān yào qù guàngjiē, dǎsuàn guàng dào wǎnshàng shí diǎn.

text.traditional: A：你昨天寫作業寫到幾點？B：寫到半夜兩點才寫完。
text.english: A: Until what time did you do your homework yesterday? B: I did my homework until two a.m. and only then finished.
text.simplified: A：你昨天写作业写到几点？B：写到半夜两点才写完。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ zuótiān xiě zuòyè xiě dào jǐdiǎn? B: Xiě dào bànyè liǎng diǎn cái xiě wán.

text.traditional: 昨天歷史課，教授教到第一百六十頁了。
text.english: In history class yesterday, the professor taught up to page 160.
text.simplified: 昨天历史课，教授教到第一百六十页了。
text.pinyin: Zuótiān lìshǐ kè, jiàoshòu jiāo dào dì yìbǎiliùshí yè le.

text.traditional: 到那個博物館參觀的遊客，今年增加到三百多萬人了。
text.english: The number of visitors to that museum increased to over three million this year.
text.simplified: 到那个博物馆参观的游客，今年增加到三百多万人了。
text.pinyin: Dào nà ge bówùguǎn cānguān de yóukè, jīnnián zēngjiā dào sānbǎi duō wàn rén le.

text.traditional: A：下星期一要考試，你念到第幾課了？B：我念到第三課了，還有兩課沒念。
text.english: A: Which lesson have you studied up to for Monday’s exam? B: I’ve reached lesson three; I still have two lessons to go.
text.simplified: A：下星期一要考试，你念到第几课了？B：我念到第三课了，还有两课没念。
text.pinyin: A: Xià xīngqíyī yào kǎoshì, nǐ niàn dào dì jǐ kè le? B: Wǒ niàn dào dì sān kè le, háiyǒu liǎng kè méi niàn.

subsections.title: Place destination
subsections.explanation: 到 marks the place reached by the action.
subsections.pattern: V 到 + 地方 + 來／去

subsections.title: Time endpoint
subsections.explanation: 到 marks the endpoint in time.

subsections.title: Range or quantity
subsections.explanation: 到 marks the endpoint of a range or a reached quantity.

segments.traditional: 我要去那家百貨公司，請問搭捷運要搭到哪裡？
segments.simplified: 我要去那家百货公司，请问搭捷运要搭到哪里？

repairs.note: 在 says where something is. Where a ride ends takes 到: 搭到台北車站.
A asks 搭到哪裡, so the answer is a place, not a time.

items.fallbackRepair: The verb, then 到, then where the ride ends: 搭到台北車站.

result.traditional: 你可以搭藍線，搭到台北車站。
result.simplified: 你可以搭蓝线，搭到台北车站。
result.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ dā lán xiàn, dā dào Táiběi chēzhàn.
result.english: You can take the Blue Line and ride to Taipei Main Station.

segments.traditional: 這些家具，你打算搬到哪裡去？
segments.simplified: 这些家具，你打算搬到哪里去？

repairs.note: 在 says where something is. Where things end up after moving takes 到: 搬到新家去.
從 marks where things start. A asks where they go, which takes 到: 搬到新家去.

items.fallbackRepair: The verb, then 到, then the place, and 去 at the end: 搬到新家去.

result.traditional: 我打算搬到新家去。
result.pinyin: Wǒ dǎsuàn bān dào xīn jiā qù.
result.english: I plan to move them to my new home.

segments.traditional: 這間公寓，你打算租到什麼時候？
segments.simplified: 这间公寓，你打算租到什么时候？

repairs.note: A asks 租到什麼時候, so the answer is a time, not a place.
在 says where or when something is. The time a rental ends takes 到: 租到明年六月.
從 marks the start. A asks when it ends, which takes 到.

items.fallbackRepair: The verb, then 到, then the time it ends: 租到明年六月.

result.traditional: 我打算租到明年六月。
result.pinyin: Wǒ dǎsuàn zū dào míngnián liù yuè.
result.english: I plan to rent it until June next year.

summary: 到 after a verb marks where the action ends: a place, a time, or the end of a range or amount.
For a place, you can add 來 or 去 after it.
For a time, the action goes on until that time.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Are You Afraid of Taking Exams?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Soften or avoid a direct response by pairing a negative with a question word.
grammarPages.explanation: This pattern is used when the subject is unwilling to show his/her attitude and avoids giving an explicit response. This pattern is always a negative sentence collocating with question words, such as “什麼”, “多少”, “幾”, “誰”, “怎麼”, “哪裡” and “什麼地方”. The structure is “S+不/沒+V+多少/幾 M/什麼/哪裡/什麼地方（+O）” or “S+不/沒+跟+誰+V（+O）”, “S+不+怎麼+Vs” or “S+不+怎麼+Vaux+V（+O）”.

grammarPages.pattern: Negative statement + question word

text.traditional: 那部卡通不怎麼有名，很多人都沒看過。
text.english: That cartoon is not very famous; many people have never seen it.
text.simplified: 那部卡通不怎么有名，很多人都没看过。
text.pinyin: Nà bù kǎtōng bù zěnme yǒumíng, hěn duō rén dōu méi kàn guo.

text.traditional: 王先生不怎麼願意做家事，讓太太不怎麼高興。
text.english: Mr. Wang is not very willing to do housework, which leaves his wife not very happy.
text.simplified: 王先生不怎么愿意做家事，让太太不怎么高兴。
text.pinyin: Wáng xiānshēng bù zěnme yuànyì zuò jiāshì, ràng tàitai bù zěnme gāoxìng.

text.traditional: 我昨天下午沒去哪裡／什麼地方，都在家休息。
text.english: I didn’t go anywhere yesterday afternoon; I stayed home and rested.
text.simplified: 我昨天下午没去哪里／什么地方，都在家休息。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān xiàwǔ méi qù nǎlǐ／ shénme dìfāng, dōu zài jiā xiūxí.

text.traditional: A：你昨天吃了那麼多小吃，花了多少錢？B：沒花多少錢，因為價錢都不貴。
text.english: A: You ate so many snacks yesterday. How much did you spend? B: I didn’t spend much because they were all inexpensive.
text.simplified: A：你昨天吃了那么多小吃，花了多少钱？B：没花多少钱，因为价钱都不贵。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ zuótiān chī le nàme duō xiǎochī, huā le duōshǎo qián? B: Méi huā duōshǎo qián, yīnwèi jiàqián dōu bú guì.

text.traditional: A：你想去便利商店買什麼？B：我不想買什麼，只想看看新活動海報。
text.english: A: What do you want to buy at the convenience store? B: I don’t want to buy anything; I just want to look at the new event poster.
text.simplified: A：你想去便利商店买什么？B：我不想买什么，只想看看新活动海报。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiǎng qù biànlì shāngdiàn mǎi shénme? B: Wǒ bù xiǎng mǎi shénme, zhǐ xiǎng kànkan xīn huódòng hǎibào.

text.traditional: 女朋友：你昨天跟誰去 KTV 唱歌了？快點兒說！男朋友：你放心！我沒跟誰去，我是一個人去的！
text.english: Girlfriend: Who did you go sing karaoke with yesterday? Tell me! Boyfriend: Don’t worry! I didn’t go with anyone; I went alone!
text.simplified: 女朋友：你昨天跟谁去 KTV 唱歌了？快点儿说！男朋友：你放心！我没跟谁去，我是一个人去的！
text.pinyin: Nǚ péngyǒu: Nǐ zuótiān gēn shéi qù KTV chànggē le? Kuài diǎnr shuō! Nán péngyǒu: Nǐ fàngxīn! Wǒ méi gēn shéi qù, wǒ shì yígerén qù de!

segments.traditional: 那塊雞排看起來很辣，你怎麼敢吃？
segments.simplified: 那块鸡排看起来很辣，你怎么敢吃？

repairs.note: 沒怎麼 goes before an action that did not happen much (沒怎麼吃). Before a quality like 辣 it is 不怎麼.
哪裡 stands for a place. "Not particularly" before a quality is 不怎麼.
多少 stands for an amount (沒多少錢). "Not particularly" before a quality is 不怎麼.

items.fallbackRepair: 不 first, then 怎麼, then the quality: 不怎麼辣.

result.traditional: 看起來好像很辣，其實不怎麼辣。
result.simplified: 看起来好像很辣，其实不怎么辣。
result.pinyin: Kànqǐlái hǎoxiàng hěn là, qíshí bù zěnme là.
result.english: It looks very spicy, but actually it isn't particularly spicy.

segments.traditional: 這個週末你打算去哪裡？
segments.simplified: 这个周末你打算去哪里？

repairs.note: After 去 comes a place, so the question word is 哪裡.
After 去 comes a place, so the question word is 哪裡. 誰 stands for a person.

items.fallbackRepair: 不 before 打算, then 去 and the question word: 不打算去哪裡.

result.traditional: 快要期末考了，我不打算去哪裡，要在家用功讀書。
result.simplified: 快要期末考了，我不打算去哪里，要在家用功读书。
result.pinyin: Kuàiyào qímòkǎo le, wǒ bù dǎsuàn qù nǎlǐ, yào zài jiā yònggōng dúshū.
result.english: Finals are coming up. I'm not planning to go anywhere in particular; I have to study hard at home.

segments.traditional: 你剛買的這個皮包多少錢？
segments.simplified: 你刚买的这个皮包多少钱？

repairs.note: The bag is already bought, and something that did not happen takes 沒: 沒花多少錢.
幾 needs a measure word after it (幾塊錢). Straight before 錢, "not much" is 沒…多少.

items.fallbackRepair: 沒 first, then the verb, then 多少, then 錢: 沒花多少錢.

result.traditional: 沒花多少錢，才一百塊。
result.simplified: 没花多少钱，才一百块。
result.pinyin: Méi huā duōshǎo qián, cái yìbǎi kuài.
result.english: I didn't spend much, only a hundred dollars.

repairs.note: 有 is negated with 沒, never 不: 沒幾個.
A asks how many (幾個), so the answer keeps 幾: 沒幾個.
A asks how many (幾個), so the answer keeps 幾: 沒幾個.

items.fallbackRepair: 沒 first, then 幾, then the measure word: 沒幾個.

result.traditional: 沒幾個，只有兩個。
result.simplified: 没几个，只有两个。
result.pinyin: Méi jǐ ge, zhǐyǒu liǎng ge.
result.english: Not many, only two.

segments.traditional: 春假的時候，你是跟誰一起去花蓮的？
segments.simplified: 春假的时候，你是跟谁一起去花莲的？

segments.traditional: 一起去，我是一個人去的。
segments.simplified: 一起去，我是一个人去的。

repairs.note: The trip is over, and something that did not happen takes 沒: 沒跟誰一起去.
After 跟 comes a person, so the question word is 誰.
After 跟 comes a person, so the question word is 誰.

items.fallbackRepair: 沒 first, then 跟, then the question word: 沒跟誰一起去.

result.traditional: 我沒跟誰一起去，我是一個人去的。
result.simplified: 我没跟谁一起去，我是一个人去的。
result.pinyin: Wǒ méi gēn shéi yìqǐ qù, wǒ shì yígerén qù de.
result.english: I didn't go with anyone; I went by myself.

summary: A question word in a negative sentence gives a soft answer that doesn't say much.
It can mean not very, not much, didn't go anywhere, or didn't go with anyone.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Are You Afraid of Taking Exams?
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Expressing Surprise with 怎麼這麼
grammarPages.learnerPromise: React with surprise or disbelief about a quality or situation.
grammarPages.explanation: The pattern shows a feeling of surprise or disbelief about a certain situation. When using this pattern, the speaker does not always ask for a reply.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The pattern shows a feeling of surprise or disbelief about a certain situation. When using this pattern, the speaker does not always ask for a reply.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The pattern shows a feeling of surprise or disbelief about a certain situation. When using this pattern, the speaker does not always ask for a reply.
grammarPages.pattern: 怎麼這麼 + Vs（+ ...）

text.traditional: A：這個卡通人物怎麼這麼可愛！B：真的嗎？我覺得史努比比較可愛。
text.english: A: How can this cartoon character be so cute! B: Really? I think Snoopy is cuter.
text.simplified: A：这个卡通人物怎么这么可爱！B：真的吗？我觉得史努比比较可爱。
text.pinyin: A: Zhège kǎtōng rénwù zěnme zhème kě'ài! B: Zhēnde ma? Wǒ juéde Shǐnǔbǐ bǐjiào kě'ài.

text.traditional: 你怎麼這麼累？昨天晚上沒睡覺嗎？
text.english: How can you be so tired? Didn’t you sleep last night?
text.simplified: 你怎么这么累？昨天晚上没睡觉吗？
text.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme zhème lèi? Zuótiān wǎnshàng méi shuìjiào ma?

text.traditional: 明天有期末考，你怎麼這麼輕鬆？都準備好了嗎？
text.english: You have a final exam tomorrow. How can you be so relaxed? Are you all prepared?
text.simplified: 明天有期末考，你怎么这么轻松？都准备好了吗？
text.pinyin: Míngtiān yǒu qímòkǎo, nǐ zěnme zhème qīngsōng? Dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma?

repairs.note: Surprise at how much is 怎麼這麼 + the quality. 很 cannot follow 怎麼 here.
什麼 asks "what". Surprise at a quality starts with 怎麼.
B's reason is that he exercises often, and exercise makes a person healthy, not fat.

items.fallbackRepair: 怎麼 first, then 這麼, then the quality: 怎麼這麼健康.

result.traditional: 你哥哥怎麼這麼健康？
result.simplified: 你哥哥怎么这么健康？
result.pinyin: Nǐ gēge zěnme zhème jiànkāng?
result.english: How come your older brother is so healthy?

segments.traditional: 對啊，我也覺得這篇很難翻。
segments.simplified: 对啊，我也觉得这篇很难翻。

repairs.note: B agrees (對啊) and says it is hard to translate, so A said the same: 難翻.
Surprise at how much is 怎麼這麼 + the quality. 很 cannot follow 怎麼 here.
什麼 asks "what". Surprise at a quality starts with 怎麼.

items.fallbackRepair: 怎麼 first, then 這麼, then the quality: 怎麼這麼難翻.

result.traditional: 這篇怎麼這麼難翻！
result.simplified: 这篇怎么这么难翻！
result.pinyin: Zhè piān zěnme zhème nán fān!
result.english: How can this piece be so hard to translate!

segments.traditional: 如果你覺得太甜，下次可以選無糖或是半糖的。
segments.simplified: 如果你觉得太甜，下次可以选无糖或是半糖的。

repairs.note: B answers about it being too sweet, so A was surprised at how sweet it is: 甜.
Surprise at how much is 怎麼這麼 + the quality. 很 cannot follow 怎麼 here.
B answers about it being too sweet, so A was surprised at how sweet it is: 甜.

items.fallbackRepair: 怎麼 first, then 這麼, then the quality: 怎麼這麼甜.

result.traditional: 珍珠奶茶怎麼這麼甜？
result.simplified: 珍珠奶茶怎么这么甜？
result.pinyin: Zhēnzhū nǎichá zěnme zhème tián?
result.english: How come the bubble tea is so sweet?

summary: 怎麼這麼 plus a state word shows surprise or disbelief about a situation.
The speaker is not always waiting for an answer.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Are You Afraid of Taking Exams?
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Enough Room or Capacity with 得下／不下
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say whether a place or person has enough capacity to hold, contain, or eat something.
grammarPages.explanation: In this pattern, “下” is a resultative complement indicating whether or not the subject has enough space to accommodate the object. Sometimes, the situation results from the subject's mental or physical factors. This resultative complement only has potential structure.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: In this pattern, “下” is a resultative complement indicating whether or not the subject has enough space to accommodate the object. Sometimes, the situation results from the subject's mental or physical factors. This resultative complement only has potential structure.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: In this pattern, “下” is a resultative complement indicating whether or not the subject has enough space to accommodate the object. Sometimes, the situation results from the subject's mental or physical factors. This resultative complement only has potential structure.
grammarPages.pattern: V 得下／V 不下 + Object

text.traditional: 這個盒子裝得下幾塊蛋糕？
text.english: How many pieces of cake can fit in this box?
text.simplified: 这个盒子装得下几块蛋糕？
text.pinyin: Zhège hézi zhuāng de xià jǐ kuài dàngāo?

text.traditional: 這間公寓很大，住得下六個人。
text.english: This apartment is large enough for six people to live in.
text.simplified: 这间公寓很大，住得下六个人。
text.pinyin: Zhè jiān gōngyù hěn dà, zhù de xià liù ge rén.

text.traditional: 我剛剛吃了好幾個包子，現在吃不下了。
text.english: I just ate several steamed buns; I can’t eat any more now.
text.simplified: 我刚刚吃了好几个包子，现在吃不下了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ gānggāng chī le hǎojǐ ge bāozi, xiànzài chī bú xià le.

segments.traditional: 我多買了一碗滷肉飯，你要不要吃？
segments.simplified: 我多买了一碗卤肉饭，你要不要吃？

segments.traditional: 謝謝，我剛吃了半隻烤雞，現在
segments.simplified: 谢谢，我刚吃了半只烤鸡，现在

repairs.note: B has just eaten half a roast chicken, so there is no room for more: 吃不下.
"Cannot fit" is verb + 不 + 下. 沒 does not go between the verb and 下.
Braised pork rice is eaten, not drunk: 吃.

items.fallbackRepair: The verb, then 不, then 下: 吃不下.

result.traditional: 謝謝，我剛吃了半隻烤雞，現在吃不下了。
result.simplified: 谢谢，我刚吃了半只烤鸡，现在吃不下了。
result.pinyin: Xièxie, wǒ gāng chī le bàn zhī kǎo jī, xiànzài chībúxià le.
result.english: Thanks, but I just ate half a roast chicken; I can't eat any more now.

segments.traditional: 我們五個人要去阿里山，可以坐你的車去嗎？
segments.simplified: 我们五个人要去阿里山，可以坐你的车去吗？

repairs.note: B says the car is small, so five people will not fit: 坐不下.
住 is for a home. People sit in a car: 坐.
"Cannot fit" is verb + 不 + 下. 沒 does not go between the verb and 下.

items.fallbackRepair: The verb, then 不, then 下: 坐不下.

result.traditional: 我的車很小，坐不下五個人。
result.simplified: 我的车很小，坐不下五个人。
result.pinyin: Wǒ de chē hěn xiǎo, zuòbúxià wǔ ge rén.
result.english: My car is small; it can't seat five people.

segments.traditional: 你可以把你去旅遊的心情寫在明信片上，寄給我嗎？
segments.simplified: 你可以把你去旅游的心情写在明信片上，寄给我吗？

repairs.note: 寫不下嗎？ would ask whether it will not fit. B doubts that it fits, so the question is 寫得下嗎？
What may not fit on a small postcard is the writing, not the mailing: 寫.

items.fallbackRepair: The verb, then 得, then 下, and 嗎 at the very end: 寫得下嗎？

result.traditional: 明信片那麼小，寫得下嗎？
result.simplified: 明信片那么小，写得下吗？
result.pinyin: Míngxìnpiàn nàme xiǎo, xiědexià ma?
result.english: A postcard is so small. Will it all fit?

summary: V得下 and V不下 say whether there is enough room, or enough ability, to fit or finish something.
In this meaning, 下 is used only in these two forms.

text.traditional: （看看牆上的鐘）可欣，已經十二點多了，妳明天早上不是有課嗎？快點兒去睡吧！
text.simplified: （看看墙上的钟）可欣，已经十二点多了，你明天早上不是有课吗？快点儿去睡吧！
text.pinyin: (Kànkan qiángshàng de zhōng) Kěxīn, yǐjīng shí'èr diǎn duō le, nǐ míngtiān zǎoshàng búshì yǒu kè ma? Kuài diǎnr qù shuì ba!
text.english: (Looking at the clock on the wall) Kexin, it's already past 12 o'clock. Don't you have classes tomorrow morning? Hurry up and go to sleep!

text.traditional: 我還不能睡。後天日本歷史考試要從第五課考到第八課，（她翻了翻書）我還有十幾頁沒念完。
text.simplified: 我还不能睡。后天日本历史考试要从第五课考到第八课，（她翻了翻书）我还有十几页没念完。
text.pinyin: Wǒ hái bùnéng shuì. Hòutiān Rìběn lìshǐ kǎoshì yào cóng dìwǔ kè kǎo dào dì bā kè, (tā fān le fān shū) wǒ háiyǒu shíjǐ yè méi niàn wán.
text.english: I can't go to sleep yet. The Japanese history exam the day after tomorrow will cover lessons 5 to 8. (She flipped through the book.) I still have more than 10 pages to finish.

text.traditional: 可是妳最近都只吃三明治，又很晚才睡，這樣對身體不好吧？
text.simplified: 可是你最近都只吃三明治，又很晚才睡，这样对身体不好吧？
text.pinyin: Kěshì nǐ zuìjìn dōu zhǐ chī sānmíngzhì, yòu hěn wǎn cái shuì, zhèyàng duì shēntǐ bùhǎo ba?
text.english: But you've been recently eating only sandwiches, and you go to sleep very late. It isn't good for your body, is it?

text.traditional: 沒辦法。這門課除了有課堂小考，期末還要考口試和寫一篇作文。要是不用功一點兒，就會被當的！
text.simplified: 没办法。这门课除了有课堂小考，期末还要考口试和写一篇作文。要是不用功一点儿，就会被当的！
text.pinyin: Méibànfǎ. Zhè mén kè chúle yǒu kètáng xiǎo kǎo, qímò háiyào kǎo kǒushì hé xiě yì piān zuòwén. Yàoshì búyòng gōng yìdiǎnr, jiù huì bèi dāng de!
text.english: There's no other way. In this course there are classroom quizzes. Moreover, at the end of the semester, we have to take an oral exam and write a composition. If we don't study harder, we may flunk the course!

text.traditional: 聽起來很辛苦，妳為什麼要修這門課呢？
text.simplified: 听起来很辛苦，你为什么要修这门课呢？
text.pinyin: Tīngqǐlái hěn xīnkǔ, nǐ wèishénme yào xiū zhè mén kè ne?
text.english: Sounds tough. Why did you want to take this course?

text.traditional: 因為那位教授知識很豐富，教法也很好。
text.simplified: 因为那位教授知识很丰富，教法也很好。
text.pinyin: Yīnwèi nà wèi jiàoshòu zhīshì hěn fēngfù, jiàofǎ yě hěn hǎo.
text.english: Because the professor's knowledge is very vast, and the methods of teaching are very good, too.

text.traditional: 我們義大利文系的課好像比較輕鬆。這學期我沒修多少課，只有一門文法課要考筆試，其他兩門課只要交報告就好了。
text.simplified: 我们义大利文系的课好像比较轻松。这学期我没修多少课，只有一门文法课要考笔试，其他两门课只要交报告就好了。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen Yìdàlì wén xì de kè hǎoxiàng bǐjiào qīngsōng. Zhè xuéqí wǒ méi xiū duōshǎo kè, zhǐyǒu yì mén wénfǎ kè yào kǎo bǐshì, qítā liǎng mén kè zhǐyào jiāo bàogào jiù hǎo le.
text.english: Courses of the Department of Italian Language seem more laid-back. This semester I don't take too many courses. There is only one grammar course in which I have to take a written exam. In the other two, I only need to hand in reports.

text.traditional: 如果沒有期末考，教授怎麼給你們成績呢？
text.simplified: 如果没有期末考，教授怎么给你们成绩呢？
text.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu qímòkǎo, jiàoshòu zěnme gěi nǐmen chéngjī ne?
text.english: How does the professor score you if there is no final exam?

text.traditional: 只要平常認真上課，多查字典，把他要我們翻譯的文章翻好，期末成績就不會太差。
text.simplified: 只要平常认真上课，多查字典，把他要我们翻译的文章翻好，期末成绩就不会太差。
text.pinyin: Zhǐyào píngcháng rènzhēn shàngkè, duō chá zìdiǎn, bǎ tā yào wǒmen fānyì de wénzhāng fān hǎo, qímò chéngjī jiù bú huì tài chà.
text.english: As long as we concentrate in class, use the dictionary often, and translate the articles he assigns, our final scores won't be too bad.

text.traditional: 怎麼這麼好！上次考試我太緊張，有幾題沒寫完，考得比較差，這次我一定要更努力！
text.simplified: 怎么这么好！上次考试我太紧张，有几题没写完，考得比较差，这次我一定要更努力！
text.pinyin: Zěnme zhème hǎo! Shàng cì kǎoshì wǒ tài jǐnzhāng, yǒu jǐ tí méi xiě wán, kǎo de bǐjiào chà, zhè cì wǒ yídìng yào gèng nǔlì!
text.english: How can it be that good! I was too stressed on my last exam. I didn't finish several questions, so I got a worse grade. This time I must work harder!

text.traditional: 我小時候也很怕考試，有時候一緊張就吃不下飯，現在好多了。
text.simplified: 我小时候也很怕考试，有时候一紧张就吃不下饭，现在好多了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎoshíhòu yě hěn pà kǎoshì, yǒushíhòu yì jǐnzhāng jiù chī bú xià fàn, xiànzài hǎo duō le.
text.english: When I was little, I was afraid of taking exams, too. Sometimes I was so stressed that I couldn't eat, but it's much better now.

text.traditional: 我覺得平常就應該多讀書，讓自己的能力更好，將來才比較容易找到好工作。
text.simplified: 我觉得平常就应该多读书，让自己的能力更好，将来才比较容易找到好工作。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde píngcháng jiù yīnggāi duō dúshū, ràng zìjǐ de nénglì gèng hǎo, jiānglái cái bǐjiào róngyì zhǎodào hǎo gōngzuò.
text.english: I think we should normally study more to improve our own ability. In the future it will be easier to find a good job.

text.traditional: 念書當然很重要，可是妳今天念的書已經夠多了，現在最重要是睡覺喔！
text.simplified: 念书当然很重要，可是你今天念的书已经够多了，现在最重要是睡觉喔！
text.pinyin: Niànshū dāngrán hěn zhòngyào, kěshì nǐ jīntiān niàn de shū yǐjīng gòu duō le, xiànzài zuì zhòngyào shì shuìjiào o!
text.english: Although studying is certainly important, you have already studied enough for today. For now, the most important thing is sleep!

text.traditional: 好好好，我把這一頁念完就去洗澡、睡覺，明天再加油吧！
text.simplified: 好好好，我把这一页念完就去洗澡、睡觉，明天再加油吧！
text.pinyin: Hǎo hǎohǎo, wǒ bǎ zhè yí yè niàn wán jiù qù xǐzǎo, shuìjiào, míngtiān zài jiāyóu ba!
text.english: Alright, alright, alright! When I finish reading this page, I'll take a bath and go to bed right away. Tomorrow I'll keep going!

items.title: Grammar 7 · Ryosuke Yamamoto’s Life of Studying Abroad

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Are You Afraid of Taking Exams?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe a quality with a vivid, high-degree form, and place it correctly before a noun, in a complement, or before a verb.
grammarPages.explanation: The pattern of reduplication of state verb is “Vs Vs 的/地”. Reduplication of Vs can be divided into monosyllabic Vs reduplication and disyllabic Vs reduplication. The structure of monosyllabic Vs reduplication is simple; for example, “香香的” and “慢慢地”. On the other hand, the structure of disyllabic Vs (XY) reduplication is “XXYY 的/地”; for example, “漂漂亮亮的” and “舒舒服服地”. This pattern cannot be used together with degree adverb (“非常” and “很”) because reduplication of Vs already implies a high degree. When reduplication of Vs serves as a predicate, “的” is necessary to be added, e.g., “他的眼睛大大的” and “他的房間乾乾淨淨的”. When reduplication of Vs serves as a complement, “的” can be omitted, e.g., “他們玩得開開心心（的）”. However, not every state verb can be used in this pattern. For example, “貴 (expensive)”, “忙 (busy)”, “新 (new)”, “好吃 (good to eat)”, “好喝 (good to drink)”, “可愛 (cute)”, “可怕 (terrible)”, “不錯 (not bad)” are inappropriate in this pattern.
