segments.traditional: 我們的衣服都是在一樣的服裝店買的。
segments.simplified: 我们的衣服都是在一样的服装店买的。

repairs.note: 一樣 means "alike". One and the same shop is 同一家.
位 counts people politely. Shops take 家.
本 counts books. Shops take 家.

items.fallbackRepair: 同 first, then 一, then the measure word: 同一家.

result.traditional: 我們的衣服都是在同一家服裝店買的。
result.simplified: 我们的衣服都是在同一家服装店买的。
result.pinyin: Wǒmen de yīfu dōu shì zài tóng yì jiā fúzhuāng diàn mǎi de.
result.english: We all bought our clothes at the same clothing store.

segments.traditional: 我的中文老師是林老師。莫以凡的中文老師也是林老師。
segments.simplified: 我的中文老师是林老师。莫以凡的中文老师也是林老师。

segments.traditional: 我跟莫以凡的中文老師是
segments.simplified: 我跟莫以凡的中文老师是

repairs.note: 家 counts shops and restaurants. A teacher takes 位.
一樣 means "alike". One and the same teacher is 同一位.
本 counts books. A teacher takes 位.

items.fallbackRepair: 同 first, then 一, then the measure word: 同一位.

result.traditional: 我跟莫以凡的中文老師是同一位。
result.simplified: 我跟莫以凡的中文老师是同一位。
result.pinyin: Wǒ gēn Mò Yǐfán de Zhōngwén lǎoshī shì tóng yí wèi.
result.english: Mo Yifan and I have the same Chinese teacher.

segments.traditional: 我妹妹的生日是3月8日，我的好朋友也是3月8日出生的。
我妹妹跟我的好朋友是

repairs.note: The sentence gives the same date (3月8日), not the same year: 同一天.
A date is a day, so the word after 同一 is 天.
一樣 means "alike". One and the same day is 同一天.

items.fallbackRepair: 同 first, then 一, then 天: 同一天.

result.traditional: 我妹妹跟我的好朋友是同一天出生的。
result.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei gēn wǒ de hǎo péngyǒu shì tóng yì tiān chūshēng de.
result.english: My younger sister and my good friend were born on the same day.

summary: 同 + 一 + a measure word says that different people or things share the same situation.
The shared thing can be the same object, time, location and so on.
A noun can follow the measure word, but it is not required.

dialogue.title: 你想參加哪一個社團？
grammarFocus: PW + V 了 + N / PW + V 著 + N

text.traditional: （以凡跟良介在校園裡）
text.simplified: （以凡跟良介在校园里）
text.pinyin: (Yǐfán gēn Liángjiè zài xiàoyuán lǐ)
text.english: (Yifan and Ryosuke are on campus.)

text.traditional: 最近校園裡擺了很多攤子，攤子前面站了不少學生，他們在做什麼啊？
text.simplified: 最近校园里摆了很多摊子，摊子前面站了不少学生，他们在做什么啊？
text.pinyin: Zuìjìn xiàoyuán lǐ bǎi le hěn duō tānzi, tānzi qiánmiàn zhàn le bùshǎo xuéshēng, tāmen zài zuò shénme a?
text.english: Recently, many stalls have been set up on campus. In front of the stalls stand a lot of students. What are they doing?

text.traditional: 每個學期開學的時候，學生社團的社員都會給新生介紹自己的社團，讓新生知道他們有什麼活動。
text.simplified: 每个学期开学的时候，学生社团的社员都会给新生介绍自己的社团，让新生知道他们有什么活动。
text.pinyin: Měi ge xuéqí kāixué de shíhòu, xuéshēng shètuán de shèyuán dōu huì gěi xīnshēng jièshào zìjǐ de shètuán, ràng xīnshēng zhīdào tāmen yǒu shénme huódòng.
text.english: At the beginning of every semester, members of each student club introduce their clubs to new students, and let new students know what activities their clubs have.

text.traditional: 聽起來很有意思，我們過去看看吧！
text.simplified: 听起来很有意思，我们过去看看吧！
text.pinyin: Tīngqǐlái hěn yǒuyìsi, wǒmen guòqù kànkan ba!
text.english: Sounds very interesting. Let’s go take a look!

text.traditional: （兩個人把攤子都看了一遍以後）
text.simplified: （两个人把摊子都看了一遍以后）
text.pinyin: (Liǎng ge rén bǎ tānzi dōu kàn le yí biàn yǐhòu)
text.english: (After taking a look at each of the stalls once.)

text.traditional: 這麼多社團，我不知道怎麼選擇。
text.simplified: 这么多社团，我不知道怎么选择。
text.pinyin: Zhème duō shètuán, wǒ bù zhīdào zěnme xuǎnzé.
text.english: There are so many student clubs. I don’t know how to choose.

text.traditional: 對啊！每個社團看起來都很吸引人，真的很難立刻決定。除了鋼琴社，我也想參加書法社和中國功夫社。
text.simplified: 对啊！每个社团看起来都很吸引人，真的很难立刻决定。除了钢琴社，我也想参加书法社和中国功夫社。
text.pinyin: Duì a! Měi ge shètuán kànqǐlái dōu hěn xīyǐn rén, zhēnde hěn nán lìkè juédìng. Chúle gāngqín shè, wǒ yě xiǎng cānjiā shūfǎ shè hé Zhōngguó gōngfu shè.
text.english: Yes! Every club looks very attractive, and it’s really hard to decide right away. Besides the piano club, I also want to participate in the calligraphy and Chinese Kungfu clubs.

text.traditional: 看不出來你對中華文化這麼感興趣！
text.simplified: 看不出来你对中华文化这么感兴趣！
text.pinyin: Kàn bù chū lái nǐ duì Zhōnghuá Wénhuà zhème gǎnxìngqù!
text.english: I can’t tell that you are so interested in Chinese culture!

text.traditional: 我覺得中國書法是一種藝術。參加書法社可以讓我認識更多漢字。
text.simplified: 我觉得中国书法是一种艺术。参加书法社可以让我认识更多汉字。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde Zhōngguó shūfǎ shì yì zhǒng yìshù. Cānjiā shūfǎ shè kěyǐ ràng wǒ rènshì gèng duō Hànzì.
text.english: I think that Chinese calligraphy is a kind of art. Joining the calligraphy club allows me to learn more Chinese characters.

text.traditional: 那中國功夫社呢？
text.simplified: 那中国功夫社呢？
text.pinyin: Nà Zhōngguó gōngfu shè ne?
text.english: What about Chinese Kungfu club then?

text.traditional: 中國功夫社嘛……我覺得中國功夫好厲害，如果學會了就可以保護自己，讓自己變得更勇敢。你呢？
text.simplified: 中国功夫社嘛……我觉得中国功夫好厉害，如果学会了就可以保护自己，让自己变得更勇敢。你呢？
text.pinyin: Zhōngguó gōngfu shè ma… wǒ juéde Zhōngguó gōngfu hǎo lìhài, rúguǒ xuéhuì le jiù kěyǐ bǎohù zìjǐ, ràng zìjǐ biàn de gèng yǒnggǎn. Nǐ ne?
text.english: Chinese Kungfu club… I think Chinese Kungfu is amazing. If I learn it, I can protect myself and become braver. And you?

text.traditional: 我想參加吉他社或是愛心服務社。
text.simplified: 我想参加吉他社或是爱心服务社。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng cānjiā jítā shè huòshì àixīn fúwù shè.
text.english: I want to join the guitar club or the charity service club.

text.traditional: 這兩個社團非常不一樣，你為什麼都有興趣？
text.simplified: 这两个社团非常不一样，你为什么都有兴趣？
text.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge shètuán fēicháng bù yíyàng, nǐ wèishénme dōu yǒu xìngqù?
text.english: These two clubs are very different. Why are you interested in both of them?

text.traditional: 我以前學過吉他，但是太久沒練習，很多技巧都忘了，我想複習複習。愛心服務社嘛……
text.simplified: 我以前学过吉他，但是太久没练习，很多技巧都忘了，我想复习复习。爱心服务社嘛……
text.pinyin: Wǒ yǐqián xué guo jítā, dànshì tài jiǔ méi liànxí, hěn duō jìqiǎo dōu wàngle, wǒ xiǎng fùxí fùxí. Àixīn fúwù shè ma…
text.english: I used to learn how to play the guitar, but I haven’t practiced it for too long. I’ve already forgotten a lot of skills, so I want to review them a bit. As for the charity service club…

text.traditional: 我知道，你想幫助需要幫助的人。
text.simplified: 我知道，你想帮助需要帮助的人。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào, nǐ xiǎng bāngzhù xūyào bāngzhù de rén.
text.english: I know! You want to help the people in need.

text.traditional: 沒錯，我們都生活在同一個地球上，本來就應該互相幫助。
text.simplified: 没错，我们都生活在同一个地球上，本来就应该互相帮助。
text.pinyin: Méicuò, wǒmen dōu shēnghuó zài tóng yíge dìqiú shàng, běnlái jiù yīnggāi hùxiāng bāngzhù.
text.english: Right. We all live on the same planet Earth. Of course we should help each other.

text.traditional: 沒想到你想得這麼多！那麼要跟誰談戀愛，你想好了沒有？
text.simplified: 没想到你想得这么多！那么要跟谁谈恋爱，你想好了没有？
text.pinyin: Méixiǎngdào nǐ xiǎng de zhème duō! Nàme yào gēn shéi tán liàn'ài, nǐ xiǎng hǎo le méiyǒu?
text.english: I didn't expect that you think this much! Then have you decided who you're to be in love with?

text.traditional: 你別開玩笑了！
text.simplified: 你别开玩笑了！
text.pinyin: Nǐ bié kāiwánxiào le!
text.english: Don't be kidding me!

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Which Club Would You Like to Join?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 等 to show a category total or that a list has more examples.
grammarPages.explanation: In Chinese, the word “等” has two functions. Firstly, it can be placed before a number that marks the total of items mentioned, or before a word that is the hypernym (category) for the items mentioned. On the other hand, it can be used at the end of a list to show there are still a lot of examples of the same kind.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: In Chinese, the word “等” has two functions. Firstly, it can be placed before a number that marks the total of items mentioned, or before a word that is the hypernym (category) for the items mentioned. On the other hand, it can be used at the end of a list to show there are still a lot of examples of the same kind.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: In Chinese, the word “等” has two functions. Firstly, it can be placed before a number that marks the total of items mentioned, or before a word that is the hypernym (category) for the items mentioned. On the other hand, it can be used at the end of a list to show there are still a lot of examples of the same kind.
grammarPages.pattern: Examples + 等 +（total / category / etc.）

text.traditional: 請在這裡寫下你的姓名、國家、出生日期等資料。
text.simplified: 请在这里写下你的姓名、国家、出生日期等资料。
text.english: Please write your name, country, date of birth, and other information here.
text.pinyin: Qǐng zài zhèlǐ xiě xià nǐ de xìngmíng, guójiā, chūshēng rìqí děng zīliào.

text.traditional: 我哥哥喜愛旅遊，他去過日本、英國、法國等三個國家。
text.simplified: 我哥哥喜爱旅游，他去过日本、英国、法国等三个国家。
text.english: My older brother loves traveling. He has visited three countries: Japan, the UK, and France.
text.pinyin: Wǒ gēge xǐ'ài lǚyóu, tā qù guo Rìběn, Yīngguó, Fǎguó děng sān ge guójiā.

text.traditional: 學校的社團像鋼琴社、吉他社、書法社等，都有很多社員。
text.simplified: 学校的社团像钢琴社、吉他社、书法社等，都有很多社员。
text.english: The school’s clubs, such as the piano, guitar, and calligraphy clubs, all have many members.
text.pinyin: Xuéxiào de shètuán xiàng gāngqín shè, jítā shè, shūfǎ shè děng, dōu yǒu hěn duō shèyuán.

repairs.note: 和 joins the last two things in a list. After the whole list, 等 leads to the word for their kind.
Stinky tofu, chicken cutlet and oyster omelet are snacks, not drinks.
A list is closed with 等, then the word for its kind: …等小吃.

items.fallbackRepair: 等 after the list, then the word for its kind: …等小吃.

result.traditional: 臭豆腐、雞排、蚵仔煎等小吃，我都吃過。
result.simplified: 臭豆腐、鸡排、蚵仔煎等小吃，我都吃过。
result.pinyin: Chòu dòufǔ, jīpái, ézǐjiān děng xiǎochī, wǒ dōu chīguo.
result.english: Stinky tofu, chicken cutlet, oyster omelet and other such snacks, I've had them all.

repairs.note: B names three countries, so the total after 等 cannot be two.
位 counts people. Countries take 個.
和 joins the last two things in a list. Before the total, the list is closed with 等.

items.fallbackRepair: 等 after the list, then the total: …等三個國家.

result.traditional: 我有日本、美國、法國等三個國家的朋友。
result.simplified: 我有日本、美国、法国等三个国家的朋友。
result.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu Rìběn, Měiguó, Fǎguó děng sān ge guójiā de péngyǒu.
result.english: I have friends from three countries: Japan, the United States and France.

segments.traditional: 我們週末要去阿里山爬山，要準備哪些東西呢？
segments.simplified: 我们周末要去阿里山爬山，要准备哪些东西呢？

repairs.note: 和 goes between the last two things, not after the list. The list ends with 等.
A asks what to bring, so B lists what is needed: 都要準備, not 不要準備.
Here 才 would say it happens late. Everything on the list takes 都.

items.fallbackRepair: 等 closes the list, and 都 sums it up: …等，都要準備.

result.traditional: 外套、雨衣、開水等，都要準備。
result.simplified: 外套、雨衣、开水等，都要准备。
result.pinyin: Wàitào, yǔyī, kāishuǐ děng, dōu yào zhǔnbèi.
result.english: Jackets, raincoats, drinking water and so on all need to be prepared.

summary: After a list of examples, 等 can sum them up with a number for the total or a word for the category.
Put 等 at the end of a list to show there are many more of the same kind.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 從……中 to say what someone learns, handles, or gains from an experience or source.
grammarPages.explanation: In this pattern, “中” means “inside” instead of “middle”. The pattern “從……中” indicates someone learns about a situation, deals with something, or gets benefits from something.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: In this pattern, “中” means “inside” instead of “middle”. The pattern “從……中” indicates someone learns about a situation, deals with something, or gets benefits from something.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: In this pattern, “中” means “inside” instead of “middle”. The pattern “從……中” indicates someone learns about a situation, deals with something, or gets benefits from something.

text.traditional: 醫生從檢查報告中了解病人的情況。
text.simplified: 医生从检查报告中了解病人的情况。
text.english: The doctor learns about the patient’s condition from the examination report.
text.pinyin: Yīshēng cóng jiǎnchá bàogào zhōng liǎojiě bìngrén de qíngkuàng.

text.traditional: 我們可以從生活中得到不少寶貴的經驗。
text.simplified: 我们可以从生活中得到不少宝贵的经验。
text.english: We can gain many valuable experiences from life.
text.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ cóng shēnghuó zhōng dédào bùshǎo bǎoguì de jīngyàn.

text.traditional: 從他說的這些話中，我聽不出來他是高興還是難過。
text.simplified: 从他说的这些话中，我听不出来他是高兴还是难过。
text.english: From what he said, I can’t tell whether he is happy or sad.
text.pinyin: Cóng tā shuō de zhèxiē huà zhōng, wǒ tīng bù chūlái tā shì gāoxìng háishì nánguò.

segments.traditional: 考試的成績可以讓老師知道學生學得怎麼樣。
segments.simplified: 考试的成绩可以让老师知道学生学得怎么样。

repairs.note: 從…到… gives a start and an end. Learning something out of the results is 從…中.
讓 is in the first sentence, where the results are the subject. Now the teacher is the subject and learns from them: 知道.
對 marks whom something affects. What the teacher learns from takes 從…中.

items.fallbackRepair: 從 before the source, 中 after it, then what is learned: 從考試的成績中知道….

result.traditional: 老師可以從考試的成績中知道學生學得怎麼樣。
result.simplified: 老师可以从考试的成绩中知道学生学得怎么样。
result.pinyin: Lǎoshī kěyǐ cóng kǎoshì de chéngjī zhōng zhīdào xuéshēng xué de zěnmeyàng.
result.english: From the exam results, the teacher can tell how well the students are learning.

segments.traditional: 我從參加社團的經驗裡，學到了不少處理事情的方法。
segments.simplified: 我从参加社团的经验里，学到了不少处理事情的方法。

segments.traditional: 了不少處理事情的方法。
segments.simplified: 了不少处理事情的方法。

repairs.note: 中間 is the middle of a place. In this pattern 中 means "in" or "out of": 從…中.
從…到… gives a start and an end. Getting something out of an experience is 從…中.
對 marks whom something affects. What you learn from takes 從…中.

items.fallbackRepair: 從 before the source, 中 after it, then what was gained: 從…經驗中，學到了….

result.traditional: 我從參加社團的經驗中，學到了不少處理事情的方法。
result.simplified: 我从参加社团的经验中，学到了不少处理事情的方法。
result.pinyin: Wǒ cóng cānjiā shètuán de jīngyàn zhōng, xuédào le bùshǎo chǔlǐ shìqíng de fāngfǎ.
result.english: From my experience of joining clubs, I learned quite a few ways of handling things.

segments.traditional: 老師選了幾個華語中心的學生，去參加用中文說故事的比賽。
segments.simplified: 老师选了几个华语中心的学生，去参加用中文说故事的比赛。

segments.traditional: ，去參加用中文說故事的比賽。
segments.simplified: ，去参加用中文说故事的比赛。

repairs.note: 對 marks whom something affects. The group the teacher picks from takes 從…中.
從…到… gives a start and an end. Picking some out of a group is 從…中.
給 hands something to someone. The group the teacher picks from takes 從…中.

items.fallbackRepair: 從 before the group, 中 after it, then the choosing: 從華語中心的學生中選了幾個.

result.traditional: 老師從華語中心的學生中選了幾個，去參加用中文說故事的比賽。
result.simplified: 老师从华语中心的学生中选了几个，去参加用中文说故事的比赛。
result.pinyin: Lǎoshī cóng Huáyǔ zhōngxīn de xuéshēng zhōng xuǎn le jǐ ge, qù cānjiā yòng Zhōngwén shuō gùshì de bǐsài.
result.english: The teacher picked a few from among the Chinese language center's students to take part in the Chinese storytelling contest.

summary: 從 ... 中 says someone learns about a situation, deals with something, or gets benefits from something.
In this pattern, 中 means inside, not middle.

dialogue.title: 社團活動對山本良介的影響

text.traditional: 山本良介來台灣以後，參加了愛心服務社。社團每個月都會安排兩次活動，利用週末到一些地方去服務。
text.simplified: 山本良介来台湾以后，参加了爱心服务社。社团每个月都会安排两次活动，利用周末到一些地方去服务。
text.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè lái Táiwān yǐhòu, cānjiā le àixīn fúwù shè. Shètuán měi ge yuè dōu huì ānpái liǎng cì huódòng, lìyòng zhōumò dào yìxiē dìfāng qù fúwù.
text.english: After coming to Taiwan, Yamamoto Ryosuke joined the charity service club. Every month, the club organizes two events and uses the time on weekends to go to some places to help people.

text.traditional: 社員們會到安養院去幫老人打掃環境、擦窗戶、洗廁所、刷馬桶，然後再陪他們聊聊天。他們也會到育幼院去照顧孩子，教比較小的孩子刷牙、穿衣服，陪比較大的孩子讀書、做功課。有時候也給他們上美術課，或是帶他們到外邊運動。上過護理課的社員，就可以到醫院去陪病人檢查身體，幫他們處理掛號、住院、出院等問題，或是到病房關心病人和他們的家人。這些經驗讓良介有不少收穫。
text.simplified: 社员们会到安养院去帮老人打扫环境、擦窗户、洗厕所、刷马桶，然后再陪他们聊聊天。他们也会到育幼院去照顾孩子，教比较小的孩子刷牙、穿衣服，陪比较大的孩子读书、做功课。有时候也给他们上美术课，或是带他们到外边运动。上过护理课的社员，就可以到医院去陪病人检查身体，帮他们处理挂号、住院、出院等问题，或是到病房关心病人和他们的家人。这些经验让良介有不少收获。
text.pinyin: Shèyuán men huì dào ānyǎng yuàn qù bāng lǎorén dǎsǎo huánjìng, cā chuānghù, xǐ cèsuǒ, shuā mǎtǒng, ránhòu zài péi tāmen liáo liáotiān. Tāmen yě huì dào yùyòuyuàn qù zhàogù háizi, jiāo bǐjiào xiǎo de háizi shuāyá, chuān yīfu, péi bǐjiào dà de háizi dúshū, zuò gōngkè. Yǒushíhòu yě gěi tāmen shàng měishù kè, huòshì dài tāmen dào wàibiān yùndòng. Shàng guo hùlǐ kè de shèyuán, jiù kěyǐ dào yīyuàn qù péi bìngrén jiǎnchá shēntǐ, bāng tāmen chǔlǐ guàhào, zhùyuàn, chūyuàn děng wèntí, huòshì dào bìngfáng guānxīn bìngrén hé tāmen de jiārén. Zhèxiē jīngyàn ràng Liángjiè yǒu bùshǎo shōuhuò.
text.english: Members of the club would go to elderly nursing homes to help the elderly clean up the environment, wipe windows, wash the bathrooms, brush the toilets, and then chat with them. They would also go to children’s homes to look after the children. They teach the younger children how to brush their teeth or put on their clothes, and accompany the older children in studying or doing homework. Sometimes they organize fine art lessons for them, or take them outside to exercise. Furthermore, members who have attended nursing courses can go to hospitals to accompany patients in medical examinations and help them handle issues such as registration, hospitalization and discharge, or go into wards to show concern for patients and their relatives. These experiences benefit Ryosuke a lot.

text.traditional: 以前良介每天只知道念書，對很多事情都不感興趣，常去的地方只有學校、書店或是圖書館。因為他極重視考試的成績，對他來說，只要成績好，就代表會有一個美好的未來。不過，參加了幾次愛心服務以後，他發現自己成長了不少。從服務中得到的經驗，好像比從課本中學到的更寶貴呢！所以良介告訴自己，畢業以後，他還要繼續做這個極有意義的工作。
text.simplified: 以前良介每天只知道念书，对很多事情都不感兴趣，常去的地方只有学校、书店或是图书馆。因为他极重视考试的成绩，对他来说，只要成绩好，就代表会有一个美好的未来。不过，参加了几次爱心服务以后，他发现自己成长了不少。从服务中得到的经验，好像比从课本中学到的更宝贵呢！所以良介告诉自己，毕业以后，他还要继续做这个极有意义的工作。
text.pinyin: Yǐqián Liángjiè měitiān zhǐ zhīdào niànshū, duì hěn duō shìqíng dōu bù gǎnxìngqù, cháng qù de dìfāng zhǐyǒu xuéxiào, shūdiàn huòshì túshūguǎn. Yīnwèi tā jí zhòngshì kǎoshì de chéngjī, duì tā lái shuō, zhǐyào chéngjī hǎo, jiù dàibiǎo huì yǒu yíge měihǎo de wèilái. Búguò, cānjiā le jǐ cì àixīn fúwù yǐhòu, tā fāxiàn zìjǐ chéngzhǎng le bùshǎo. Cóng fúwù zhōng dédào de jīngyàn, hǎoxiàng bǐ cóng kèběn zhōng xué dào de gèng bǎoguì ne! Suǒyǐ Liángjiè gàosu zìjǐ, bìyè yǐhòu, tā háiyào jìxù zuò zhège jí yǒu yìyì de gōngzuò.
text.english: Before, what Ryosuke did was just studying every day. He wasn’t interested in many things. The places where he went often were only the school, bookstores and libraries. He paid very great attention to the scores of exams. For him, he thought that grades mean everything. As long as the grades are good, it means a bright future. However, after participating in charity service several times, he realized he grew a lot. The experience he gained through service seems to be more valuable than what he learned from textbooks! So Ryosuke tells himself: After graduation, he will continue to do this extremely meaningful work.

items.title: Grammar 1–6 · A Small Clerk? A Big Boss?

dialogue.title: 對話 · 小職員？大老闆？ · A Small Clerk? A Big Boss?

text.traditional: （美心跟可欣在教室外面聊天）
text.simplified: （美心跟可欣在教室外面聊天）
text.pinyin: (Měixīn gēn Kěxīn zài jiàoshì wàimiàn liáotiān)
text.english: (Meixin and Kexin are chatting outside the classroom.)

text.traditional: 我大哥今年六月就大學畢業了，他計畫去英國念研究所。
text.simplified: 我大哥今年六月就大学毕业了，他计划去英国念研究所。
text.pinyin: Wǒ dàgē jīnnián liùyuè jiù dàxué bìyè le, tā jìhuà qù Yīngguó niàn yánjiùsuǒ.
text.english: My eldest brother is going to graduate this June. He is planning to study in a graduate school in England.

text.traditional: 他想研究什麼呢？
text.simplified: 他想研究什么呢？
text.pinyin: Tā xiǎng yánjiù shénme ne?
text.english: What does he want to research?

text.traditional: 他對藝術、文化很有興趣，英國的大學有很多這樣的課程，等收到學校的通知，就要去留學了。
text.simplified: 他对艺术、文化很有兴趣，英国的大学有很多这样的课程，等收到学校的通知，就要去留学了。
text.pinyin: Tā duì yìshù, wénhuà hěn yǒu xìngqù, Yīngguó de dàxué yǒu hěn duō zhèyàng de kèchéng, děng shōudào xuéxiào de tōngzhī, jiùyào qù liúxué le.
text.english: He is interested in art and culture. The universities in England have many courses like that. After he receives a notification, he will leave to study abroad in June.

text.traditional: 出國念書很好啊！念了研究所，將來也比較容易找到工作。
text.simplified: 出国念书很好啊！念了研究所，将来也比较容易找到工作。
text.pinyin: Chūguó niànshū hěn hǎo a! Niàn le yánjiùsuǒ, jiānglái yě bǐjiào róngyì zhǎodào gōngzuò.
text.english: Studying abroad is really good! Also, after getting the Master’s degree, it will be easier to find a job in the future.

text.traditional: 聽說有些念廣告或是服裝設計的人，還沒畢業就找到工作了。
text.simplified: 听说有些念广告或是服装设计的人，还没毕业就找到工作了。
text.pinyin: Tīngshuō yǒuxiē niàn guǎnggào huòshì fúzhuāng shèjì de rén, háiméi bìyè jiù zhǎodào gōngzuò le.
text.english: I heard that some people who study advertising or fashion design find a job even before graduation.

text.traditional: 好厲害喔！不過，我覺得興趣也很重要，如果工作太無聊，我一定會想換工作的。
text.simplified: 好厉害喔！不过，我觉得兴趣也很重要，如果工作太无聊，我一定会想换工作的。
text.pinyin: Hǎo lìhài o! Búguò, wǒ juéde xìngqù yě hěn zhòngyào, rúguǒ gōngzuò tài wúliáo, wǒ yídìng huì xiǎng huàn gōngzuò de.
text.english: Wow, amazing! However, I think that interests are important, too. If the work is too boring, I will certainly want to change my job.

text.traditional: 妳對日語有興趣，而且成績很好，應該繼續念研究所，將來當教授啊！
text.simplified: 你对日语有兴趣，而且成绩很好，应该继续念研究所，将来当教授啊！
text.pinyin: Nǐ duì Rìyǔ yǒu xìngqù, érqiě chéngjī hěn hǎo, yīnggāi jìxù niàn yánjiùsuǒ, jiānglái dāng jiàoshòu a!
text.english: You are interested in the Japanese language, and you get good grades. You should continue going to a graduate school and become a professor in the future!

text.traditional: 我是有這樣的想法。妳呢？妳的課上得怎麼樣？
text.simplified: 我是有这样的想法。你呢？你的课上得怎么样？
text.pinyin: Wǒ shì yǒu zhèyàng de xiǎngfǎ. Nǐ ne? Nǐ de kè shàng de zěnmeyàng?
text.english: I do consider this. What about you? How are you doing in class?

text.traditional: 除了翻譯課比較難，聽力跟會話課的成績都不錯。
text.simplified: 除了翻译课比较难，听力跟会话课的成绩都不错。
text.pinyin: Chúle fānyì kè bǐjiào nán, tīnglì gēn huìhuà kè de chéngjī dōu búcuò.
text.english: Except that the translation class is more difficult, both my listening and conversation grades are not bad.

text.traditional: 台灣好像只有一、兩所大學的外語學院有義大利文系，畢業後應該不難找工作吧？
text.simplified: 台湾好像只有一、两所大学的外语学院有义大利文系，毕业后应该不难找工作吧？
text.pinyin: Táiwān hǎoxiàng zhǐyǒu yì, liǎng suǒ dàxué de wàiyǔ xuéyuàn yǒu Yìdàlì wén xì, bìyè hòu yīnggāi bù nán zhǎo gōngzuò ba?
text.english: It seems that there are only one or two universities in Taiwan where the College of Foreign Language has a Department of Italian Language. It should not be difficult to find a job after graduation, right?

text.traditional: 也許不像念哲學、歷史的那麼難，可是沒有其他的專業能力，想找到好工作也是很困難的。
text.simplified: 也许不像念哲学、历史的那么难，可是没有其他的专业能力，想找到好工作也是很困难的。
text.pinyin: Yěxǔ bú xiàng niàn zhéxué, lìshǐ de nàme nán, kěshì méiyǒu qítā de zhuānyè nénglì, xiǎng zhǎodào hǎo gōngzuò yě shì hěn kùnnán de.
text.english: Maybe it’s not as hard as those who study philosophy or history. However, without any other professional skill, it is still very difficult to find a good job.

text.traditional: 我覺得日語老師是很好的職業，所以從下個月起，我就要去當王教授的助理，向他學習怎麼教日文。妳呢？妳希望將來的職業是什麼？
text.simplified: 我觉得日语老师是很好的职业，所以从下个月起，我就要去当王教授的助理，向他学习怎么教日文。你呢？你希望将来的职业是什么？
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde Rìyǔ lǎoshī shì hěn hǎo de zhíyè, suǒyǐ cóng xià ge yuè qǐ, wǒ jiùyào qù dāng Wáng jiàoshòu de zhùlǐ, xiàng tā xuéxí zěnme jiāo Rìwén. Nǐ ne? Nǐ xīwàng jiānglái de zhíyè shì shénme?
text.english: I think being a Japanese teacher is a very good job, so from next month I am going to work as Professor Wang’s assistant. I will learn from him how to teach Japanese. And you? What kind of job do you hope to have in the future?

text.traditional: 說真的，我只想去貿易公司上班，當一個小職員就好了。
text.simplified: 说真的，我只想去贸易公司上班，当一个小职员就好了。
text.pinyin: Shuōzhēnde, wǒ zhǐ xiǎng qù màoyì gōngsī shàngbān, dāng yíge xiǎo zhíyuán jiù hǎo le.
text.english: Honestly speaking, I just want to work in a trading company, working as a small office clerk is good enough.

text.traditional: 真的？妳不想自己當老闆嗎？
text.simplified: 真的？你不想自己当老板吗？
text.pinyin: Zhēnde? Nǐ bù xiǎng zìjǐ dāng lǎobǎn ma?
text.english: Really? Don’t you want to be the boss?

text.traditional: 當老闆太累了！像我爸爸是保險公司的經理，管理三十多個員工，不但常常開會、加班，還要做市場研究。
text.simplified: 当老板太累了！像我爸爸是保险公司的经理，管理三十多个员工，不但常常开会、加班，还要做市场研究。
text.pinyin: Dāng lǎobǎn tài lèi le! Xiàng wǒ bàba shì bǎoxiǎn gōngsī de jīnglǐ, guǎnlǐ sānshí duō ge yuángōng, búdàn chángcháng kāihuì, jiābān, háiyào zuò shìchǎng yánjiù.
text.english: Being a boss is too tiring! For example, my father is a manager in an insurance company. He manages more than thirty employees. He not only has meetings and works overtime often, but also needs to do market research.

text.traditional: 他要負責這麼多事情，真的太累了，難怪妳不想當老闆。
text.simplified: 他要负责这么多事情，真的太累了，难怪你不想当老板。
text.pinyin: Tā yào fùzé zhème duō shìqíng, zhēnde tài lèi le, nánguài nǐ bù xiǎng dāng lǎobǎn.
text.english: He is responsible for so many things and can be really tired. No wonder you don’t want to be the boss.

text.traditional: 最近他也覺得體力越來越差，做不了那麼多事了，所以想要早一點兒退休。
text.simplified: 最近他也觉得体力越来越差，做不了那么多事了，所以想要早一点儿退休。
text.pinyin: Zuìjìn tā yě juéde tǐlì yuèláiyuè chà, zuò bùliǎo nàme duō shì le, suǒyǐ xiǎngyào zǎo yìdiǎnr tuìxiū.
text.english: Recently, he feels that he’s been getting physically weaker and can’t manage to do so many things, so he really wants to retire.

text.traditional: （可欣看看手錶）
text.simplified: （可欣看看手表）
text.pinyin: (Kěxīn kànkan shǒubiǎo)
text.english: (Kexin is looking at the watch.)

text.traditional: 快上課了，我們別想那麼多了。到底要找什麼工作，等大四再說吧。
text.simplified: 快上课了，我们别想那么多了。到底要找什么工作，等大四再说吧。
text.pinyin: Kuài shàngkè le, wǒmen bié xiǎng nàme duō le. Dàodǐ yào zhǎo shénme gōngzuò, děng dà sì zàishuō ba.
text.english: It’s time for class. Don’t think too much. Let’s wait until the senior year to think about looking for a job.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: A Small Clerk? A Big Boss?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Exclude one person or thing while saying what is true of the rest.
grammarPages.pattern: S + 除了 + excluded item, ... 都 ... / 除了 + excluded item, S + ... 都 ...
grammarPages.explanation: “除了”, which shows exclusion, can be followed by a noun, verb, noun phrase or intransitive state verb. The subject of this pattern can be placed in front of either “除了” or “都”, ie: “我除了咖啡，什麼飲料都喝。” or “除了咖啡，我什麼飲料都喝。”
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: “除了”, which shows exclusion, can be followed by a noun, verb, noun phrase or intransitive state verb. The subject of this pattern can be placed in front of either “除了” or “都”, ie: “我除了咖啡，什麼飲料都喝。” or “除了咖啡，我什麼飲料都喝。”
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “除了”, which shows exclusion, can be followed by a noun, verb, noun phrase or intransitive state verb. The subject of this pattern can be placed in front of either “除了” or “都”, ie: “我除了咖啡，什麼飲料都喝。” or “除了咖啡，我什麼飲料都喝。”

text.traditional: 我除了影集，什麼電視節目都不愛看。
text.simplified: 我除了影集，什么电视节目都不爱看。
text.pinyin: Wǒ chúle yǐngjí, shénme diànshì jiémù dōu bú ài kàn.
text.english: Except for TV series, I don’t like watching any kind of TV program.

text.traditional: 除了加班，爸爸週末都不去公司，一定在家休息。
text.simplified: 除了加班，爸爸周末都不去公司，一定在家休息。
text.pinyin: Chúle jiābān, bàba zhōumò dōu bú qù gōngsī, yídìng zài jiā xiūxí.
text.english: Except when he works overtime, Dad never goes to the office on weekends; he’s always resting at home.

text.traditional: A：聽說那個研究所的課程很難，教授都用英文上課。B：沒錯，除了電腦課，所有課程都是用英文上的。
text.simplified: A：听说那个研究所的课程很难，教授都用英文上课。B：没错，除了电脑课，所有课程都是用英文上的。
text.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō nàge yánjiùsuǒ de kèchéng hěn nán, jiàoshòu dōu yòng Yīngwén shàngkè. B: Méicuò, chúle diànnǎo kè, suǒyǒu kèchéng dōu shì yòng Yīngwén shàng de.
text.english: A: I heard the graduate-school courses are hard and the professors teach them all in English. B: That’s right; except for the computer course, all the courses are taught in English.

repairs.note: The sentence is about foreign languages (其他外語), and math is not one of them.
如果 sets up an "if", but nothing here is a condition. Leaving one language out of "all the others" is 除了.
Every other language is covered, so this takes 都: 其他外語都沒興趣.

items.fallbackRepair: 除了 before the one left out, and 都 before what is true of all the others.

result.traditional: 除了中文，我對其他外語都沒興趣。
result.simplified: 除了中文，我对其他外语都没兴趣。
result.pinyin: Chúle Zhōngwén, wǒ duì qítā wàiyǔ dōu méi xìngqù.
result.english: Apart from Chinese, I have no interest in any other foreign language.

segments.traditional: 這麼多卡通人物，你最喜歡哪一個？
segments.simplified: 这么多卡通人物，你最喜欢哪一个？

repairs.note: 怎麼 asks "how". Before a noun, "any" is 什麼: 什麼卡通人物都….
A asks which one B likes most. B names Snoopy as the only one, so the others are 不喜歡.

items.fallbackRepair: 除了 before the one left out, then 什麼 + noun, then 都 + what is true of the rest.

result.traditional: 除了史努比，我什麼卡通人物都不喜歡。
result.simplified: 除了史努比，我什么卡通人物都不喜欢。
result.pinyin: Chúle Shǐnǔbǐ, wǒ shénme kǎtōng rénwù dōu bù xǐhuān.
result.english: Apart from Snoopy, I don't like any cartoon character.

segments.traditional: 如果你去安養院，可以幫老人做什麼？
segments.simplified: 如果你去安养院，可以帮老人做什么？

repairs.note: 誰 stands for a person. What B can do for them is a thing: 什麼.
After 什麼, "anything" takes 都: 什麼都可以.

items.fallbackRepair: 除了 before the one thing left out, then 什麼, then 都: 除了做飯，我什麼都可以幫他們做.

result.traditional: 除了做飯，我什麼都可以幫他們做。
result.simplified: 除了做饭，我什么都可以帮他们做。
result.pinyin: Chúle zuòfàn, wǒ shénme dōu kěyǐ bāng tāmen zuò.
result.english: Apart from cooking, I can do anything for them.

summary: 除了 means except for. It names what is left out, and 都 comes in the second part.
After 除了 you can use a noun, a verb, or a state verb with no object.
The subject can go before 除了 or before 都.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: A Small Clerk? A Big Boss?
grammarPages.titleTraditional: NP₁ + 像／不像 + NP₂ + 那麼／這麼 + Vs
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Not as… as: 不像…那麼
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Compare one person or thing with another using a degree description.
grammarPages.pattern: NP₁ + 像／不像 + NP₂ + 那麼／這麼 + Vs
grammarPages.explanation: This pattern compares NP₁ and NP₂. “那麼” should be followed by an intransitive state verb with a higher degree. This pattern is similar to “NP₁ 有／沒有 NP₂ 那麼 Vs”.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern compares NP₁ and NP₂. “那麼” should be followed by an intransitive state verb with a higher degree. This pattern is similar to “NP₁ 有／沒有 NP₂ 那麼 Vs”.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern compares NP₁ and NP₂. “那麼” should be followed by an intransitive state verb with a higher degree. This pattern is similar to “NP₁ 有／沒有 NP₂ 那麼 Vs”.

text.traditional: 會話課的考試像翻譯課的（考試）那麼難嗎？
text.simplified: 会话课的考试像翻译课的（考试）那么难吗？
text.pinyin: Huìhuà kè de kǎoshì xiàng fānyì kè de (kǎoshì) nàme nán ma?
text.english: Is the conversation-class exam as difficult as the translation-class exam?

text.traditional: 弟弟的體力不像我這麼好，他在操場跑了十分鐘就累了。
text.simplified: 弟弟的体力不像我这么好，他在操场跑了十分钟就累了。
text.pinyin: Dìdi de tǐlì bú xiàng wǒ zhème hǎo, tā zài cāochǎng pǎo le shífēn zhōng jiù lèi le.
text.english: My younger brother’s stamina is not as good as mine; he gets tired after running on the track for ten minutes.

text.traditional: 黃先生是吉他老師，他的技巧很厲害，我不像他那麼專業。
text.simplified: 黄先生是吉他老师，他的技巧很厉害，我不像他那么专业。
text.pinyin: Huáng xiānshēng shì jítā lǎoshī, tā de jìqiǎo hěn lìhài, wǒ bú xiàng tā nàme zhuānyè.
text.english: Mr. Huang is a guitar teacher, and his technique is impressive. I am not as professional as he is.

practice.title: Say it in one sentence with 像／不像……那麼……

segments.traditional: 哥哥有 185 公分高，我只有 168 公分。

repairs.note: The brother is the taller one, so the sentence starts from the speaker: 我不像哥哥那麼高.
The speaker is 168 and the brother is 185, so the speaker is not as tall: 不像.
After the person compared with comes 那麼, not 很: 不像哥哥那麼高.

items.fallbackRepair: The speaker first, then 不像 + the other person + 那麼 + the quality: 我不像哥哥那麼高.

result.traditional: 我不像哥哥那麼高。
result.simplified: 我不像哥哥那么高。
result.pinyin: Wǒ bú xiàng gēge nàme gāo.
result.english: I am not as tall as my older brother.

segments.traditional: 台北的夏天差不多 35.5°C，高雄的夏天差不多 35°C。

repairs.note: Start with 高雄的夏天. 台北的 (short for 台北的夏天) comes after 像 or 不像.
Both cities are around 35°C in summer, so the quality being compared is heat: 熱.
After the thing compared with comes 那麼, not 很.

items.fallbackRepair: 高雄的夏天 first, then 像 or 不像 + 台北的 + 那麼 + the quality.

result.traditional: 高雄的夏天不像台北的那麼熱。
result.simplified: 高雄的夏天不像台北的那么热。
result.pinyin: Gāoxióng de xiàtiān bú xiàng Táiběi de nàme rè.
result.english: Summer in Kaohsiung is not as hot as in Taipei.

alternatives.traditional: 高雄的夏天像台北的那麼熱。
alternatives.simplified: 高雄的夏天像台北的那么热。
alternatives.pinyin: Gāoxióng de xiàtiān xiàng Táiběi de nàme rè.
alternatives.english: Summer in Kaohsiung is as hot as in Taipei.

segments.traditional: 我每天工作到五點就下班，他每天忙到晚上十點才回家。
segments.simplified: 我每天工作到五点就下班，他每天忙到晚上十点才回家。

repairs.note: He is the busier one, so the sentence starts from the speaker: 我不像他那麼忙.
The speaker leaves at five and he works until ten, so the speaker is not as busy: 不像.
After the person compared with comes 那麼, not 很: 不像他那麼忙.

items.fallbackRepair: The speaker first, then 不像 + the other person + 那麼 + the quality: 我不像他那麼忙.

result.traditional: 我不像他那麼忙。
result.simplified: 我不像他那么忙。
result.pinyin: Wǒ bú xiàng tā nàme máng.
result.english: I am not as busy as he is.

summary: 像 or 不像 compares the first thing with the second. 不像 says the first is not as much as the second.
After 那麼 or 這麼 comes a state verb that shows degree.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: A Small Clerk? A Big Boss?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Mark when an action or situation begins and what follows from that point.
grammarPages.pattern: （S）（+ 從）+ Time／VP + 起，（S）就……
grammarPages.explanation: This pattern is used to indicate something which begins with a point in time. “起” serves as a verb here and means “to begin”. “從” is often followed by time words or verb phrases, e.g., “從下個月起” and “從開始學中文起”. Besides, “就” is often used at the beginning of the latter clause to imply an action is going to occur. In this pattern, “從” can be omitted. The subject can be placed in the beginning of the sentence or the second clause.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern is used to indicate something which begins with a point in time. “起” serves as a verb here and means “to begin”. “從” is often followed by time words or verb phrases, e.g., “從下個月起” and “從開始學中文起”. Besides, “就” is often used at the beginning of the latter clause to imply an action is going to occur. In this pattern, “從” can be omitted. The subject can be placed in the beginning of the sentence or the second clause.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern is used to indicate something which begins with a point in time. “起” serves as a verb here and means “to begin”. “從” is often followed by time words or verb phrases, e.g., “從下個月起” and “從開始學中文起”. Besides, “就” is often used at the beginning of the latter clause to imply an action is going to occur. In this pattern, “從” can be omitted. The subject can be placed in the beginning of the sentence or the second clause.

text.traditional: 從明天起，他就要天天早起去慢跑。
text.simplified: 从明天起，他就要天天早起去慢跑。
text.pinyin: Cóng míngtiān qǐ, tā jiùyào tiāntiān zǎo qǐ qù mànpǎo.
text.english: Starting tomorrow, he will get up early to jog every day.

text.traditional: 姐姐從學會開車起，就自己開車去上班了。
text.simplified: 姐姐从学会开车起，就自己开车去上班了。
text.pinyin: Jiějie cóng xuéhuì kāichē qǐ, jiù zìjǐ kāichē qù shàngbān le.
text.english: As soon as my older sister learned to drive, she started driving herself to work.

text.traditional: 為了身體健康，（從）明天起，我就不吃太甜、太油的食物了。
text.simplified: 为了身体健康，（从）明天起，我就不吃太甜、太油的食物了。
text.pinyin: Wèile shēntǐ jiànkāng, (cóng) míngtiān qǐ, wǒ jiù bù chī tài tián, tài yóu de shíwù le.
text.english: For my health, starting tomorrow I will stop eating food that is too sweet or greasy.

segments.traditional: 敢一個人走路去上學了。
segments.simplified: 敢一个人走路去上学了。

repairs.note: 到 marks where a stretch ends. The point where something starts is 從…起.
The child is brave and did it early, so the result takes 就, not 才.

items.fallbackRepair: 從 + the starting point + 起, then 就 + what has been true since.

result.traditional: 那個孩子很勇敢，從六歲起，就敢一個人走路去上學了。
result.simplified: 那个孩子很勇敢，从六岁起，就敢一个人走路去上学了。
result.pinyin: Nàge háizi hěn yǒnggǎn, cóng liù suì qǐ, jiù gǎn yígerén zǒulù qù shàngxué le.
result.english: That child is very brave; since the age of six, the child has dared to walk to school alone.

segments.traditional: 我找到工作了，下個月五號起，
segments.simplified: 我找到工作了，下个月五号起，

repairs.note: The new job starts on that date, so what follows takes 就, not 才.
The speaker has just found a job, so what starts on the fifth is going to work, not retiring.

items.fallbackRepair: The date + 起, then 就 + what starts then: 下個月五號起，我就要上班了.

result.traditional: 我找到工作了，下個月五號起，我就要上班了。
result.simplified: 我找到工作了，下个月五号起，我就要上班了。
result.pinyin: Wǒ zhǎodào gōngzuò le, xià ge yuè wǔ hào qǐ, wǒ jiù yào shàngbān le.
result.english: I found a job; starting from the fifth of next month, I'll be going to work.

repairs.note: 到 marks where a stretch ends. The point where something starts is 從…起.
She stopped right from that day, so the result takes 就, not 才.
的時候 says when one thing happens. "Ever since that day" is 從…起.

items.fallbackRepair: 從 + the starting point + 起, then 就 + what has been true since.

result.traditional: 陳小姐從結婚那天起，就不上班了。
result.simplified: 陈小姐从结婚那天起，就不上班了。
result.pinyin: Chén xiǎojiě cóng jiéhūn nà tiān qǐ, jiù bú shàngbān le.
result.english: Ever since the day she got married, Miss Chen has not gone to work.

summary: This pattern says something starts from a certain time or action. 起 means begin.
從 often goes before a time word or verb phrase, and it can be left out.
就 often starts the second part. The subject can go at the start or in the second part.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: A Small Clerk? A Big Boss?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 向 before a person to mark the recipient of an action; it is more formal and respectful than 跟.
grammarPages.pattern: 向 + N／NP + V……
grammarPages.explanation: “向” can be used as a preposition that shows the direction of an action, e.g., “向前走”. If followed by a person, it indicates the object of an action. This pattern is more formal, polite and respectful than the pattern “跟+N/NP+V”.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: “向” can be used as a preposition that shows the direction of an action, e.g., “向前走”. If followed by a person, it indicates the object of an action. This pattern is more formal, polite and respectful than the pattern “跟+N/NP+V”.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “向” can be used as a preposition that shows the direction of an action, e.g., “向前走”. If followed by a person, it indicates the object of an action. This pattern is more formal, polite and respectful than the pattern “跟+N/NP+V”.

text.traditional: 餐廳的老闆向客人介紹那個義大利菜。
text.simplified: 餐厅的老板向客人介绍那个义大利菜。
text.pinyin: Cāntīng de lǎobǎn xiàng kèrén jièshào nàge Yìdàlì cài.
text.english: The restaurant owner introduces that Italian dish to the customers.

text.traditional: 這個研究計畫有問題，我應該向教授報告。
text.simplified: 这个研究计划有问题，我应该向教授报告。
text.pinyin: Zhège yánjiù jìhuà yǒu wèntí, wǒ yīnggāi xiàng jiàoshòu bàogào.
text.english: There is a problem with this research project; I should report it to the professor.

text.traditional: 那個學生很認真，成績也很好，我們都應該向他學習。
text.simplified: 那个学生很认真，成绩也很好，我们都应该向他学习。
text.pinyin: Nàge xuéshēng hěn rènzhēn, chéngjī yě hěn hǎo, wǒmen dōu yīnggāi xiàng tā xuéxí.
text.english: That student is diligent and gets good grades; we should all learn from him.

repairs.note: 給 hands something to someone. Here the teacher is marked with 向: 向老師說對不起.
在 marks a place. Here the teacher is marked with 向: 向老師說對不起.
問 asks a question. An apology is said: 說對不起.

items.fallbackRepair: 向 first, then the person, then the action: 向老師說對不起.

result.traditional: 我上課遲到了，應該向老師說對不起。
result.simplified: 我上课迟到了，应该向老师说对不起。
result.pinyin: Wǒ shàngkè chídào le, yīnggāi xiàng lǎoshī shuō duìbùqǐ.
result.english: I was late for class; I should say sorry to the teacher.

repairs.note: 給 hands something to someone. The one you borrow from takes 向.
To buy a house he needs money, so he borrows it: 借.
A library lends books, not money. Money for a house comes from a bank.

items.fallbackRepair: 向 first, then whom, then the action: 向銀行借了很多錢.

result.traditional: 他為了買房子，向銀行借了很多錢。
result.simplified: 他为了买房子，向银行借了很多钱。
result.pinyin: Tā wèile mǎi fángzi, xiàng yínháng jiè le hěn duō qián.
result.english: In order to buy a house, he borrowed a lot of money from the bank.

segments.traditional: 如果你很喜歡那個女孩子，你會怎麼做？
segments.simplified: 如果你很喜欢那个女孩子，你会怎么做？

repairs.note: 給 hands something to someone. Here she is marked with 向: 向她表達我的愛.
告訴 takes the person straight after it (告訴她), with no 向. With 向 the verb is 表達.
在 marks a place. Here she is marked with 向: 向她表達我的愛.

items.fallbackRepair: 向 first, then the person, then the action: 向她表達我的愛.

result.traditional: 我會送她玫瑰花，向她表達我的愛。
result.simplified: 我会送她玫瑰花，向她表达我的爱。
result.pinyin: Wǒ huì sòng tā méiguīhuā, xiàng tā biǎodá wǒ de ài.
result.english: I would give her roses and express my love to her.

summary: 向 can show the direction of an action. Before a person, it shows who the action is aimed at.
Compared with 跟, 向 sounds more formal, polite and respectful.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: A Small Clerk? A Big Boss?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Link a known fact to the conclusion it makes unsurprising.
grammarPages.pattern: Reason or known fact + 難怪 + result
grammarPages.explanation: Before “難怪”, there is usually an existing fact stated and unlikely to change, so no need to feel surprised. “難怪” is often followed by verb phrases. Sometimes when used in a conversation, the listener will be a little surprised after understanding a stated fact or reason.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Before “難怪”, there is usually an existing fact stated and unlikely to change, so no need to feel surprised. “難怪” is often followed by verb phrases. Sometimes when used in a conversation, the listener will be a little surprised after understanding a stated fact or reason.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: Before “難怪”, there is usually an existing fact stated and unlikely to change, so no need to feel surprised. “難怪” is often followed by verb phrases. Sometimes when used in a conversation, the listener will be a little surprised after understanding a stated fact or reason.

text.traditional: 他喝了太多酒，難怪身體不舒服。
text.simplified: 他喝了太多酒，难怪身体不舒服。
text.pinyin: Tā hē le tài duō jiǔ, nánguài shēntǐ bù shūfu.
text.english: He drank too much alcohol; no wonder he feels unwell.

text.traditional: 那個美國人在中國住了五年，難怪中文說得那麼好。
text.simplified: 那个美国人在中国住了五年，难怪中文说得那么好。
text.pinyin: Nàge Měiguó rén zài Zhōngguó zhù le wǔ nián, nánguài Zhōngwén shuō de nàme hǎo.
text.english: That American lived in China for five years; no wonder they speak Chinese so well.

text.traditional: 同事 A：經理說他感冒了，昨天晚上不但發燒，還一直咳嗽。同事 B：難怪他今天上班的時候，一直戴著口罩。
text.simplified: 同事 A：经理说他感冒了，昨天晚上不但发烧，还一直咳嗽。同事 B：难怪他今天上班的时候，一直戴着口罩。
text.pinyin: Tóngshì A: Jīnglǐ shuō tā gǎnmào le, zuótiān wǎnshàng búdàn fāshāo, hái yìzhí késòu. Tóngshì B: Nánguài tā jīntiān shàngbān de shíhòu, yìzhí dài zhe kǒuzhào.
text.english: Coworker A: The manager said he has a cold. Last night he not only had a fever, but also kept coughing. Coworker B: No wonder he kept wearing a mask at work today.

repairs.note: He was sick last night, so what is no surprise is that he stayed away: 沒來.
奇怪 means something is strange. "No wonder" is the opposite: 難怪.
難過 means sad. "No wonder" is 難怪.
Being sick explains his absence. Nothing turns, so it is 難怪, not 可是.

items.fallbackRepair: 難怪 before what is now explained: 難怪今天沒來上班.

result.traditional: 他昨天晚上拉肚子，難怪今天沒來上班。
result.simplified: 他昨天晚上拉肚子，难怪今天没来上班。
result.pinyin: Tā zuótiān wǎnshàng lādùzi, nánguài jīntiān méi lái shàngbān.
result.english: He had diarrhea last night; no wonder he didn't come to work today.

segments.traditional: 下個禮拜我有一場很重要的球賽，一定要贏。
segments.simplified: 下个礼拜我有一场很重要的球赛，一定要赢。

repairs.note: B adds 週末也不休息, so every day A is practicing, not resting.
奇怪 means something is strange. B now understands why: 難怪.
A has just given the reason. B reacts to it with "no wonder": 難怪.
如果 sets up an "if". B is reacting to a fact: 難怪.

items.fallbackRepair: 難怪 before what is now explained: 難怪你每天都在練習.

result.traditional: 難怪你每天都在練習，週末也不休息。
result.simplified: 难怪你每天都在练习，周末也不休息。
result.pinyin: Nánguài nǐ měitiān dōu zài liànxí, zhōumò yě bù xiūxí.
result.english: No wonder you practice every day and don't even rest on weekends.

segments.traditional: 張教授不但知識豐富，他教的專業課程也都很有意思。
segments.simplified: 张教授不但知识丰富，他教的专业课程也都很有意思。

repairs.note: A says his courses are interesting, so it is no wonder students like them.
奇怪 means something is strange. B now understands why: 難怪.
All the students like his classes, so this takes 都.

items.fallbackRepair: 難怪 first, then 都 before the verb: 難怪學生都喜歡上他的課.

result.traditional: 難怪學生都喜歡上他的課。
result.simplified: 难怪学生都喜欢上他的课。
result.pinyin: Nánguài xuéshēng dōu xǐhuān shàng tā de kè.
result.english: No wonder the students all like taking his classes.

summary: 難怪 says a result is no surprise, now that you know the reason.
The known fact usually comes first, then 難怪 and the result.
A verb phrase often follows 難怪, and it can also start a reply in conversation.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: A Small Clerk? A Big Boss?
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Can or Can’t Manage: V得了／V不了
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say whether someone can accomplish an action or achieve a result.
grammarPages.pattern: V + 得了／不了（+ O）
grammarPages.explanation: The pattern “V 得了” shows one’s ability to achieve something or cause a certain result. Its negative form is “V 不了”. The verbs used in this pattern are often monosyllabic, such as “吃（eat）”, “忘（forget）”, “拿（take）”, “做（do）”, “到（reach）”, “管（manage）”, etc. This pattern is different from “V 了”. The former shows likelihood, while the latter implies that something has been done, e.g., “吃了” and “做了”.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The pattern “V 得了” shows one’s ability to achieve something or cause a certain result. Its negative form is “V 不了”. The verbs used in this pattern are often monosyllabic, such as “吃（eat）”, “忘（forget）”, “拿（take）”, “做（do）”, “到（reach）”, “管（manage）”, etc. This pattern is different from “V 了”. The former shows likelihood, while the latter implies that something has been done, e.g., “吃了” and “做了”.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The pattern “V 得了” shows one’s ability to achieve something or cause a certain result. Its negative form is “V 不了”. The verbs used in this pattern are often monosyllabic, such as “吃（eat）”, “忘（forget）”, “拿（take）”, “做（do）”, “到（reach）”, “管（manage）”, etc. This pattern is different from “V 了”. The former shows likelihood, while the latter implies that something has been done, e.g., “吃了” and “做了”.

text.traditional: 你買了這麼多東西，一個人拿得了嗎？
text.simplified: 你买了这么多东西，一个人拿得了吗？
text.pinyin: Nǐ mǎi le zhème duō dōngxi, yígerén ná de liǎo ma?
text.english: You bought so many things. Can one person carry them all?

text.traditional: 我們只有三個人，吃不了這麼多菜。
text.simplified: 我们只有三个人，吃不了这么多菜。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen zhǐyǒu sān ge rén, chī bùliǎo zhème duō cài.
text.english: There are only three of us; we can’t eat this many dishes.

text.traditional: 媽媽一個人做不了那麼多家事，所以我的房間自己打掃。
text.simplified: 妈妈一个人做不了那么多家事，所以我的房间自己打扫。
text.pinyin: Māma yígerén zuò bùliǎo nàme duō jiāshì, suǒyǐ wǒ de fángjiān zìjǐ dǎsǎo.
text.english: Mom can’t do so many chores alone, so I clean my own room.

segments.traditional: 你不運動，三餐又吃得那麼多，體重當然減
segments.simplified: 你不运动，三餐又吃得那么多，体重当然减

repairs.note: No exercise and big meals mean the weight cannot come down: 減不了.
V不完 is not being able to finish all of something. Not being able to do it at all is V不了.

items.fallbackRepair: After the verb comes 不, then 了: 減不了.

result.traditional: 你不運動，三餐又吃得那麼多，體重當然減不了。
result.simplified: 你不运动，三餐又吃得那么多，体重当然减不了。
result.pinyin: Nǐ bú yùndòng, sāncān yòu chī de nàme duō, tǐzhòng dāngrán jiǎnbùliǎo.
result.english: You don't exercise and you eat so much at every meal; of course you can't lose weight.

segments.traditional: 從台灣坐飛機到越南去，兩個小時
segments.simplified: 从台湾坐飞机到越南去，两个小时

repairs.note: V得完 is being able to finish all of something. Being able to get there is 到得了.
V得下 is about having enough room. Being able to get there is 到得了.

items.fallbackRepair: The verb, then 得, then 了: 到得了.

result.traditional: 從台灣坐飛機到越南去，兩個小時到得了嗎？
result.simplified: 从台湾坐飞机到越南去，两个小时到得了吗？
result.pinyin: Cóng Táiwān zuò fēijī dào Yuènán qù, liǎng ge xiǎoshí dàodeliǎo ma?
result.english: Flying from Taiwan to Vietnam, can you get there in two hours?

segments.traditional: 第一次跟女朋友約會的經驗。
segments.simplified: 第一次跟女朋友约会的经验。

repairs.note: A first date stays in the mind: he cannot forget it. That is 忘不了.
V不下 is about not having enough room. Not being able to forget is 忘不了.
V不完 is not being able to finish all of something. Not being able to forget is 忘不了.

items.fallbackRepair: The verb, then 不, then 了: 忘不了.

result.traditional: 王先生忘不了第一次跟女朋友約會的經驗。
result.simplified: 王先生忘不了第一次跟女朋友约会的经验。
result.pinyin: Wáng xiānshēng wàngbùliǎo dì yī cì gēn nǚpéngyǒu yuēhuì de jīngyàn.
result.english: Mr. Wang can't forget his first date with his girlfriend.

summary: V得了 says you can do the action or reach the result. The negative is V不了.
It often goes with a verb of one syllable.
It is about being able to do it. V了 is different, because it says the action is done.

items.title: Grammar 7–8 · A Small Clerk? A Big Boss?

dialogue.title: 短文 · 自我推薦 · A Letter of Self-Recommendation

text.traditional: 李老闆：
text.simplified: 李老板：
text.pinyin: Lǐ lǎobǎn:
text.english: Dear Mr. Li,

text.traditional: 您好，我是陳可欣，今年二十一歲，是大學日文系的學生。父親在高中教書，母親是鐵路局的員工，哥哥在貿易公司上班。我是家裡最小的孩子，可是我知道怎麼照顧自己，不讓父母擔心。
text.simplified: 您好，我是陈可欣，今年二十一岁，是大学日文系的学生。父亲在高中教书，母亲是铁路局的员工，哥哥在贸易公司上班。我是家里最小的孩子，可是我知道怎么照顾自己，不让父母担心。
text.pinyin: Nín hǎo, wǒ shì Chén Kěxīn, jīnnián èrshíyī suì, shì dàxué Rìwén xì de xuéshēng. Fùqīn zài gāozhōng jiāoshū, mǔqīn shì Tiělùjú de yuángōng, gēge zài màoyì gōngsī shàngbān. Wǒ shì jiālǐ zuì xiǎo de háizi, kěshì wǒ zhīdào zěnme zhàogù zìjǐ, bú ràng fùmǔ dānxīn.
text.english: I am Kexin Chen, 21 years old. I am a university student in the Department of Japanese Language. My father teaches in a senior high school, my mother is an employee in the Railways Administration, and my elder brother works in a trading company. I am the youngest in my family, but I know how to take care of myself, so I don’t let my parents worry about me.

text.traditional: 這個暑假，您要找人到鄉下的花園去種花、剪草。我不喜歡都市緊張的生活，也不習慣天天穿著襯衫，坐在辦公室裡打電腦。鄉下環境好、空氣新鮮，如果能在花園打工，不但可以認識很多植物，休息的時候，還可以坐在草地上喝個茶、聽個音樂。這樣的生活，一定會讓我很開心的。
text.simplified: 这个暑假，您要找人到乡下的花园去种花、剪草。我不喜欢都市紧张的生活，也不习惯天天穿着衬衫，坐在办公室里打电脑。乡下环境好、空气新鲜，如果能在花园打工，不但可以认识很多植物，休息的时候，还可以坐在草地上喝个茶、听个音乐。这样的生活，一定会让我很开心的。
text.pinyin: Zhège shǔjià, nín yào zhǎo rén dào xiāngxià de huāyuán qù zhòng huā, jiǎn cǎo. Wǒ bù xǐhuān dūshì jǐnzhāng de shēnghuó, yě bù xíguàn tiāntiān chuān zhe chènshān, zuò zài bàngōngshì lǐ dǎ diànnǎo. Xiāngxià huánjìng hǎo, kōngqì xīnxiān, rúguǒ néng zài huāyuán dǎgōng, búdàn kěyǐ rènshì hěn duō zhíwù, xiūxí de shíhòu, hái kěyǐ zuò zài cǎodì shàng hē ge chá, tīng ge yīnyuè. Zhèyàng de shēnghuó, yídìng huì ràng wǒ hěn kāixīn de.
text.english: This summer vacation, you are looking for people who will grow flowers and trim the lawn in a countryside garden. I don’t like stressful urban life, and I am not used to wearing a shirt every day or sitting in an office using a computer. In the countryside the environment is good, and the air is fresh. If I can work part-time in a garden, I can not only know many plants, but also sit on the grass drinking tea or listen to some music during the breaks. This kind of life will certainly make me happy!

text.traditional: 我現在沒有正式的職業，可是我知道打工的經驗很重要，能讓我有不少的收穫。比如說，可以存一點兒學費，學習做事的方法，讓自己的想法更成熟、工作能力更強。大二時，我為了加強日文的會話能力，就去當教授的助理；也做過日本餐廳的服務生、去工廠打過工。洗碗、打掃或是搬重的東西，我都自己來。有時候工作到夜裡兩、三點才回家，我也不害怕。
text.simplified: 我现在没有正式的职业，可是我知道打工的经验很重要，能让我有不少的收获。比如说，可以存一点儿学费，学习做事的方法，让自己的想法更成熟、工作能力更强。大二时，我为了加强日文的会话能力，就去当教授的助理；也做过日本餐厅的服务生、去工厂打过工。洗碗、打扫或是搬重的东西，我都自己来。有时候工作到夜里两、三点才回家，我也不害怕。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài méiyǒu zhèngshì de zhíyè, kěshì wǒ zhīdào dǎgōng de jīngyàn hěn zhòngyào, néng ràng wǒ yǒu bùshǎo de shōuhuò. Bǐrú shuō, kěyǐ cún yìdiǎnr xuéfèi, xuéxí zuòshì de fāngfǎ, ràng zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ gèng chéngshú, gōngzuò nénglì gèng qiáng. Dà èr shí, wǒ wèile jiāqiáng Rìwén de huìhuà nénglì, jiù qù dāng jiàoshòu de zhùlǐ; yě zuò guo Rìběn cāntīng de fúwùshēng, qù gōngchǎng dǎ guo gōng. Xǐwǎn, dǎsǎo huòshì bān zhòng de dōngxi, wǒ dōu zìjǐ lái. Yǒushíhòu gōngzuò dào yèlǐ liǎng, sān diǎn cái huí jiā, wǒ yě bú hàipà.
text.english: I don’t have a formal job now, but I know that part-time working experience is very important, and it benefits me a lot. For example, I can save some money for the tuition, learn how to do some tasks, and become more mature in thinking and have stronger working ability. In my sophomore year, in order to improve my Japanese conversation ability, I worked as a professor’s assistant. I also worked as a waitress in a Japanese restaurant. I did all tasks such as doing dishes, cleaning, or moving heavy objects by myself. Sometimes I worked until 2 or 3 a.m. before going back home, but I wasn’t afraid, either.

text.traditional: 我是一個很樂觀的人，也相信有能力把您的花園照顧好，所以向您推薦我自己，請給我這個工作機會。從現在起，我的手機二十四小時都開著，有好消息的話，請隨時通知我，非常謝謝您！
text.simplified: 我是一个很乐观的人，也相信有能力把您的花园照顾好，所以向您推荐我自己，请给我这个工作机会。从现在起，我的手机二十四小时都开着，有好消息的话，请随时通知我，非常谢谢您！
text.pinyin: Wǒ shì yíge hěn lèguān de rén, yě xiāngxìn yǒu nénglì bǎ nín de huāyuán zhàogù hǎo, suǒyǐ xiàng nín tuījiàn wǒ zìjǐ, qǐng gěi wǒ zhège gōngzuò jīhuì. Cóng xiànzài qǐ, wǒ de shǒujī èrshísì xiǎoshí dōu kāi zhe, yǒu hǎo xiāoxí dehuà, qǐng suíshí tōngzhī wǒ, fēicháng xièxie nín!
text.english: I am a very optimistic person. I believe I have the ability to take good care of your garden. Therefore, I recommend myself to you. Please give me this job opportunity. From now on, you can reach me on my phone 24 hours a day. If you have any good news, please inform me any time. Thank you very much!

text.traditional: 陳可欣　敬上
text.simplified: 陈可欣敬上
text.pinyin: Chén Kěxīn jìngshàng
text.english: Sincerely, Kexin Chen

text.traditional: 5 月 21 日
text.simplified: 5 月 21 日
text.pinyin: 5 yuè 21 rì
text.english: May 21st

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: A Small Clerk? A Big Boss?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 個 after a verb to make an action sound brief, casual, or easy.
grammarPages.pattern: V + 個 + N（O）
grammarPages.explanation: In this pattern, “個” serves as a particle showing that an action only lasts for a short time or something is done in a relaxing and easy manner. Verb-object separable words are often used in this pattern, such as “喝個茶”, “唱個歌”, “跳個舞”, etc.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: In this pattern, “個” serves as a particle showing that an action only lasts for a short time or something is done in a relaxing and easy manner. Verb-object separable words are often used in this pattern, such as “喝個茶”, “唱個歌”, “跳個舞”, etc.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: In this pattern, “個” serves as a particle showing that an action only lasts for a short time or something is done in a relaxing and easy manner. Verb-object separable words are often used in this pattern, such as “喝個茶”, “唱個歌”, “跳個舞”, etc.

text.traditional: 我覺得洗個碗、倒個垃圾都是很簡單的家事。
text.simplified: 我觉得洗个碗、倒个垃圾都是很简单的家事。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde xǐ ge wǎn, dào ge lèsè dōu shì hěn jiǎndān de jiāshì.
text.english: I think washing a few dishes and taking out the trash are both very simple chores.

text.traditional: 爸爸每天下班回家，都先看個電視再吃晚飯。
text.simplified: 爸爸每天下班回家，都先看个电视再吃晚饭。
text.pinyin: Bàba měitiān xiàbān huí jiā, dōu xiān kàn ge diànshì zài chī wǎnfàn.
text.english: When Dad comes home from work each day, he watches a little TV before dinner.

text.traditional: 這個週末我想先去 KTV 唱個歌，再去看個電影，輕鬆一下。
text.simplified: 这个周末我想先去 KTV 唱个歌，再去看个电影，轻松一下。
text.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōumò wǒ xiǎng xiān qù KTV chàng ge gē, zài qù kàn ge diànyǐng, qīngsōng yíxià.
text.english: This weekend I want to go to KTV first for a bit of singing, then catch a movie and relax a little.

segments.traditional: 今天天氣很好，你會跟朋友說什麼？
segments.simplified: 今天天气很好，你会跟朋友说什么？

repairs.note: A light, relaxed action puts 個 between the two halves of the verb: 散個步.
散步 splits into 散 and 步: 散個步. 走 is not part of it.
位 counts people. The light, relaxed 個 goes inside the verb: 散個步.

items.fallbackRepair: 個 goes between the two halves of 散步: 散個步.

result.traditional: 我們去公園散個步吧！
result.simplified: 我们去公园散个步吧！
result.pinyin: Wǒmen qù gōngyuán sàn ge bù ba!
result.english: Let's go take a walk in the park!

segments.traditional: 室友覺得頭很痛，可是他想去上課，你會跟他說什麼？
segments.simplified: 室友觉得头很痛，可是他想去上课，你会跟他说什么？

repairs.note: 生病 is getting sick, and he is sick already. What he should do first is see a doctor: 看病.
A light, quick action puts 個 between the two halves of the verb: 看個病.
位 counts people. The light 個 goes inside the verb: 看個病.

items.fallbackRepair: 個 goes between the two halves of 看病: 看個病.

result.traditional: 你先看個病再去上課吧。
result.simplified: 你先看个病再去上课吧。
result.pinyin: Nǐ xiān kàn ge bìng zài qù shàngkè ba.
result.english: See a doctor first and then go to class.

segments.traditional: 朋友去你家，他要走的時候已經晚上六點了，你會跟他說什麼？
segments.simplified: 朋友去你家，他要走的时候已经晚上六点了，你会跟他说什么？

repairs.note: A suggestion to do one thing and then another takes 再: 吃個飯再走吧.
A light, relaxed action puts 個 between the verb and its object: 吃個飯.

items.fallbackRepair: 個 goes between 吃 and 飯, and 再 comes before 走: 吃個飯再走吧.

result.traditional: 吃個飯再走吧！
result.simplified: 吃个饭再走吧！
result.pinyin: Chī ge fàn zài zǒu ba!
result.english: Have a meal before you go!

summary: 個 after a verb makes the action sound short, relaxed or easy.
Words made of a verb and its object often use this form, such as 喝個茶.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: A Small Clerk? A Big Boss?
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Letting Someone Do It: N 來 V
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 來 to stand for a known action, or let someone else handle a task.
grammarPages.pattern: N／NP + 來（+ V）
grammarPages.explanation: In this pattern, “來” refers to an omitted verb and is often used when there is a specific action, e.g., “我來做” and “我來幫忙”. If the dialogue responds with “自己來”, it indicates that the speaker doesn’t want to bother the other person. It is a polite statement.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: In this pattern, “來” refers to an omitted verb and is often used when there is a specific action, e.g., “我來做” and “我來幫忙”. If the dialogue responds with “自己來”, it indicates that the speaker doesn’t want to bother the other person. It is a polite statement.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: In this pattern, “來” refers to an omitted verb and is often used when there is a specific action, e.g., “我來做” and “我來幫忙”. If the dialogue responds with “自己來”, it indicates that the speaker doesn’t want to bother the other person. It is a polite statement.

text.traditional: 我做了很多菜，你想吃什麼，自己來，別客氣。
text.simplified: 我做了很多菜，你想吃什么，自己来，别客气。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zuò le hěn duō cài, nǐ xiǎng chī shénme, zìjǐ lái, bié kèqì.
text.english: I made a lot of dishes. Help yourself to whatever you want; don’t be shy.

text.traditional: 上網訂票、找資料、寫報告，這些事情李老闆都讓助理來。
text.simplified: 上网订票、找资料、写报告，这些事情李老板都让助理来。
text.pinyin: Shàngwǎng dìng piào, zhǎo zīliào, xiě bàogào, zhèxiē shìqíng Lǐ lǎobǎn dōu ràng zhùlǐ lái.
text.english: For booking tickets online, finding information, and writing reports, Mr. Li has his assistant handle all those things.

text.traditional: A：像洗碗、打掃房間這樣的事，那個孩子都做不好。B：他才五歲，這些事最好讓父母來（做）。
text.simplified: A：像洗碗、打扫房间这样的事，那个孩子都做不好。B：他才五岁，这些事最好让父母来（做）。
text.pinyin: A: Xiàng xǐwǎn, dǎsǎo fángjiān zhèyàng de shì, nàge háizi dōu zuò bùhǎo. B: Tā cái wǔ suì, zhèxiē shì zuìhǎo ràng fùmǔ lái (zuò).
text.english: A: The child cannot do things like washing dishes and cleaning the room well. B: He is only five; it’s best to let his parents do those things.

segments.traditional: 我要做晚飯了，你想吃什麼？
segments.simplified: 我要做晚饭了，你想吃什么？

segments.traditional: 你不舒服，快去休息吧。晚餐

repairs.note: She is unwell and should rest, so the husband takes over: 我來做.
She was about to cook dinner. He offers to do the cooking: 做.

items.fallbackRepair: Who takes over, then 來, then the action: 我來做.

result.traditional: 你不舒服，快去休息吧。晚餐我來做。
result.simplified: 你不舒服，快去休息吧。晚餐我来做。
result.pinyin: Nǐ bù shūfu, kuài qù xiūxí ba. Wǎncān wǒ lái zuò.
result.english: You're not feeling well; go and rest. I'll make dinner.

segments.traditional: 你看到朋友手裡拿了很多東西，沒辦法開門，你會說什麼？
segments.simplified: 你看到朋友手里拿了很多东西，没办法开门，你会说什么？

repairs.note: The friend's hands are full, so the speaker offers to do it: 我來.
The friend cannot open the door, so the help needed is opening it: 開門.

items.fallbackRepair: Who takes over, then 來, then the action: 我來開門.

result.traditional: 我來開門吧！
result.simplified: 我来开门吧！
result.pinyin: Wǒ lái kāimén ba!
result.english: Let me open the door!

segments.traditional: 服務生很忙，沒幫客人倒水，如果你是客人，你會說什麼？
segments.simplified: 服务生很忙，没帮客人倒水，如果你是客人，你会说什么？

repairs.note: The customer does not want to trouble the busy waiter, so it is the customer who does it: 我自己來.
The customer is not leaving. Offering to pour the water oneself is 我自己來.
The customer offers to do it personally: 我自己來.

items.fallbackRepair: Who, then 自己, then 來: 我自己來.

result.traditional: 沒關係，我自己來。
result.simplified: 没关系，我自己来。
result.pinyin: Méiguānxi, wǒ zìjǐ lái.
result.english: It's all right, I'll help myself.

summary: 來 stands in for an action that is already clear from the context, often a specific one.
自己來 is a polite way to say you don't want to trouble someone else.

items.title: Grammar 1–3 · I Want to Buy a Laptop

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Buy a Laptop
grammarPages.titleEnglish: No Matter What with 不管…都…
grammarPages.learnerPromise: State a result that stays true under every condition.
grammarPages.pattern: 不管 + question/condition，(subject) + 都 + unchanged result
grammarPages.explanation: This pattern indicates in every possible condition, the stated situation in the latter part of the sentence will not change. “不管” is followed by possible conditions, and “都” is followed by the situation that will remain unchanged. Besides, the sentence following “不管” is an interrogative sentence, which can be Wh-Question, A-not-A Question, Alternative Question, and two opposite monosyllabic words.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern indicates in every possible condition, the stated situation in the latter part of the sentence will not change. “不管” is followed by possible conditions, and “都” is followed by the situation that will remain unchanged. Besides, the sentence following “不管” is an interrogative sentence, which can be Wh-Question, A-not-A Question, Alternative Question, and two opposite monosyllabic words.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern indicates in every possible condition, the stated situation in the latter part of the sentence will not change. “不管” is followed by possible conditions, and “都” is followed by the situation that will remain unchanged. Besides, the sentence following “不管” is an interrogative sentence, which can be Wh-Question, A-not-A Question, Alternative Question, and two opposite monosyllabic words.

text.traditional: 不管這支手機貴不貴，我都要買。
text.simplified: 不管这支手机贵不贵，我都要买。
text.pinyin: Bùguǎn zhè zhī shǒujī guì bú guì, wǒ dōu yào mǎi.
text.english: No matter whether this phone is expensive, I still want to buy it.

text.traditional: 不管看什麼電影，我都喜歡跟朋友一起看。
text.simplified: 不管看什么电影，我都喜欢跟朋友一起看。
text.pinyin: Bùguǎn kàn shénme diànyǐng, wǒ dōu xǐhuān gēn péngyǒu yìqǐ kàn.
text.english: No matter what movie it is, I like watching it with friends.

text.traditional: 這個城市交通便利，不管搭公車還是火車都很方便。
text.simplified: 这个城市交通便利，不管搭公车还是火车都很方便。
text.pinyin: Zhè ge chéngshì jiāotōng biànlì, bùguǎn dā gōngchē háishì huǒchē dōu hěn fāngbiàn.
text.english: Transportation in this city is convenient; it is easy to get around by either bus or train.

text.traditional: 員工：我今天心情不好，我要請假。老闆：不管心情好壞，你都得來上班。
text.simplified: 员工：我今天心情不好，我要请假。老板：不管心情好坏，你都得来上班。
text.pinyin: Yuángōng: Wǒ jīntiān xīnqíng bùhǎo, wǒ yào qǐngjià. Lǎobǎn: Bùguǎn xīnqíng hǎohuài, nǐ dōu děi lái shàngbān.
text.english: Employee: I’m in a bad mood today, so I want to take a day off. Boss: Whether you’re in a good or bad mood, you still have to come to work.

segments.traditional: 你的課很多，還有時間參加學校的社團嗎？
segments.simplified: 你的课很多，还有时间参加学校的社团吗？

repairs.note: After 不管 comes a question form that covers every case: 多不多.
雖然 accepts one fact and needs a turn after it. "Whatever the case" is 不管…，都….
Here 才 would say it happens late. After 不管, what stays the same takes 都.

items.fallbackRepair: 不管 + a question form, then 都 + what stays the same: 不管課多不多，我都要參加社團.

result.traditional: 不管課多不多，我都要參加社團。
result.simplified: 不管课多不多，我都要参加社团。
result.pinyin: Bùguǎn kè duō bù duō, wǒ dōu yào cānjiā shètuán.
result.english: No matter how many classes I have, I am going to join a club.

segments.traditional: 我找不到電腦的保證書，恐怕不能在這家店修理了。
segments.simplified: 我找不到电脑的保证书，恐怕不能在这家店修理了。

repairs.note: After 不管 comes a question form that covers every case: 有沒有.
如果 sets up one case. B means it makes no difference either way: 不管…，都….
Here 才 would say it happens late. After 不管, what stays the same takes 都.

items.fallbackRepair: 不管 + a question form, then 都 + what stays the same: 不管有沒有保證書，都可以修理.

result.traditional: 只要付錢，不管有沒有保證書，都可以修理。
result.simplified: 只要付钱，不管有没有保证书，都可以修理。
result.pinyin: Zhǐyào fù qián, bùguǎn yǒu méiyǒu bǎozhèngshū, dōu kěyǐ xiūlǐ.
result.english: As long as you pay, it can be repaired whether or not you have the warranty.

segments.traditional: 這種青菜很難吃，我不要吃。
segments.simplified: 这种青菜很难吃，我不要吃。

repairs.note: After 不管 comes a question form that covers every case: 喜不喜歡.
Dad is not giving a reason. He means liking it or not makes no difference: 不管.
Here 才 would say it happens late. Every healthy food takes 都.

items.fallbackRepair: 不管 + a question form, then 都 + what stays the same.

result.traditional: 不管你喜不喜歡，只要對身體好的食物都應該吃。
result.simplified: 不管你喜不喜欢，只要对身体好的食物都应该吃。
result.pinyin: Bùguǎn nǐ xǐ bù xǐhuān, zhǐyào duì shēntǐ hǎo de shíwù dōu yīnggāi chī.
result.english: Whether you like it or not, you should eat any food that is good for your body.

alternatives.traditional: 你不管喜不喜歡，只要對身體好的食物都應該吃。
alternatives.simplified: 你不管喜不喜欢，只要对身体好的食物都应该吃。
alternatives.pinyin: Nǐ bùguǎn xǐ bù xǐhuān, zhǐyào duì shēntǐ hǎo de shíwù dōu yīnggāi chī.
alternatives.english: Whether you like it or not, you should eat any food that is good for your body.

segments.traditional: 我已經很瘦了，不用去運動了吧！
segments.simplified: 我已经很瘦了，不用去运动了吧！

repairs.note: After 不管 comes a choice with 還是, not a pair joined by 和: 胖還是瘦.
After 不管 comes a question form that covers every case: 胖還是瘦.
After 不管, what stays the same takes 都, not 就.

items.fallbackRepair: 不管 + a choice with 還是, then 都 + what stays the same.

result.traditional: 可是我覺得不管胖還是瘦，都應該運動。
result.simplified: 可是我觉得不管胖还是瘦，都应该运动。
result.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ juéde bùguǎn pàng háishì shòu, dōu yīnggāi yùndòng.
result.english: But I think that whether you are fat or thin, you should exercise.

summary: 不管 ... 都 says that in every possible condition, the result stays the same.
After 不管 come the possible conditions, and after 都 comes the situation that does not change.
What follows 不管 is a question: a question word, A-not-A, a choice, or two opposite one-syllable words.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Buy a Laptop
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Offer a better alternative after explaining the first option.
grammarPages.pattern: original action/comment，不如 + better suggestion (+ explanation)
grammarPages.explanation: This pattern in a conversation is usually used to help the speaker offer a better suggestion. Before “不如”, the speaker can give comments on the original action to explain why there is a better suggestion which follows “不如”. And, accordingly, a further explanation can be added to the better suggestion.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern in a conversation is usually used to help the speaker offer a better suggestion. Before “不如”, the speaker can give comments on the original action to explain why there is a better suggestion which follows “不如”. And, accordingly, a further explanation can be added to the better suggestion.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern in a conversation is usually used to help the speaker offer a better suggestion. Before “不如”, the speaker can give comments on the original action to explain why there is a better suggestion which follows “不如”. And, accordingly, a further explanation can be added to the better suggestion.

text.traditional: 這台筆電太舊了，如果要花不少錢修理，不如買一台新的。
text.simplified: 这台笔电太旧了，如果要花不少钱修理，不如买一台新的。
text.pinyin: Zhè tái bǐdiàn tài jiù le, rúguǒ yào huā bùshǎo qián xiūlǐ, bùrú mǎi yì tái xīn de.
text.english: This laptop is too old. If repairing it would cost a lot, it would be better to buy a new one.

text.traditional: 先生：那台最新的平板不但很輕，功能也很好，我想要買。太太：可是新產品都很貴，不如等便宜一點兒再買吧！
text.simplified: 先生：那台最新的平板不但很轻，功能也很好，我想要买。太太：可是新产品都很贵，不如等便宜一点儿再买吧！
text.pinyin: Xiānshēng: Nà tái zuìxīn de píngbǎn búdàn hěn qīng, gōngnéng yě hěn hǎo, wǒ xiǎngyào mǎi. Tàitai: Kěshì xīn chǎnpǐn dōu hěn guì, bùrú děng piányí yìdiǎnr zài mǎi ba!
text.english: Husband: That newest tablet is light and has great features. I want to buy it. Wife: But new products are all expensive. It would be better to wait until it’s a little cheaper.

text.traditional: A：我們去附近的飯館吃餃子，好不好？B：那家飯館常常客滿，不如去便利商店買三明治，不必等。
text.simplified: A：我们去附近的饭馆吃饺子，好不好？B：那家饭馆常常客满，不如去便利商店买三明治，不必等。
text.pinyin: A: Wǒmen qù fùjìn de fànguǎn chī jiǎozi, hǎo bù hǎo? B: Nà jiā fànguǎn chángcháng kèmǎn, bùrú qù biànlì shāngdiàn mǎi sānmíngzhì, búbì děng.
text.english: A: Shall we go to the nearby restaurant for dumplings? B: That restaurant is often full. We’d better go to the convenience store for a sandwich; we won’t have to wait.

segments.traditional: 聽說你計畫一個人去印尼旅行，為什麼不參加團體旅遊呢？
segments.simplified: 听说你计划一个人去印尼旅行，为什么不参加团体旅游呢？

segments.traditional: 我覺得團體旅遊比較麻煩，
segments.simplified: 我觉得团体旅游比较麻烦，

repairs.note: B has just said group tours are a bother, so the better choice is going alone.
比較 goes before a quality (比較麻煩). The better choice comes after 不如.
不好 says something is bad. Pointing to a better choice is 不如.

items.fallbackRepair: 不如 first, then the better choice: 不如一個人去.

result.traditional: 我覺得團體旅遊比較麻煩，不如一個人去，又輕鬆又自由。
result.simplified: 我觉得团体旅游比较麻烦，不如一个人去，又轻松又自由。
result.pinyin: Wǒ juéde tuántǐ lǚyóu bǐjiào máfán, bùrú yígerén qù, yòu qīngsōng yòu zìyóu.
result.english: I find group tours more of a bother; it's better to go alone, which is both relaxed and free.

segments.traditional: 我已經少吃飯、少吃肉了，為什麼還是很胖？
segments.simplified: 我已经少吃饭、少吃肉了，为什么还是很胖？

repairs.note: B is offering something better than eating less: more exercise, not less.
比較 goes before a quality (比較健康). The better choice comes after 不如.
不但 starts a "not only… but also" pair. Pointing to a better choice is 不如.

items.fallbackRepair: 不如 first, then the better choice: 不如多運動.

result.traditional: 少吃東西不一定健康，不如多運動。
result.simplified: 少吃东西不一定健康，不如多运动。
result.pinyin: Shǎo chī dōngxi bù yídìng jiànkāng, bùrú duō yùndòng.
result.english: Eating less isn't necessarily healthy; you'd do better to exercise more.

segments.traditional: 我老了以後要住在鄉下，空氣好、風景美。
segments.simplified: 我老了以后要住在乡下，空气好、风景美。

segments.traditional: 可是鄉下交通很不方便，
segments.simplified: 可是乡下交通很不方便，

repairs.note: B has just said the countryside is inconvenient, so the better choice is the city.
比較 goes before a quality (比較方便). The better choice comes after 不如.
不但 starts a "not only… but also" pair. Pointing to a better choice is 不如.

items.fallbackRepair: 不如 first, then the better choice: 不如住在都市.

result.traditional: 可是鄉下交通很不方便，不如住在都市。
result.simplified: 可是乡下交通很不方便，不如住在都市。
result.pinyin: Kěshì xiāngxià jiāotōng hěn bù fāngbiàn, bùrú zhù zài dūshì.
result.english: But transportation in the countryside is very inconvenient; it would be better to live in the city.

summary: 不如 offers a better suggestion than the original action.
Before 不如, the speaker can comment on the original action to explain why.
After the suggestion, you can add a further explanation.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Buy a Laptop
grammarPages.titleEnglish: A Little Too… with Vs了一點兒
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe a small shortcoming or complaint.
grammarPages.pattern: Vs + 了 +（一）點兒
grammarPages.explanation: This pattern is used when the speaker wants to show a situation is not as good as expected, but there is not much difference. Usually, it implies minor weaknesses or complaints. For example, “這支手機不錯，可是貴了一點兒 (This cell phone is not bad, but it is a little bit expensive.)” In the example, the speaker thinks the cell phone is more expensive than he expects, but it is not a big issue.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern is used when the speaker wants to show a situation is not as good as expected, but there is not much difference. Usually, it implies minor weaknesses or complaints. For example, “這支手機不錯，可是貴了一點兒 (This cell phone is not bad, but it is a little bit expensive.)” In the example, the speaker thinks the cell phone is more expensive than he expects, but it is not a big issue.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern is used when the speaker wants to show a situation is not as good as expected, but there is not much difference. Usually, it implies minor weaknesses or complaints. For example, “這支手機不錯，可是貴了一點兒 (This cell phone is not bad, but it is a little bit expensive.)” In the example, the speaker thinks the cell phone is more expensive than he expects, but it is not a big issue.

text.traditional: 這堂美術課很有意思，可是學生多了一點兒。
text.simplified: 这堂美术课很有意思，可是学生多了一点儿。
text.pinyin: Zhè táng měishù kè hěn yǒuyìsi, kěshì xuéshēng duō le yìdiǎnr.
text.english: This art class is interesting, but there are a bit too many students.

text.traditional: 健身雖然對身體有很多好處，但是健身房的費用高了一點兒。
text.simplified: 健身虽然对身体有很多好处，但是健身房的费用高了一点儿。
text.pinyin: Jiànshēn suīrán duì shēntǐ yǒu hěn duō hǎochù, dànshì jiànshēnfáng de fèiyòng gāo le yìdiǎnr.
text.english: Although working out has many benefits for your health, the gym fee is a little high.

text.traditional: A：聽說你趁這次春假去了日月潭，那裡的風景怎麼樣？B：日月潭很美，花也都開了。可惜人太多，擠了點兒。
text.simplified: A：听说你趁这次春假去了日月潭，那里的风景怎么样？B：日月潭很美，花也都开了。可惜人太多，挤了点儿。
text.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō nǐ chèn zhè cì chūnjià qù le Rìyuè Tán, nàlǐ de fēngjǐng zěnmeyàng? B: Rìyuè Tán hěn měi, huā yě dōu kāi le. Kěxí rén tài duō, jǐ le diǎnr.
text.english: A: I heard you went to Sun Moon Lake during spring break. How was the scenery? B: Sun Moon Lake is beautiful, and the flowers have all bloomed. Too bad there were so many people; it was a little crowded.

segments.traditional: 他的中文說得不錯，可是
segments.simplified: 他的中文说得不错，可是

repairs.note: After 可是 comes the small weak point, not another good point.
A small weak point is the quality + 了 + 一點兒: 慢了一點兒.
很 goes before a quality. "A little too…" puts 了一點兒 after it: 慢了一點兒.

items.fallbackRepair: The quality first, then 了, then 一點兒: 慢了一點兒.

result.traditional: 他的中文說得不錯，可是慢了一點兒。
result.simplified: 他的中文说得不错，可是慢了一点儿。
result.pinyin: Tā de Zhōngwén shuō de búcuò, kěshì màn le yìdiǎnr.
result.english: He speaks Chinese quite well, but a little too slowly.

segments.traditional: 做愛心服務雖然很有意義，可是
segments.simplified: 做爱心服务虽然很有意义，可是

repairs.note: After 雖然…可是 comes the small weak point: tiring, not relaxing.
A small weak point is the quality + 了 + 點兒, with nothing in between: 累了點兒.
一下 goes after an action (等一下). After a quality, "a little too…" is 了點兒: 累了點兒.

items.fallbackRepair: The quality first, then 了, then 點兒: 累了點兒.

result.traditional: 做愛心服務雖然很有意義，可是累了點兒。
result.simplified: 做爱心服务虽然很有意义，可是累了点儿。
result.pinyin: Zuò àixīn fúwù suīrán hěn yǒu yìyì, kěshì lèi le diǎnr.
result.english: Volunteer service is very meaningful, but it is a little tiring.

segments.traditional: 在外國生活很有意思，可是東西
segments.simplified: 在外国生活很有意思，可是东西

repairs.note: After 可是 comes the small weak point: expensive, not cheap.
A small weak point is the quality + 了 + 一點兒, with no 的: 貴了一點兒.
一下 goes after an action (等一下). After a quality, "a little too…" is 了一點兒.

items.fallbackRepair: The quality first, then 了, then 一點兒: 貴了一點兒.

result.traditional: 在外國生活很有意思，可是東西貴了一點兒。
result.simplified: 在外国生活很有意思，可是东西贵了一点儿。
result.pinyin: Zài wàiguó shēnghuó hěn yǒuyìsi, kěshì dōngxi guì le yìdiǎnr.
result.english: Living abroad is very interesting, but things are a little expensive.

summary: 了一點兒 after a state word says something is not as good as expected, but not by much.
It usually shows small weaknesses or a mild complaint, like 貴了一點兒.

dialogue.title: 對話 · 我要買筆電 · I Want to Buy a Laptop

text.traditional: 您好，要找哪種產品？筆電還是平板？
text.simplified: 您好，要找哪种产品？笔电还是平板？
text.pinyin: Nín hǎo, yào zhǎo nǎ zhǒng chǎnpǐn? Bǐdiàn háishì píngbǎn?
text.english: Hello! What kind of product are you looking for? A laptop or a tablet?

text.traditional: 你好，請問這兩種有什麼差別？你可以說明一下嗎？
text.simplified: 你好，请问这两种有什么差别？你可以说明一下吗？
text.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, qǐngwèn zhè liǎng zhǒng yǒu shénme chābié? Nǐ kěyǐ shuōmíng yíxià ma?
text.english: Hello. May I ask that what is the difference between these two? Could you please explain?

text.traditional: 其實功能都差不多，可是平板比較輕，不少上班族出差時，得隨時處理公司的事情，所以他們比較喜歡買平板。
text.simplified: 其实功能都差不多，可是平板比较轻，不少上班族出差时，得随时处理公司的事情，所以他们比较喜欢买平板。
text.pinyin: Qíshí gōngnéng dōu chàbùduō, kěshì píngbǎn bǐjiào qīng, bùshǎo shàngbān zú chūchāi shí, děi suíshí chǔlǐ gōngsī de shìqíng, suǒyǐ tāmen bǐjiào xǐhuān mǎi píngbǎn.
text.english: Actually, their functions are similar, but tablets are lighter. When many office workers go on business trips, they have to deal with tasks of their companies anytime, so they prefer buying tablets.

text.traditional: 你的意思是，帶著筆電出門很麻煩，不如買平板？
text.simplified: 你的意思是，带着笔电出门很麻烦，不如买平板？
text.pinyin: Nǐ de yìsi shì, dài zhe bǐdiàn chūmén hěn máfán, bùrú mǎi píngbǎn?
text.english: You mean it is very troublesome to go out with a laptop, and it is better to buy a laptop, right?

text.traditional: 也不一定，大多數的大學生把筆電放在背包裡，不管去圖書館還是咖啡廳，隨時都能做功課、寫報告。
text.simplified: 也不一定，大多数的大学生把笔电放在背包里，不管去图书馆还是咖啡厅，随时都能做功课、写报告。
text.pinyin: Yě bù yídìng, dàduōshù de dàxuéshēng bǎ bǐdiàn fàng zài bēibāo lǐ, bùguǎn qù túshūguǎn háishì kāfēitīng, suíshí dōu néng zuò gōngkè, xiě bàogào.
text.english: Not necessarily. Most university students put laptops in their backpacks. No matter where they go, to a library or to a café, they can do homework and write reports anytime.

text.traditional: 我好像比較需要這樣的產品。那有沒有輕一點兒的筆電？
text.simplified: 我好像比较需要这样的产品。那有没有轻一点儿的笔电？
text.pinyin: Wǒ hǎoxiàng bǐjiào xūyào zhèyàng de chǎnpǐn. Nà yǒu méiyǒu qīng yìdiǎnr de bǐdiàn?
text.english: I seem to need this kind of product more. In that case, do you have any laptop that is lighter?

text.traditional: 有，請跟我來。您看，這部筆電是最新的，牌子很有名，也非常輕。
text.simplified: 有，请跟我来。您看，这部笔电是最新的，牌子很有名，也非常轻。
text.pinyin: Yǒu, qǐng gēn wǒ lái. Nín kàn, zhè bù bǐdiàn shì zuìxīn de, páizi hěn yǒumíng, yě fēicháng qīng.
text.english: We do. Please follow me. Look! This laptop is the newest. The brand is very famous and the laptop is very light, too.

text.traditional: 看起來很好用，拿起來也很輕，可是最近電視新聞說這個牌子的筆電不好，很多人都抱怨電池有問題。
text.simplified: 看起来很好用，拿起来也很轻，可是最近电视新闻说这个牌子的笔电不好，很多人都抱怨电池有问题。
text.pinyin: Kànqǐlái hěn hǎoyòng, ná qǐ lái yě hěn qīng, kěshì zuìjìn diànshì xīnwén shuō zhège páizi de bǐdiàn bùhǎo, hěn duō rén dōu bàoyuàn diànchí yǒu wèntí.
text.english: It looks useful, and is very light to carry. However, recently, in TV news people say laptops of this brand are not good. Many people complain about problems with the battery.

text.traditional: 電腦用久了，有問題是正常的。以後有問題的話，您就帶著保證書來，我們會幫您免費修理的。
text.simplified: 电脑用久了，有问题是正常的。以后有问题的话，您就带着保证书来，我们会帮您免费修理的。
text.pinyin: Diànnǎo yòng jiǔ le, yǒu wèntí shì zhèngcháng de. Yǐhòu yǒu wèntí dehuà, nín jiù dài zhe bǎozhèngshū lái, wǒmen huì bāng nín miǎnfèi xiūlǐ de.
text.english: If a computer has been used for a long time, it would be normal to have some problems. If there is really something wrong with it, you can bring this warranty, and we will repair it for you for free.

text.traditional: 這樣啊，不過三萬六千塊貴了一點兒，恐怕我買不起。我改天再來看看，謝謝。
text.simplified: 这样啊，不过三万六千块贵了一点儿，恐怕我买不起。我改天再来看看，谢谢。
text.pinyin: Zhèyàng a, búguò sānwànliùqiān kuài guì le yìdiǎnr, kǒngpà wǒ mǎi bù qǐ. Wǒ gǎitiān zài lái kànkan, xièxie.
text.english: I see. But a computer costing 36,000 dollars is a little expensive. I’m afraid I can’t afford it. I’ll come again another day, thank you.

text.traditional: 請等一下！除了傳真機，我們的產品這個禮拜都打八五折，還有「滿三萬送三千」的活動。
