text.simplified: 请等一下！除了传真机，我们的产品这个礼拜都打八五折，还有「满三万送三千」的活动。
text.pinyin: Qǐng děng yíxià! Chúle chuánzhēnjī, wǒmen de chǎnpǐn zhège lǐbài dōu dǎ bāwǔ zhé, háiyǒu “mǎn sānwàn sòng sānqiān” de huódòng.
text.english: Please wait a moment! In addition to fax machines, our products are 15% off this week. We are also having a sales promotion, which is “3,000-dollar cash rebate on every 30,000-dollar purchase”.

text.traditional: 你的意思是打折以後要是超過三萬元，還可以再便宜三千塊嗎？
text.simplified: 你的意思是打折以后要是超过三万元，还可以再便宜三千块吗？
text.pinyin: Nǐ de yìsi shì dǎzhé yǐhòu yàoshì chāoguò sānwàn yuán, hái kěyǐ zài piányí sānqiān kuài ma?
text.english: Do you mean that if the price of the product after the discount exceeds 30,000 dollars, it can be another 3,000 dollars cheaper?

text.traditional: 沒錯，而且這個活動下禮拜就結束了，請把握機會喔！
text.simplified: 没错，而且这个活动下礼拜就结束了，请把握机会喔！
text.pinyin: Méicuò, érqiě zhège huódòng xià lǐbài jiù jiéshù le, qǐng bǎwò jīhuì o!
text.english: Exactly. What’s more, this offer will end next week. Please seize the opportunity!

text.traditional: 那麼，我只要付大約兩萬八，就能夠把這部筆電帶回家，是嗎？
text.simplified: 那么，我只要付大约两万八，就能够把这部笔电带回家，是吗？
text.pinyin: Nàme, wǒ zhǐyào fù dàyuē liǎngwànbā, jiù nénggòu bǎ zhè bù bǐdiàn dài huí jiā, shì ma?
text.english: So, I only need to pay about 28,000 dollars to bring the laptop home, right?

text.traditional: 是的。我們有白色、黑色、紅色等三種顏色讓客人選擇。
text.simplified: 是的。我们有白色、黑色、红色等三种颜色让客人选择。
text.pinyin: Shì de. Wǒmen yǒu báisè, hēisè, hóngsè děng sān zhǒng yánsè ràng kèrén xuǎnzé.
text.english: Yes, and we have three colors, white, black and red for our guests to choose.

text.traditional: 我要黑色的。
text.simplified: 我要黑色的。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yào hēisè de.
text.english: I’ll take the black one.

text.traditional: 好的。打折後是兩萬七千六百元，再送您一個真皮的背包。
text.simplified: 好的。打折后是两万七千六百元，再送您一个真皮的背包。
text.pinyin: Hǎo de. Dǎzhé hòu shì liǎngwànqīqiānliùbǎi yuán, zài sòng nín yíge zhēnpí de bēibāo.
text.english: Alright. That would be 27,600 dollars with the discount. I’ll give you a backpack made of genuine leather as a gift.

text.traditional: 謝謝，再見。
text.simplified: 谢谢，再见。
text.pinyin: Xièxie, zàijiàn.
text.english: Thank you. Goodbye.

text.traditional: 先生，這支手機是您的嗎？
text.simplified: 先生，这支手机是您的吗？
text.pinyin: Xiānshēng, zhè zhī shǒujī shì nín de ma?
text.english: Sir, is this cellphone yours?

items.title: Grammar 4–6 · I Want to Buy a Laptop

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Buy a Laptop
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Comparing with 比, 比較 and 比起來
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Compare two things with 比, 比較, or 比起來.
grammarPages.pattern: A 比 B + Vs / S + 比較 + Vs / 跟 B 比起來，A 比較……

columns.meaning: A is more/less Vs than B

columns.traditional: 跟 B 比起來，A 比較……
columns.simplified: 跟 B 比起来，A 比较……
columns.meaning: compared with B, A is more/less…

grammarPages.explanation: “比” is a preposition that indicates the status of the subject when a comparison is made. “比” is followed by the compared object, e.g., “我比你高” and “搭公車比搭火車便宜”, equivalent to “than” in English. “比較” is an adverb that indicates a higher or lower degree, e.g., “台灣比較熱” and “坐公車比較便宜”, equivalent to “more” in English. The subject is placed before “比較”, while the stative verb is placed after it. “比起來” is a phrase that shows the remark about one thing as compared to another. The common pattern is “(A/B)跟 B/A 比起來，A/B 比較……”, e.g., “（你）跟他比起來，你比較漂亮” and “（我）跟你比起來，我沒有你那麼漂亮”.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: “比” is a preposition that indicates the status of the subject when a comparison is made. “比” is followed by the compared object, e.g., “我比你高” and “搭公車比搭火車便宜”, equivalent to “than” in English. “比較” is an adverb that indicates a higher or lower degree, e.g., “台灣比較熱” and “坐公車比較便宜”, equivalent to “more” in English. The subject is placed before “比較”, while the stative verb is placed after it. “比起來” is a phrase that shows the remark about one thing as compared to another. The common pattern is “(A/B)跟 B/A 比起來，A/B 比較……”, e.g., “（你）跟他比起來，你比較漂亮” and “（我）跟你比起來，我沒有你那麼漂亮”.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “比” is a preposition that indicates the status of the subject when a comparison is made. “比” is followed by the compared object, e.g., “我比你高” and “搭公車比搭火車便宜”, equivalent to “than” in English. “比較” is an adverb that indicates a higher or lower degree, e.g., “台灣比較熱” and “坐公車比較便宜”, equivalent to “more” in English. The subject is placed before “比較”, while the stative verb is placed after it. “比起來” is a phrase that shows the remark about one thing as compared to another. The common pattern is “(A/B)跟 B/A 比起來，A/B 比較……”, e.g., “（你）跟他比起來，你比較漂亮” and “（我）跟你比起來，我沒有你那麼漂亮”.

text.traditional: 平板比筆電便宜，所以我比較想買平板。
text.simplified: 平板比笔电便宜，所以我比较想买平板。
text.pinyin: Píngbǎn bǐ bǐdiàn piányí, suǒyǐ wǒ bǐjiào xiǎng mǎi píngbǎn.
text.english: Tablets are cheaper than laptops, so I’d rather buy a tablet.

text.traditional: 跟國外旅遊比起來，大部分的國內旅遊便宜一點兒。
text.simplified: 跟国外旅游比起来，大部分的国内旅游便宜一点儿。
text.pinyin: Gēn guówài lǚyóu bǐ qǐ lái, dàbùfèn de guónèi lǚyóu piányí yìdiǎnr.
text.english: Compared with traveling abroad, most domestic trips are a little cheaper.

text.traditional: 雖然筆電的功能比平板好，可是跟平板比起來，筆電比較重。
text.simplified: 虽然笔电的功能比平板好，可是跟平板比起来，笔电比较重。
text.pinyin: Suīrán bǐdiàn de gōngnéng bǐ píngbǎn hǎo, kěshì gēn píngbǎn bǐ qǐ lái, bǐdiàn bǐjiào zhòng.
text.english: Although laptops have better features than tablets, laptops are heavier compared with tablets.

practice.title: Complete the sentences and dialogues with 比 / 比較 / 比起來.

repairs.note: 最 picks the top of three or more. Between two, the quality takes 比較.

items.fallbackRepair: 跟… is closed by 比起來 (or 比), and 比較 goes before the quality.

result.traditional: 跟他做的菜比起來，我做的比較好吃。
result.simplified: 跟他做的菜比起来，我做的比较好吃。
result.pinyin: Gēn tā zuò de cài bǐ qǐlái, wǒ zuò de bǐjiào hǎochī.
result.english: Compared with the food he makes, mine tastes better.

alternatives.traditional: 跟他做的菜比，我做的比較好吃。
alternatives.simplified: 跟他做的菜比，我做的比较好吃。
alternatives.pinyin: Gēn tā zuò de cài bǐ, wǒ zuò de bǐjiào hǎochī.
alternatives.english: Compared with the food he makes, mine tastes better.

repairs.note: 比較 goes straight before a quality (比較熱). Before the thing compared with (台灣), it is 比.
最 picks the top of three or more. Between two countries, it is A比B….

items.fallbackRepair: 跟… is closed by 比起來, and 比 goes before the thing compared with.

result.traditional: 跟台灣比起來，我的國家比台灣熱多了。
result.simplified: 跟台湾比起来，我的国家比台湾热多了。
result.pinyin: Gēn Táiwān bǐ qǐlái, wǒ de guójiā bǐ Táiwān rè duō le.
result.english: Compared with Taiwan, my country is much hotter than Taiwan.

segments.traditional: 有用，可是在台灣，說中文的人
segments.simplified: 有用，可是在台湾，说中文的人

segments.traditional: 說英文的多得多，所以我
segments.simplified: 说英文的多得多，所以我

repairs.note: 跟 already opens the phrase (跟中文…). The blanks here take 比起來, 比較 or 比.

items.fallbackRepair: 跟… is closed by 比起來; 比較 goes before a quality or a wish; 比 goes before the thing compared with.

result.traditional: 跟中文比起來，英文比較有用，可是在台灣，說中文的人比說英文的多得多，所以我比較想學中文。
result.simplified: 跟中文比起来，英文比较有用，可是在台湾，说中文的人比说英文的多得多，所以我比较想学中文。
result.pinyin: Gēn Zhōngwén bǐ qǐlái, Yīngwén bǐjiào yǒuyòng, kěshì zài Táiwān, shuō Zhōngwén de rén bǐ shuō Yīngwén de duō de duō, suǒyǐ wǒ bǐjiào xiǎng xué Zhōngwén.
result.english: Compared with Chinese, English is more useful, but in Taiwan far more people speak Chinese than English, so I would rather learn Chinese.

segments.traditional: 有人說吃青菜比吃肉健康，你覺得呢？
segments.simplified: 有人说吃青菜比吃肉健康，你觉得呢？

repairs.note: 比較 goes straight before a quality. Between the two things compared, it is 比.
比起來 closes a 跟… phrase. Between the two things compared, it is 比.
一樣 goes with 跟 (跟…一樣). After 比 comes the quality itself: 好吃.

items.fallbackRepair: 比, then the thing compared with, then the quality: 比吃青菜好吃.

result.traditional: 可是我覺得吃肉比吃青菜好吃。
result.simplified: 可是我觉得吃肉比吃青菜好吃。
result.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ juéde chī ròu bǐ chī qīngcài hǎochī.
result.english: But I think eating meat tastes better than eating vegetables.

segments.traditional: 中文的發音跟漢字，你覺得哪個難？
segments.simplified: 中文的发音跟汉字，你觉得哪个难？

repairs.note: 最 picks the top of three or more. Between two, the quality takes 比較.

items.fallbackRepair: 跟… is closed by 比起來 (or 比), and 比較 goes before the quality.

result.traditional: 跟發音比起來，漢字比較難。
result.simplified: 跟发音比起来，汉字比较难。
result.pinyin: Gēn fāyīn bǐ qǐlái, Hànzì bǐjiào nán.
result.english: Compared with pronunciation, characters are harder.

alternatives.traditional: 跟發音比，漢字比較難。
alternatives.simplified: 跟发音比，汉字比较难。
alternatives.pinyin: Gēn fāyīn bǐ, Hànzì bǐjiào nán.
alternatives.english: Compared with pronunciation, characters are harder.

segments.traditional: 如果一定要選一個社團，你想參加鋼琴社還是吉他社？
segments.simplified: 如果一定要选一个社团，你想参加钢琴社还是吉他社？

repairs.note: 比 needs the thing compared with right after it. Before 想, "would rather" is 比較.
比起來 closes a 跟… phrase. Before 想, "would rather" is 比較.

items.fallbackRepair: 比較 before 想, then the action: 比較想參加吉他社.

result.traditional: 我比較想參加吉他社。
result.simplified: 我比较想参加吉他社。
result.pinyin: Wǒ bǐjiào xiǎng cānjiā jítā shè.
result.english: I would rather join the guitar club.

summary: 比 means than. The thing you compare with goes after it: 我比你高.
比較 means more. The subject goes before it and the state verb goes after it.
比起來 gives a remark about one thing compared with another, often as 跟 B 比起來.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Buy a Laptop
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe something unwanted that nearly happened.
grammarPages.pattern: 差（一）點兒 + verb phrase (+ 就 + result)
grammarPages.explanation: “差一點兒” is usually followed by verbs or verb phrases. This pattern is usually used in a situation when something which the speaker did not wish almost happened.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: “差一點兒” is usually followed by verbs or verb phrases. This pattern is usually used in a situation when something which the speaker did not wish almost happened.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “差一點兒” is usually followed by verbs or verb phrases. This pattern is usually used in a situation when something which the speaker did not wish almost happened.

text.traditional: 我以為我的手機不見了，差一點兒就要去買新的。
text.simplified: 我以为我的手机不见了，差一点儿就要去买新的。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi wǒ de shǒujī bújiànle, chàyìdiǎnr jiùyào qù mǎi xīn de.
text.english: I thought I had lost my phone and almost went to buy a new one.

text.traditional: 他吃了不新鮮的食物，拉了三天的肚子，差一點兒就死了。
text.simplified: 他吃了不新鲜的食物，拉了三天的肚子，差一点儿就死了。
text.pinyin: Tā chī le bù xīnxiān de shíwù, lā le sān tiān de dùzi, chàyìdiǎnr jiù sǐ le.
text.english: He ate stale food and had diarrhea for three days; he almost died.

text.traditional: 我差點兒忘了今天要考試，還好你告訴我，要不然這門課我一定會被當。
text.simplified: 我差点儿忘了今天要考试，还好你告诉我，要不然这门课我一定会被当。
text.pinyin: Wǒ chàdiǎnr wàngle jīntiān yào kǎoshì, háihǎo nǐ gàosu wǒ, yàobùrán zhè mén kè wǒ yídìng huì bèi dàng.
text.english: I almost forgot that I had an exam today. Good thing you told me; otherwise, I would definitely have failed this class.

segments.traditional: 李媽媽沒把錢存到銀行裡，錢
segments.simplified: 李妈妈没把钱存到银行里，钱

repairs.note: 有一點兒 goes before a feeling or quality. Something bad that nearly happened is 差一點兒.
After 差一點兒, the thing that nearly happened takes 就, not 才.
She did not put the money in the bank, so the danger was losing it, not finding it.

items.fallbackRepair: 差一點兒 first, then 就, then what nearly happened: 差一點兒就不見了.

result.traditional: 李媽媽沒把錢存到銀行裡，錢差一點兒就不見了。
result.simplified: 李妈妈没把钱存到银行里，钱差一点儿就不见了。
result.pinyin: Lǐ māma méi bǎ qián cún dào yínháng lǐ, qián chàyìdiǎnr jiù bújiàn le.
result.english: Mrs. Li didn't put the money in the bank, and the money was nearly lost.

repairs.note: 一點兒 alone is "a little". "Nearly" is 差一點兒.
After 差一點兒, the thing that nearly happened takes 就, not 才.
Getting up too late nearly makes a person late, not early.

items.fallbackRepair: 差一點兒 first, then 就, then what nearly happened: 差一點兒就遲到了.

result.traditional: 今天早上我太晚起床，差一點兒就遲到了。
result.simplified: 今天早上我太晚起床，差一点儿就迟到了。
result.pinyin: Jīntiān zǎoshàng wǒ tài wǎn qǐchuáng, chàyìdiǎnr jiù chídào le.
result.english: I got up too late this morning and was nearly late.

repairs.note: 有點兒 goes before a feeling or quality (有點兒無聊). "Nearly" is 差點兒.
After 差點兒, the thing that nearly happened takes 就, not 才.
再 puts an action off until later. After 差點兒, what nearly happened takes 就.

items.fallbackRepair: 差點兒 first, then 就, then what nearly happened: 差點兒就回家了.

result.traditional: 這部電影太無聊了，我差點兒就回家了。
result.simplified: 这部电影太无聊了，我差点儿就回家了。
result.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng tài wúliáo le, wǒ chàdiǎnr jiù huí jiā le.
result.english: This movie was so boring that I nearly went home.

summary: 差一點兒 says something almost happened.
It is followed by a verb or verb phrase, and it is usually about something the speaker did not want.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Buy a Laptop
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Show that an action had no expected effect.
grammarPages.pattern: 白 + V (+ 了)
grammarPages.explanation: “白” should be followed by a verb, often a monosyllabic verb. It indicates an action is carried out with no effects it should have. Note when collocating with some verbs such as “吃 (eat)”, “喝 (drink)” and “住 (live)”, it means “unwilling to pay money or make effort”, e.g., “他常常來我家白吃白喝”.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: “白” should be followed by a verb, often a monosyllabic verb. It indicates an action is carried out with no effects it should have. Note when collocating with some verbs such as “吃 (eat)”, “喝 (drink)” and “住 (live)”, it means “unwilling to pay money or make effort”, e.g., “他常常來我家白吃白喝”.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “白” should be followed by a verb, often a monosyllabic verb. It indicates an action is carried out with no effects it should have. Note when collocating with some verbs such as “吃 (eat)”, “喝 (drink)” and “住 (live)”, it means “unwilling to pay money or make effort”, e.g., “他常常來我家白吃白喝”.

text.traditional: 我說了這麼多次，你還是沒聽懂，真是白說了。
text.simplified: 我说了这么多次，你还是没听懂，真是白说了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ shuō le zhème duōcì, nǐ háishì méi tīngdǒng, zhēnshì bái shuō le.
text.english: I’ve said it so many times, but you still didn’t understand. It was all for nothing.

text.traditional: 那家餐廳很遠，你先打電話問他們今天做不做生意，別白跑了！
text.simplified: 那家餐厅很远，你先打电话问他们今天做不做生意，别白跑了！
text.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng hěn yuǎn, nǐ xiān dǎ diànhuà wèn tāmen jīntiān zuò bú zuò shēngyì, bié bái pǎo le!
text.english: That restaurant is far away. Call first to ask whether they’re open today so you don’t make the trip for nothing!

text.traditional: 我把野餐要吃的三明治都準備好了，可是朋友忽然說不去了，我白準備了。
text.simplified: 我把野餐要吃的三明治都准备好了，可是朋友忽然说不去了，我白准备了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ yěcān yào chī de sānmíngzhì dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le, kěshì péngyǒu hūrán shuō bú qù le, wǒ bái zhǔnbèi le.
text.english: I prepared all the sandwiches for the picnic, but my friend suddenly said they weren’t going. I prepared them for nothing.

practice.title: Complete the sentences with the given words.

segments.traditional: 我用電腦寫報告，電腦忽然壞了，我
segments.simplified: 我用电脑写报告，电脑忽然坏了，我

repairs.note: 再 is doing something again later. Work that came to nothing is 白 + verb + 了.
What came to nothing is the writing of the report: 白寫了.
Here 才 would say it happens late. Work that came to nothing is 白 + verb + 了.

items.fallbackRepair: 白 before the verb, and 了 after it: 白寫了.

result.traditional: 我用電腦寫報告，電腦忽然壞了，我白寫了。
result.simplified: 我用电脑写报告，电脑忽然坏了，我白写了。
result.pinyin: Wǒ yòng diànnǎo xiě bàogào, diànnǎo hūrán huài le, wǒ bái xiě le.
result.english: I was writing a report on the computer when it suddenly broke down; I wrote it for nothing.

segments.traditional: 我買了一盒豆漿給他，可是他不喝，我
segments.simplified: 我买了一盒豆浆给他，可是他不喝，我

repairs.note: He did not drink it. What came to nothing is the buying: 白買了.
The pattern closes with 了: 白買了.
再 is doing something again later. Something done for nothing is 白 + verb + 了.

items.fallbackRepair: 白 before the verb, and 了 after it: 白買了.

result.traditional: 我買了一盒豆漿給他，可是他不喝，我白買了。
result.simplified: 我买了一盒豆浆给他，可是他不喝，我白买了。
result.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le yì hé dòujiāng gěi tā, kěshì tā bù hē, wǒ bái mǎi le.
result.english: I bought him a carton of soy milk, but he won't drink it; I bought it for nothing.

segments.traditional: 朋友剛剛請我到餐廳去吃飯，現在一點兒也不餓。
segments.simplified: 朋友刚刚请我到餐厅去吃饭，现在一点儿也不饿。

repairs.note: Nobody will eat the dinner. What came to nothing is her cooking: 白做了.
Here 才 would say it happens late. Work that came to nothing is 白 + verb + 了.

items.fallbackRepair: 真是 first, then 白 before the verb, and 了 after it: 真是白做了.

result.traditional: 我做了好吃的晚餐，真是白做了。
result.pinyin: Wǒ zuò le hǎochī de wǎncān, zhēnshì bái zuò le.
result.english: I made a delicious dinner; I really made it for nothing.

summary: 白 plus a verb, often a one-syllable one, says an action was done but did not have the effect it should have.
With verbs like 吃, 喝 and 住, it means not willing to pay money or make effort.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 去光華商場買筆電 · Going to Guanghua Digital Plaza to Buy a Laptop

text.traditional: 我在台灣沒買過 3C 產品，所以買電腦以前，我看了好幾本電腦雜誌，也問了有經驗的朋友。朋友說他總是先上網打聽哪家店比較好、哪家店打折，或是哪家店的店員比較客氣。我覺得他說得很有道理，所以前兩天我也先上網找了一家不錯的商店。
text.simplified: 我在台湾没买过 3C 产品，所以买电脑以前，我看了好几本电脑杂志，也问了有经验的朋友。朋友说他总是先上网打听哪家店比较好、哪家店打折，或是哪家店的店员比较客气。我觉得他说得很有道理，所以前两天我也先上网找了一家不错的商店。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zài Táiwān méi mǎi guò 3C chǎnpǐn, suǒyǐ mǎi diànnǎo yǐqián, wǒ kàn le hǎojǐ běn diànnǎo zázhì, yě wèn le yǒu jīngyàn de péngyǒu. Péngyǒu shuō tā zǒngshì xiān shàngwǎng dǎtīng nǎ jiā diàn bǐjiào hǎo, nǎ jiā diàn dǎzhé, huòshì nǎ jiā diàn de diànyuán bǐjiào kèqì. Wǒ juéde tā shuō de hěn yǒudàolǐ, suǒyǐ qián liǎng tiān wǒ yě xiān shàngwǎng zhǎo le yìjiā búcuò de shāngdiàn.
text.english: I had never bought any electronic product in Taiwan before, so I read several computer magazines and asked an experienced friend before buying a computer. A friend told me that he would first inquire on the Internet about which store is better, which store gives discounts, or in which store the clerks are more polite. I thought that what he said made sense, so in the past two days, I also searched for a store on the Internet.

text.traditional: 那家店在光華商場，昨天我一下課就去那裡看看。本來我想買平板，但是店員認為大學生用筆電比較方便，而且跟平板比起來，筆電還是比較好用的。
text.simplified: 那家店在光华商场，昨天我一下课就去那里看看。本来我想买平板，但是店员认为大学生用笔电比较方便，而且跟平板比起来，笔电还是比较好用的。
text.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn zài Guānghuá Shāngchǎng, zuótiān wǒ yíxià kè jiù qù nàlǐ kànkan. Běnlái wǒ xiǎng mǎi píngbǎn, dànshì diànyuán rènwéi dàxuéshēng yòng bǐdiàn bǐjiào fāngbiàn, érqiě gēn píngbǎn bǐqǐ lái, bǐdiàn háishì bǐjiào hǎoyòng de.
text.english: The store was in Guanghua Digital Plaza. I went there and had a look right after class yesterday. Originally, I wanted to buy the tablet, but the clerk thought using a laptop is more convenient for university students. Besides, in comparison to a tablet, a laptop is still more useful.

text.traditional: 店員建議我買的那部筆電是最新的產品，拿起來很輕、看起來很好用，可是價格太高了。我最近窮死了，買不起那麼貴的電腦。因為上次搬家的時候手機不見了，父母說我不愛惜東西，這兩個月不給我零用錢，逼我省錢。還好店員告訴我，那部電腦打折以後能便宜八千塊錢，而且還答應我，要是電腦有問題，不超過一年都可以免費修理，所以我當天就把電腦買回家了。付了錢以後，我差一點兒就又忘了拿自己的手機，真糊塗！
text.simplified: 店员建议我买的那部笔电是最新的产品，拿起来很轻、看起来很好用，可是价格太高了。我最近穷死了，买不起那么贵的电脑。因为上次搬家的时候手机不见了，父母说我不爱惜东西，这两个月不给我零用钱，逼我省钱。还好店员告诉我，那部电脑打折以后能便宜八千块钱，而且还答应我，要是电脑有问题，不超过一年都可以免费修理，所以我当天就把电脑买回家了。付了钱以后，我差一点儿就又忘了拿自己的手机，真糊涂！
text.pinyin: Diànyuán jiànyì wǒ mǎi de nà bù bǐdiàn shì zuìxīn de chǎnpǐn, ná qǐ lái hěn qīng, kànqǐlái hěn hǎoyòng, kěshì jiàgé tài gāo le. Wǒ zuìjìn qióng sǐ le, mǎi bù qǐ nàme guì de diànnǎo. Yīnwèi shàng cì bānjiā de shíhòu shǒujī bújiànle, fùmǔ shuō wǒ bú àixí dōngxi, zhè liǎng ge yuè bù gěi wǒ língyòngqián, bī wǒ shěngqián. Háihǎo diànyuán gàosu wǒ, nà bù diànnǎo dǎzhé yǐhòu néng piányí bāqiān kuài qián, érqiě hái dāyìng wǒ, yàoshì diànnǎo yǒu wèntí, bù chāoguò yì nián dōu kěyǐ miǎnfèi xiūlǐ, suǒyǐ wǒ dāngtiān jiù bǎ diànnǎo mǎi huí jiā le. Fù le qián yǐhòu, wǒ chàyìdiǎnr jiù yòu wàngle ná zìjǐ de shǒujī, zhēn hútú!
text.english: The laptop the clerk suggested me to buy was the newest product. It was very light to carry and looked useful, but the price was too high. I was terribly poor recently, and I couldn’t afford such an expensive computer. Because my new cell phone was gone when I was moving house last time, my parents said that I didn’t cherish my stuff, so they didn’t give me pocket money these two months in order for me to save money. Fortunately, the clerk told me later that I could save 8,000 dollars after a discount, and he also promised me that if there were problems with the computer within a year, he would definitely help me repair it for free, so I brought the computer home on that same day. After paying the money, I almost forgot my cell phone again. How clumsy I was!

text.traditional: 我很高興這次去光華商場沒白跑，很快就買到需要的筆電，省了不少麻煩。後來我又去看了其他的科技產品，有不少新發現。新產品的功能越來越多，不但能幫我們解決很多問題，也能讓我們的生活變得更便利。
text.simplified: 我很高兴这次去光华商场没白跑，很快就买到需要的笔电，省了不少麻烦。后来我又去看了其他的科技产品，有不少新发现。新产品的功能越来越多，不但能帮我们解决很多问题，也能让我们的生活变得更便利。
text.pinyin: Wǒ hěn gāoxìng zhè cì qù Guānghuá Shāngchǎng méi bái pǎo, hěn kuài jiù mǎi dào xūyào de bǐdiàn, shěng le bùshǎo máfán. Hòulái wǒ yòu qù kàn le qítā de kējì chǎnpǐn, yǒu bùshǎo xīn fāxiàn. Xīn chǎnpǐn de gōngnéng yuèláiyuè duō, búdàn néng bāng wǒmen jiějué hěn duō wèntí, yě néng ràng wǒmen de shēnghuó biàn de gèng biànlì.
text.english: I am glad that this time I didn’t go to Guanghua Digital Plaza for nothing. I quickly bought the laptop I wanted, and it saved me a lot of trouble. Afterwards I went to see other technological products and had many new discoveries. I think new products have more and more functions. They not only can help us solve many problems, but also can make our lives more convenient.

items.title: Grammar 1–3 · Fish on the Dish, Abundance Year after Year

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Fish on the Dish, Abundance Year after Year
grammarPages.titleTraditional: 想起來：想起來了／沒想起來／想得起來／想不起來
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Now Remember / Can or Can’t Remember
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Recall something you nearly forgot.
grammarPages.explanation: “想起來” is used when someone suddenly remembers something that is almost forgotten or recalls something with great effort. “想得起來／想不起來” indicates whether or not someone can remember something almost forgotten or happened a long time ago.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: “想起來” is used when someone suddenly remembers something that is almost forgotten or recalls something with great effort. “想得起來／想不起來” indicates whether or not someone can remember something almost forgotten or happened a long time ago.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “想起來” is used when someone suddenly remembers something that is almost forgotten or recalls something with great effort. “想得起來／想不起來” indicates whether or not someone can remember something almost forgotten or happened a long time ago.
grammarPages.pattern: 想起來了／沒想起來／想得起來／想不起來

text.traditional: 太太：你怎麼看起來這麼緊張啊？先生：我忽然想起來今天要開會，我得快點兒去公司！
text.simplified: 太太：你怎么看起来这么紧张啊？先生：我忽然想起来今天要开会，我得快点儿去公司！
text.pinyin: Tàitai: Nǐ zěnme kànqǐlái zhème jǐnzhāng a? Xiānshēng: Wǒ hūrán xiǎng qǐlái jīntiān yào kāihuì, wǒ děi kuài diǎnr qù gōngsī!
text.english: Wife: Why do you look so nervous? Husband: I suddenly remembered that I have a meeting today. I have to hurry to the office!

text.traditional: A：你記得我們上次去的 KTV 在哪裡嗎？B：我想想……想起來了！就在捷運龍山寺站的附近。
text.simplified: A：你记得我们上次去的 KTV 在哪里吗？B：我想想……想起来了！就在捷运龙山寺站的附近。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ jìde wǒmen shàng cì qù de KTV zài nǎlǐ ma? B: Wǒ xiǎng xiǎng… xiǎng qǐlái le! Jiù zài Jiéyùn Lóngshān Sì Zhàn de fùjìn.
text.english: A: Do you remember where the KTV we went to last time is? B: Let me think… I remember now! It’s right near Longshan Temple MRT Station.

text.traditional: A：我是你的小學同學，你還記得我的名字嗎？B：你叫……對不起，我想不起來了。
text.simplified: A：我是你的小学同学，你还记得我的名字吗？B：你叫……对不起，我想不起来了。
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ shì nǐ de xiǎoxué tóngxué, nǐ hái jìde wǒ de míngzi ma? B: Nǐ jiào… duìbùqǐ, wǒ xiǎng bù qǐlái le.
text.english: A: I am your elementary school classmate. Do you still remember my name? B: Your name is… Sorry, I can’t remember.

text.traditional: A：你小時候第一次看的卡通是什麼，你想得起來嗎？B：那麼久以前的事，我怎麼想得起來！
text.simplified: A：你小时候第一次看的卡通是什么，你想得起来吗？B：那么久以前的事，我怎么想得起来！
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiǎoshíhòu dì yī cì kàn de kǎtōng shì shénme, nǐ xiǎng de qǐlái ma? B: Nàme jiǔ yǐqián de shì, wǒ zěnme xiǎng de qǐlái!
text.english: A: What was the first cartoon you watched as a child? Can you remember? B: How could I remember something from so long ago!

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Use 想起來 to complete the four prompts.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Complete the sentences with a suitable 想起來 form.

segments.traditional: 你的第一支手機是在哪裡買的嗎？
segments.simplified: 你的第一支手机是在哪里买的吗？

repairs.note: 想出來 is working out something new. Bringing back something from long ago is 想起來.
Remembering is done with 想: 想得起來.

items.fallbackRepair: The verb, then 得, then 起來: 想得起來.

result.traditional: 你想得起來你的第一支手機是在哪裡買的嗎？
result.simplified: 你想得起来你的第一支手机是在哪里买的吗？
result.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎngdeqǐlái nǐ de dì yī zhī shǒujī shì zài nǎlǐ mǎi de ma?
result.english: Can you remember where you bought your first cell phone?

segments.traditional: 昨天口試的時候，那個問題應該怎麼回答，我
segments.simplified: 昨天口试的时候，那个问题应该怎么回答，我

repairs.note: The speaker is angry about it, so the answer would not come back: 想不起來.
Remembering is done with 想: 想不起來.
想不下 is not a phrase. Not being able to remember is 想不起來.

items.fallbackRepair: The verb, then 不, then 起來: 想不起來.

result.traditional: 昨天口試的時候，那個問題應該怎麼回答，我想不起來，讓我很生氣。
result.simplified: 昨天口试的时候，那个问题应该怎么回答，我想不起来，让我很生气。
result.pinyin: Zuótiān kǒushì de shíhòu, nàge wèntí yīnggāi zěnme huídá, wǒ xiǎngbùqǐlái, ràng wǒ hěn shēngqì.
result.english: During yesterday's oral exam I couldn't remember how that question should be answered, which made me very angry.

segments.traditional: 你這件大衣怎麼這麼便宜？是打折的時候買的嗎？
segments.simplified: 你这件大衣怎么这么便宜？是打折的时候买的吗？

repairs.note: B only says 大概是吧, so B cannot remember: 想不起來了.
想不出來 is failing to work out something new. Failing to recall when the coat was bought is 想不起來.
Remembering is done with 想: 想不起來.

items.fallbackRepair: The verb, then 不, then 起來: 想不起來了.

result.traditional: 我想不起來了，大概是吧。
result.simplified: 我想不起来了，大概是吧。
result.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngbùqǐlái le, dàgài shì ba.
result.english: I can't remember anymore. Probably.

segments.traditional: 我忘了買媽媽的生日禮物，怎麼辦？
segments.simplified: 我忘了买妈妈的生日礼物，怎么办？

segments.traditional: 了，所以昨天一下班就去買了。
segments.simplified: 了，所以昨天一下班就去买了。

repairs.note: 想出來 is working out something new. Suddenly remembering is 想起來.
She bought the gift, so she did not forget. She remembered: 想起來了.
Remembering is done with 想: 想起來了.

items.fallbackRepair: The verb, then 起來: 想起來了.

result.traditional: 還好我想起來了，所以昨天一下班就去買了。
result.simplified: 还好我想起来了，所以昨天一下班就去买了。
result.pinyin: Háihǎo wǒ xiǎngqǐlái le, suǒyǐ zuótiān yí xiàbān jiù qù mǎi le.
result.english: Luckily I remembered, so I went and bought one yesterday right after work.

summary: 想起來 is used when someone suddenly remembers something almost forgotten, or remembers it with great effort.
想得起來 and 想不起來 say whether someone can remember something almost forgotten or from long ago.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Fish on the Dish, Abundance Year after Year
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say what you have never done with 從來沒, or what you never do with 從來不.
grammarPages.explanation: This pattern expresses that someone has never done something, or never does something.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern expresses that someone has never done something, or never does something.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern expresses that someone has never done something, or never does something.
grammarPages.pattern: 從來 + 沒／不 + V

text.traditional: A：這個週末我們一起去 KTV 唱歌，怎麼樣？B：太好了！我從來沒去過 KTV，一定很好玩。
text.simplified: A：这个周末我们一起去 KTV 唱歌，怎么样？B：太好了！我从来没去过 KTV，一定很好玩。
text.pinyin: A: Zhège zhōumò wǒmen yìqǐ qù KTV chànggē, zěnmeyàng? B: Tài hǎo le! Wǒ cónglái méi qù guo KTV, yídìng hěn hǎowán.
text.english: A: How about going to KTV to sing together this weekend? B: Great! I’ve never been to KTV; it must be fun.

text.traditional: A：下班以後，我們找老王一起去健身吧！B：不用找他了，他從來不運動！
text.simplified: A：下班以后，我们找老王一起去健身吧！B：不用找他了，他从来不运动！
text.pinyin: A: Xiàbān yǐhòu, wǒmen zhǎo Lǎo Wáng yìqǐ qù jiànshēn ba! B: Búyòng zhǎo tā le, tā cónglái bú yùndòng!
text.english: A: Let’s ask Lao Wang to work out with us after work! B: There’s no need; he never exercises!

text.traditional: A：我從來沒去過阿里山，聽說那裡的日出很美，是真的嗎？B：阿里山的日出是很美，夜裡看星星也不錯喔！
text.simplified: A：我从来没去过阿里山，听说那里的日出很美，是真的吗？B：阿里山的日出是很美，夜里看星星也不错喔！
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ cónglái méi qù guo Ālǐ Shān, tīngshuō nàlǐ de rìchū hěn měi, shì zhēnde ma? B: Ālǐ Shān de rìchū shì hěn měi, yèlǐ kàn xīngxīng yě búcuò o!
text.english: A: I’ve never been to Alishan. I heard the sunrise there is beautiful. Is that true? B: The sunrise at Alishan is beautiful, and stargazing at night is nice too!

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Complete the dialogues with 從來＋沒／不.

segments.traditional: 我覺得在網路上買的化妝品或保養品又便宜又好用。
segments.simplified: 我觉得在网路上买的化妆品或保养品又便宜又好用。

segments.traditional: 在網路上買東西，因為我怕買到有問題的商品。
segments.simplified: 在网路上买东西，因为我怕买到有问题的商品。

repairs.note: A does buy online, so B cannot say "also". B never does: 從來不.
很少不 would mean B almost always shops online, but B is afraid of bad products: 從來不.

items.fallbackRepair: 從來 first, then 不 before the action: 從來不在網路上買東西.

result.traditional: 我從來不在網路上買東西，因為我怕買到有問題的商品。
result.simplified: 我从来不在网路上买东西，因为我怕买到有问题的商品。
result.pinyin: Wǒ cónglái bú zài wǎnglù shang mǎi dōngxi, yīnwèi wǒ pà mǎidào yǒu wèntí de shāngpǐn.
result.english: I never buy things online, because I'm afraid of getting faulty products.

segments.traditional: 你知道在哪一個網站可以找到租房子的廣告嗎？
segments.simplified: 你知道在哪一个网站可以找到租房子的广告吗？

repairs.note: Experience with 過 is negated with 沒, not 不: 從來沒租過.
沒 + verb does not take 了. Something never done up to now is 從來沒 + verb + 過.

items.fallbackRepair: 從來, then 沒, then the verb, then 過: 從來沒租過房子.

result.traditional: 我一直住在家裡，從來沒租過房子，所以不知道。
result.simplified: 我一直住在家里，从来没租过房子，所以不知道。
result.pinyin: Wǒ yìzhí zhù zài jiā lǐ, cónglái méi zūguo fángzi, suǒyǐ bù zhīdào.
result.english: I've always lived at home and have never rented a place, so I don't know.

segments.traditional: 你大學的時候參加過什麼社團？
segments.simplified: 你大学的时候参加过什么社团？

segments.traditional: 因為我的課很多，也有很多考試，所以我
segments.simplified: 因为我的课很多，也有很多考试，所以我

repairs.note: Experience with 過 is negated with 沒, not 不: 從來沒參加過.
B had many classes and exams, so joining a club never happened: 從來沒參加過.

items.fallbackRepair: 從來, then 沒, then the verb, then 過: 從來沒參加過社團.

result.traditional: 因為我的課很多，也有很多考試，所以我從來沒參加過社團。
result.simplified: 因为我的课很多，也有很多考试，所以我从来没参加过社团。
result.pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ de kè hěn duō, yě yǒu hěn duō kǎoshì, suǒyǐ wǒ cónglái méi cānjiāguo shètuán.
result.english: Because I had a lot of classes and a lot of exams, I never joined a club.

summary: 從來 plus 沒 or 不 says someone has never done something, or never does it.
Put 從來 and 沒 or 不 before the verb.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Add 等等 after a list when more examples of the same kind are left unlisted.
grammarPages.explanation: Similar to “等”, “等等” is used to show there are still more items of the same kind that are not entirely listed. Normally, “等等” should not be placed after proper nouns.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Similar to “等”, “等等” is used to show there are still more items of the same kind that are not entirely listed. Normally, “等等” should not be placed after proper nouns.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: Similar to “等”, “等等” is used to show there are still more items of the same kind that are not entirely listed. Normally, “等等” should not be placed after proper nouns.

text.traditional: 便利商店的貼紙，可以換尺、牙刷、卡通娃娃等等。
text.simplified: 便利商店的贴纸，可以换尺、牙刷、卡通娃娃等等。

text.english: Convenience store stickers can be exchanged for rulers, toothbrushes, cartoon dolls, and so on.

text.traditional: 為了身體健康，薯條、漢堡、餅乾等等，最好少吃。

text.english: For good health, it’s best to eat fewer french fries, hamburgers, cookies, and similar foods.

text.traditional: 去鄉下爺爺奶奶家的時候，我會幫他們種花、剪草等等。
text.simplified: 去乡下爷爷奶奶家的时候，我会帮他们种花、剪草等等。

text.english: When I go to my grandparents’ home in the countryside, I help them plant flowers, cut grass, and so on.

segments.traditional: 平常你在家會做哪些家事呢？
segments.simplified: 平常你在家会做哪些家事呢？

repairs.note: 和 goes between the last two things, not after the list. An open list ends with 等等.
等一下 means "in a moment". "And so on" after a list is 等等.
A asks which chores B does, so B does them: 都會做.

items.fallbackRepair: 等等 closes the list, and 都 sums it up: …等等，我都會做.

result.traditional: 洗碗、打掃房間、倒垃圾等等，我都會做。
result.simplified: 洗碗、打扫房间、倒垃圾等等，我都会做。
result.pinyin: Xǐwǎn, dǎsǎo fángjiān, dào lèsè děngděng, wǒ dōu huì zuò.
result.english: Washing dishes, cleaning my room, taking out the trash and so on, I do them all.

segments.traditional: 台灣有哪些好吃的水果？請你給我介紹介紹吧！
segments.simplified: 台湾有哪些好吃的水果？请你给我介绍介绍吧！

repairs.note: 跟 means "with" or "and". Giving examples starts with 像.
等一下 means "in a moment". "And so on" after a list is 等等.
和 goes between the last two things, not before or after the list.

items.fallbackRepair: 像 opens the examples and 等等 closes them.

result.traditional: 像西瓜、香蕉、橘子等等，都很好吃。
result.pinyin: Xiàng xīguā, xiāngjiāo, júzi děngděng, dōu hěn hǎochī.
result.english: Watermelons, bananas, tangerines and so on are all delicious.

segments.traditional: 請問，您要出租的公寓有家具嗎？
segments.simplified: 请问，您要出租的公寓有家具吗？

repairs.note: 和 goes between the last two things, not after the list. An open list ends with 等等.
等一下 means "in a moment". "And so on" after a list is 等等.
Here 還是 would mean "or" or "still". All the furniture listed takes 都.

items.fallbackRepair: 等等 closes the list, and 都 sums it up: …等等，都是新的.

result.pinyin: Yǒu chuáng, zhuōzi, yǐzi děngděng, dōu shì xīn de.

segments.traditional: 良介參加了鋼琴社、吉他社、愛心服務社
segments.simplified: 良介参加了钢琴社、吉他社、爱心服务社

repairs.note: Before the total (三個社團) the list is closed with 等, not 等等.
和 goes between the last two things, not after the list. Before the total, the list is closed with 等.
都 sums up before a verb. Before the total, the list is closed with 等.
