This pattern is used in situations, such as denying another person’s opinion, emphasizing the fact or an expression showing the expected result finally happens. “可” also carries the meaning of “be sure to” and “remind someone to do something”, e.g., “可別忘了！” and “可要記得！”

text.traditional: A：對不起，我來晚了。B：你可來了，我等你等了半天了。
text.simplified: A：对不起，我来晚了。B：你可来了，我等你等了半天了。
text.pinyin: A: Duìbùqǐ, wǒ lái wǎn le. B: Nǐ kě lái le, wǒ děng nǐ děng le bàntiān le.
text.english: A: Sorry I’m late. B: You finally came! I’ve been waiting for you for ages.

text.traditional: A：怎麼那麼多人喜歡看韓劇？真是太無聊了。B：韓劇在台灣可流行呢！大家都愛看！
text.simplified: A：怎么那么多人喜欢看韩剧？真是太无聊了。B：韩剧在台湾可流行呢！大家都爱看！
text.pinyin: A: Zěnme nàme duō rén xǐhuān kàn Hánjù? Zhēnshì tài wúliáo le. B: Hánjù zài Táiwān kě liúxíng ne! Dàjiā dōu ài kàn!
text.english: A: Why do so many people like Korean dramas? They’re so boring. B: Korean dramas are really popular in Taiwan! Everyone loves watching them!

text.traditional: 孩子：我明天就要出國留學了。父親：你可別忘了帶護照喔！要不然會上不了飛機的。
text.simplified: 孩子：我明天就要出国留学了。父亲：你可别忘了带护照喔！要不然会上不了飞机的。
text.pinyin: Háizi: Wǒ míngtiān jiùyào chūguó liúxué le. Fùqīn: Nǐ kě bié wàngle dài hùzhào o! Yàobùrán huì shàng bùliǎo fēijī de.
text.english: Child: I’m leaving to study abroad tomorrow. Father: Be sure not to forget your passport! Otherwise, you won’t be able to board the plane.

segments.traditional: 你媽媽的年糕和蘿蔔糕，做得好吃嗎？
segments.simplified: 你妈妈的年糕和萝卜糕，做得好吃吗？

segments.traditional: 我媽媽做的年糕和蘿蔔糕
segments.simplified: 我妈妈做的年糕和萝卜糕

repairs.note: 可以 means "may" or "can". Here the word that adds force before the quality is 可.
嗎 asks a yes/no question. B is answering with force: 可好吃呢！
可能 means "maybe". B is sure, so the word that adds force before the quality is 可.

items.fallbackRepair: 可 before the quality, and 呢 at the very end: 可好吃呢！

result.traditional: 我媽媽做的年糕和蘿蔔糕可好吃呢！
result.simplified: 我妈妈做的年糕和萝卜糕可好吃呢！
result.pinyin: Wǒ māma zuò de niángāo hé luóbogāo kě hǎochī ne!
result.english: The rice cake and radish cake my mom makes are really delicious!

segments.traditional: 你記得教授說什麼時候要把報告交給他嗎？
segments.simplified: 你记得教授说什么时候要把报告交给他吗？

repairs.note: 可以 means "may" or "can". A strong reminder puts 可 before 要.
B wants A to remember the date, not to forget it: 可要記得.
嗎 asks a yes/no question. B is giving a strong reminder.

items.fallbackRepair: 可 first, then 要, then the verb: 你可要記得！

result.traditional: 是下星期一，你可要記得！
result.simplified: 是下星期一，你可要记得！
result.pinyin: Shì xià xīngqíyī, nǐ kě yào jìde!
result.english: It's next Monday. Be sure to remember!

segments.traditional: 莫以凡是義大利人，他的中國功夫學得怎麼樣？
segments.simplified: 莫以凡是义大利人，他的中国功夫学得怎么样？

repairs.note: 可以 means "may" or "can". Here the word that adds force before the quality is 可.
This strong comment closes with 了: 可好了！
嗎 asks a yes/no question. B is answering with force: 可好了！

items.fallbackRepair: 可 before the quality, and 了 at the end: 學得可好了！

result.traditional: 他學得可好了！
result.simplified: 他学得可好了！
result.pinyin: Tā xué de kě hǎo le!
result.english: He has learned it really well!

summary: 可 adds emphasis to the verb or state verb after it.
It is used to deny someone's opinion, stress a fact, or show that an expected result finally happened.
It can also mean be sure to, or remind someone to do something.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: The Thing that Confucius Did Not Know
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Count an action with a measure word such as 拳, 眼, or 口.
grammarPages.pattern: V（+了）+ 一 + M
grammarPages.explanation: The measure word in this pattern, referred to as MV, “Measure word for verbs”, is used to indicate the unit of times of actions, such as “眼”, “腳”, “拳(quán, fist)”, “口”, “次”, “遍”, etc.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The measure word in this pattern, referred to as MV, “Measure word for verbs”, is used to indicate the unit of times of actions, such as “眼”, “腳”, “拳(quán, fist)”, “口”, “次”, “遍”, etc.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The measure word in this pattern, referred to as MV, “Measure word for verbs”, is used to indicate the unit of times of actions, such as “眼”, “腳”, “拳(quán, fist)”, “口”, “次”, “遍”, etc.

text.traditional: 弟弟很生氣，所以打了哥哥一拳。
text.simplified: 弟弟很生气，所以打了哥哥一拳。
text.pinyin: Dìdi hěn shēngqì, suǒyǐ dǎ le gēge yì quán.
text.english: My younger brother was angry, so he punched his older brother once.

text.traditional: 他看了我一眼，什麼話都沒說，就出去了。
text.simplified: 他看了我一眼，什么话都没说，就出去了。
text.pinyin: Tā kàn le wǒ yì yǎn, shénme huà dōu méi shuō, jiù chūqù le.
text.english: He glanced at me, didn’t say a word, and went out.

text.traditional: 客人：老闆，這個橘子甜不甜？我怕酸。老闆：我賣的橘子都很甜。你可以吃一口，不酸再買。
text.simplified: 客人：老板，这个橘子甜不甜？我怕酸。老板：我卖的橘子都很甜。你可以吃一口，不酸再买。
text.pinyin: Kèrén: Lǎobǎn, zhège júzi tián bù tián? Wǒ pà suān. Lǎobǎn: Wǒ mài de júzi dōu hěn tián. Nǐ kěyǐ chī yì kǒu, bù suān zài mǎi.
text.english: Customer: Boss, is this orange sweet? I’m afraid it’ll be sour. Owner: The oranges I sell are all sweet. You can take a bite; if it isn’t sour, buy it.

repairs.note: 一口 counts bites and sips (吃一口). A quick look is counted with 眼: 看了一眼.
一拳 counts punches (打了一拳). A quick look is counted with 眼: 看了一眼.

items.fallbackRepair: The verb, then 了, then 一 + the counting word: 看了一眼.

result.traditional: 弟弟不喜歡念書，看了一眼就跑出去玩了。
result.simplified: 弟弟不喜欢念书，看了一眼就跑出去玩了。
result.pinyin: Dìdi bù xǐhuān niànshū, kàn le yì yǎn jiù pǎo chūqù wán le.
result.english: My younger brother doesn't like studying; he took one look and ran out to play.

segments.traditional: 這個烤魷魚又鹹又辣，我
segments.simplified: 这个烤鱿鱼又咸又辣，我

repairs.note: 一眼 counts looks (看了一眼). A bite is counted with 口: 吃了一口.
一遍 counts doing something from start to finish (說一遍). A bite is counted with 口.
Grilled squid is eaten, not drunk: 吃.

items.fallbackRepair: The verb, then 了, then 一 + the counting word: 吃了一口.

result.traditional: 這個烤魷魚又鹹又辣，我吃了一口就不吃了。
result.simplified: 这个烤鱿鱼又咸又辣，我吃了一口就不吃了。
result.pinyin: Zhège kǎo yóuyú yòu xián yòu là, wǒ chī le yì kǒu jiù bù chī le.
result.english: This grilled squid is both salty and spicy; I took one bite and stopped eating.

segments.traditional: 老師，這個句子的文法有一點兒難，我不太懂。
segments.simplified: 老师，这个句子的文法有一点儿难，我不太懂。

repairs.note: 一眼 counts looks (看了一眼). Saying something through once more is 說一遍.
一口 counts bites and sips. Saying something through once more is 說一遍.
The teacher is the one who explains, so the teacher says it once more: 我再說一遍.

items.fallbackRepair: The verb, then 一 + the counting word: 說一遍.

result.traditional: 沒關係，我再說一遍，你就懂了。
result.simplified: 没关系，我再说一遍，你就懂了。
result.pinyin: Méiguānxi, wǒ zài shuō yí biàn, nǐ jiù dǒng le.
result.english: It's all right. I'll say it once more, and then you'll understand.

summary: A measure word for actions counts how many times an action happens.
Examples of these measure words are 拳, 眼, 口, 次 and 遍.
Put 一 and the measure word after the verb.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: The Thing that Confucius Did Not Know
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 下來 for downward movement, recording or acquiring something, or stopping/staying.
grammarPages.pattern: V + 下來
grammarPages.explanation: - To show the direction of a physical action, e.g., “跑下來” and “走下來”. - To write down, take note or to buy something, e.g., “記下來”, “寫下來” and “買下來”. - To stay or to stop the moving process, e.g., “住下來”, “留下來” and “停下來”.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: - To show the direction of a physical action, e.g., “跑下來” and “走下來”. - To write down, take note or to buy something, e.g., “記下來”, “寫下來” and “買下來”. - To stay or to stop the moving process, e.g., “住下來”, “留下來” and “停下來”.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: - To show the direction of a physical action, e.g., “跑下來” and “走下來”. - To write down, take note or to buy something, e.g., “記下來”, “寫下來” and “買下來”. - To stay or to stop the moving process, e.g., “住下來”, “留下來” and “停下來”.

text.traditional: 前面有人，快點兒把車停下來！
text.simplified: 前面有人，快点儿把车停下来！
text.pinyin: Qiánmiàn yǒu rén, kuài diǎnr bǎ chē tíng xiàlái!
text.english: There’s someone ahead. Hurry and stop the car!

text.traditional: 妹妹從二樓跑下來，到便利商店去買東西。
text.simplified: 妹妹从二楼跑下来，到便利商店去买东西。
text.pinyin: Mèimei cóng èr lóu pǎo xiàlái, dào biànlì shāngdiàn qù mǎi dōngxi.
text.english: My younger sister ran down from the second floor and went to the convenience store to buy something.

text.traditional: 上課的時候，我把老師的話寫下來，回家才可以複習。
text.simplified: 上课的时候，我把老师的话写下来，回家才可以复习。
text.pinyin: Shàngkè de shíhòu, wǒ bǎ lǎoshī de huà xiě xià lái, huí jiā cái kěyǐ fùxí.
text.english: During class, I write down what the teacher says so I can review it at home.

segments.traditional: 我在樓下叫了弟弟好幾次，他才從樓上慢慢地
segments.simplified: 我在楼下叫了弟弟好几次，他才从楼上慢慢地

repairs.note: He starts upstairs (從樓上), so he moves down, not up.
The speaker is downstairs, so he comes down toward the speaker: 下來.
寫下來 is writing something down. Coming down the stairs is 走下來.

items.fallbackRepair: The verb, then 下來: 走下來.

result.traditional: 我在樓下叫了弟弟好幾次，他才從樓上慢慢地走下來。
result.simplified: 我在楼下叫了弟弟好几次，他才从楼上慢慢地走下来。
result.pinyin: Wǒ zài lóuxià jiào le dìdi hǎojǐ cì, tā cái cóng lóushàng mànmàn de zǒu xiàlái.
result.english: I called my younger brother several times from downstairs before he slowly walked down.

segments.traditional: 開會的時候，員工們都把老闆說的話
segments.simplified: 开会的时候，员工们都把老板说的话

repairs.note: 停下來 is coming to a stop. Getting the boss's words onto paper is 寫下來.
走下來 is walking down. Getting the boss's words onto paper is 寫下來.
Getting something onto paper so that it stays there is 寫下來, not 寫起來.

items.fallbackRepair: The verb, then 下來: 寫下來.

result.traditional: 開會的時候，員工們都把老闆說的話寫下來了。
result.simplified: 开会的时候，员工们都把老板说的话写下来了。
result.pinyin: Kāihuì de shíhòu, yuángōngmen dōu bǎ lǎobǎn shuō de huà xiě xiàlái le.
result.english: During the meeting, the staff all wrote down what the boss said.

segments.traditional: 這個公寓又便宜又乾淨，我們
segments.simplified: 这个公寓又便宜又干净，我们

repairs.note: 租出去 is renting a place out to someone else. Taking it for yourselves is 租下來.
跑下來 is running down. Taking the apartment is 租下來.
Taking and keeping the apartment is 租下來, not 租起來.

items.fallbackRepair: The verb, then 下來: 租下來.

result.traditional: 這個公寓又便宜又乾淨，我們租下來吧！
result.simplified: 这个公寓又便宜又干净，我们租下来吧！
result.pinyin: Zhège gōngyù yòu piányí yòu gānjìng, wǒmen zū xiàlái ba!
result.english: This apartment is both cheap and clean. Let's take it!

summary: 下來 after a verb can show an action moving downward.
It can also mean writing something down or buying something, such as 記下來.
It can also mean stopping a movement and staying.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: The Thing that Confucius Did Not Know
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Right Away, No Hesitation: 說V就V
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe doing something readily, without much hesitation, or often.
grammarPages.pattern: 說 + V（+O）+ 就 + V（+O）
grammarPages.explanation: - This pattern is used to express doing something without much hesitation or consideration. - Used to indicate a situation that occurs easily or frequently.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: - This pattern is used to express doing something without much hesitation or consideration. - Used to indicate a situation that occurs easily or frequently.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: - This pattern is used to express doing something without much hesitation or consideration. - Used to indicate a situation that occurs easily or frequently.

text.traditional: 那個小男孩很愛哭，常常說哭就哭。
text.simplified: 那个小男孩很爱哭，常常说哭就哭。
text.pinyin: Nàge xiǎo nánhái hěn ài kū, chángcháng shuō kū jiù kū.
text.english: That little boy loves to cry; he often bursts into tears just like that.

text.traditional: 他很容易生氣，常常說生氣就生氣。
text.simplified: 他很容易生气，常常说生气就生气。
text.pinyin: Tā hěn róngyì shēngqì, chángcháng shuō shēngqì jiù shēngqì.
text.english: He gets angry easily and often gets angry in an instant.

text.traditional: A：我今天太累了，明天再運動吧。B：健身要說做就做，我們現在就去運動吧！
text.simplified: A：我今天太累了，明天再运动吧。B：健身要说做就做，我们现在就去运动吧！
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ jīntiān tài lèi le, míngtiān zài yùndòng ba. B: Jiànshēn yào shuō zuò jiù zuò, wǒmen xiànzài jiù qù yùndòng ba!
text.english: A: I’m too tired today. Let’s exercise tomorrow. B: When it comes to working out, you do it the moment you say you will. Let’s go exercise right now!

repairs.note: Something that happens at once, without warning, takes 就: 說下雨就下雨.
The pattern repeats the action after 就: 說下雨就下雨.

items.fallbackRepair: 說 + the action, then 就 + the same action: 說下雨就下雨.

result.traditional: 今天的天氣很奇怪，說下雨就下雨。
result.simplified: 今天的天气很奇怪，说下雨就下雨。
result.pinyin: Jīntiān de tiānqì hěn qíguài, shuō xiàyǔ jiù xiàyǔ.
result.english: The weather is strange today; it rains without any warning.

segments.traditional: 我很餓，什麼時候才可以吃飯？
segments.simplified: 我很饿，什么时候才可以吃饭？

segments.traditional: 好吧，那別等爸爸了，我們
segments.simplified: 好吧，那别等爸爸了，我们

repairs.note: Mom has just said 別等爸爸了, so what they do right away is eat: 說吃就吃.

items.fallbackRepair: 說 + the action, then 就 + the same action: 說吃就吃.

result.traditional: 好吧，那別等爸爸了，我們說吃就吃吧。
result.simplified: 好吧，那别等爸爸了，我们说吃就吃吧。
result.pinyin: Hǎo ba, nà bié děng bàba le, wǒmen shuō chī jiù chī ba.
result.english: All right, let's not wait for Dad then. Let's eat right now.

segments.traditional: 我想去孔廟看看，大家什麼時候有空可以一起去？
segments.simplified: 我想去孔庙看看，大家什么时候有空可以一起去？

repairs.note: A wants to go to the temple, away from where they are now: 去.

items.fallbackRepair: 說 + the action, then 就 + the same action: 說去就去.

result.traditional: 今天大家都有空，說去就去吧。
result.simplified: 今天大家都有空，说去就去吧。
result.pinyin: Jīntiān dàjiā dōu yǒukòng, shuō qù jiù qù ba.
result.english: Everyone is free today, so let's just go.

summary: 說 V 就 V says you do something right away, without much hesitation or thought.
It can also show that something happens easily or often.

items.title: Grammar 5 · The Thing that Confucius Did Not Know

dialogue.title: 短文 · 中國最偉大的老師——孔子 · The Greatest Teacher of China — Confucius

text.traditional: 有人說，不管是中國人或是外國人，想研究中國哲學，就必須先認識孔子，因為他是中國最偉大的教師。在台灣，九月二十八號「教師節」就是紀念他的節日。
text.simplified: 有人说，不管是中国人或是外国人，想研究中国哲学，就必须先认识孔子，因为他是中国最伟大的教师。在台湾，九月二十八号「教师节」就是纪念他的节日。
text.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō, bùguǎn shì Zhōngguó rén huòshì wàiguó rén, xiǎng yánjiù Zhōngguó zhéxué, jiù bìxū xiān rènshì Kǒngzǐ, yīnwèi tā shì Zhōngguó zuì wěidà de jiàoshī. Zài Táiwān, jiǔ yuè èrshíbā hào “Jiàoshījié” jiùshì jìniàn tā de jiérì.
text.english: Some people say that whether Chinese or foreigners, if they want to study Chinese philosophy, they must know Confucius first because he is the greatest teacher in China. In Taiwan, the Teacher's Day on September 28th is the holiday to commemorate him.

text.traditional: 孔子曾經和學生們去過很多國家，讓大家了解他的政治理想。雖然辛苦，可是這是他的選擇，因為他一輩子就是希望有君王能接受他的建議，用他的方法來管理國家。誰知道過了十三年，也等待了十三年，都沒有任何一位君王信他的話、明白他的想法。最後，孔子不得不回到自己的國家。那個時候，他已經六十八歲了。
text.simplified: 孔子曾经和学生们去过很多国家，让大家了解他的政治理想。虽然辛苦，可是这是他的选择，因为他一辈子就是希望有君王能接受他的建议，用他的方法来管理国家。谁知道过了十三年，也等待了十三年，都没有任何一位君王信他的话、明白他的想法。最后，孔子不得不回到自己的国家。那个时候，他已经六十八岁了。
text.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ céngjīng hé xuéshēng men qù guo hěn duō guójiā, ràng dàjiā liǎojiě tā de zhèngzhì lǐxiǎng. Suīrán xīnkǔ, kěshì zhè shì tā de xuǎnzé, yīnwèi tā yíbèizi jiùshì xīwàng yǒu jūnwáng néng jiēshòu tā de jiànyì, yòng tā de fāngfǎ lái guǎnlǐ guójiā. Shéi zhīdào guò le shísān nián, yě děngdài le shísān nián, dōu méiyǒu rènhé yí wèi jūnwáng xìn tā de huà, míngbái tā de xiǎngfǎ. Zuìhòu, Kǒngzǐ bùdébù huídào zìjǐ de guójiā. Nàge shíhòu, tā yǐjīng liùshíbā suì le.
text.english: Confucius had taken his students to many different countries, so that everyone could understand his political ideals. It was tough, but that was his choice, because throughout his life, he always hoped there would be a king who could take his advice and rule the country with his methods. Nobody had expected that after 13 years, and he had also been waiting for 13 years, none of the kings believed him and understood his thoughts. At last, Confucius had no choice but to return to his own country. At that time, he was already 68 years old.

text.traditional: 中國古代的思想很保守，有錢、有背景的人才可以去學校讀書，一般人是沒辦法的。可是對孔子來說，不管年紀大或是小、笨或是聰明、有錢或是沒有錢，只要想學習，他都願意教他們，讓大家都有念書和學習的機會。孔子也認為，必須先看學生的個性、表現和程度等等，再用不同的方法來教他們做人做事的道理。這樣，學生才能學得好、學得快。
text.simplified: 中国古代的思想很保守，有钱、有背景的人才可以去学校读书，一般人是没办法的。可是对孔子来说，不管年纪大或是小、笨或是聪明、有钱或是没有钱，只要想学习，他都愿意教他们，让大家都有念书和学习的机会。孔子也认为，必须先看学生的个性、表现和程度等等，再用不同的方法来教他们做人做事的道理。这样，学生才能学得好、学得快。
text.pinyin: Zhōngguó gǔdài de sīxiǎng hěn bǎoshǒu, yǒu qián, yǒu bèijǐng de rén cái kěyǐ qù xuéxiào dúshū, yìbān rén shì méibànfǎ de. Kěshì duì Kǒngzǐ lái shuō, bùguǎn niánjì dà huòshì xiǎo, bèn huòshì cōngmíng, yǒu qián huòshì méiyǒu qián, zhǐyào xiǎng xuéxí, tā dōu yuànyì jiāo tāmen, ràng dàjiā dōu yǒu niànshū hé xuéxí de jīhuì. Kǒngzǐ yě rènwéi, bìxū xiān kàn xuéshēng de gèxìng, biǎoxiàn hé chéngdù děngděng, zài yòng bùtóng de fāngfǎ lái jiāo tāmen zuòrénzuòshì de dàolǐ. Zhèyàng, xuéshēng cáinéng xué de hǎo, xué de kuài.
text.english: The thoughts in ancient China were very conservative. The rich and people with a privileged background could go to school while ordinary people were not allowed to. But for Confucius, no matter how old or young, stupid or clever, rich or poor, as long as they want to learn, he is willing to teach them, so that everyone has the opportunity to study and learn. Confucius also believes that we have to first identify students' personalities, performances and levels, and so on, and then use different methods to teach them the truth of conducting oneself and doing things. In this way, students can learn well and learn quickly.

text.traditional: 孔子用他的教育方法成功地教育了不少學生，他的政治、哲學思想不但影響了中國歷史和文化，而且也影響了日本、韓國、越南等國家。所以從以前到現在，大家都認為孔子是中國最偉大的老師。
text.simplified: 孔子用他的教育方法成功地教育了不少学生，他的政治、哲学思想不但影响了中国历史和文化，而且也影响了日本、韩国、越南等国家。所以从以前到现在，大家都认为孔子是中国最伟大的老师。
text.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ yòng tā de jiàoyù fāngfǎ chénggōng de jiàoyù le bùshǎo xuéshēng, tā de zhèngzhì, zhéxué sīxiǎng búdàn yǐngxiǎng le Zhōngguó lìshǐ hé wénhuà, érqiě yě yǐngxiǎng le Rìběn, Hánguó, Yuènán děng guójiā. Suǒyǐ cóng yǐqián dào xiànzài, dàjiā dōu rènwéi Kǒngzǐ shì Zhōngguó zuì wěidà de lǎoshī.
text.english: Confucius successfully educated many students with his educational methods. His political and philosophical thoughts not only affected the history and culture of China, but also affected countries such as Japan, South Korea, Vietnam, etc. So from the past to the present, everyone thinks that Confucius is the greatest teacher of China.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: The Thing that Confucius Did Not Know
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Who Would Have Thought: 誰知道
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 誰知道 to react to an unexpected outcome, not to ask for information.
grammarPages.pattern: 誰知道 + unexpected outcome
grammarPages.explanation: This pattern is used as a rhetorical question that does not aim to elicit an answer. It indicates that something happens unexpectedly.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern is used as a rhetorical question that does not aim to elicit an answer. It indicates that something happens unexpectedly.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern is used as a rhetorical question that does not aim to elicit an answer. It indicates that something happens unexpectedly.

text.traditional: A：你不是早就出門了嗎？為什麼遲到了？B：我七點就出門了，誰知道路上車那麼多！
text.simplified: A：你不是早就出门了吗？为什么迟到了？B：我七点就出门了，谁知道路上车那么多！
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ búshì zǎojiù chūmén le ma? Wèishénme chídào le? B: Wǒ qī diǎn jiù chūmén le, shéi zhīdào lùshang chē nàme duō!
text.english: A: Didn’t you leave early? Why were you late? B: I left at seven. Who knew there would be so much traffic!

text.traditional: A：聽說春節的高鐵票很難訂，你怎麼那麼順利就訂到了？B：我也以為很難訂，誰知道一下子就成功了。
text.simplified: A：听说春节的高铁票很难订，你怎么那么顺利就订到了？B：我也以为很难订，谁知道一下子就成功了。
text.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō Chūnjié de gāotiě piào hěn nán dìng, nǐ zěnme nàme shùnlì jiù dìng dào le? B: Wǒ yě yǐwéi hěn nán dìng, shéi zhīdào yíxiàzi jiù chénggōng le.
text.english: A: I heard it’s hard to book high-speed rail tickets for Lunar New Year. How did you book yours so easily? B: I thought it would be difficult too. Who knew I’d succeed right away?

text.traditional: A：你昨天在夜市怎麼花了一千多塊？太多了吧！B：我以為夜市的小吃都很便宜，誰知道有的很貴。
text.simplified: A：你昨天在夜市怎么花了一千多块？太多了吧！B：我以为夜市的小吃都很便宜，谁知道有的很贵。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ zuótiān zài yèshì zěnme huā le yìqiān duō kuài? Tài duō le ba! B: Wǒ yǐwéi yèshì de xiǎochī dōu hěn piányí, shéi zhīdào yǒude hěn guì.
text.english: A: How did you spend over a thousand dollars at the night market yesterday? That’s too much! B: I thought the snacks at the night market were all cheap. Who knew some would be expensive?

segments.traditional: 你已經打掃了一個上午了，怎麼還沒打掃好？
segments.simplified: 你已经打扫了一个上午了，怎么还没打扫好？

segments.traditional: 我以為很快就可以把房間打掃好，
segments.simplified: 我以为很快就可以把房间打扫好，

repairs.note: The cleaning is taking all morning, so the surprise is how dirty the room is.
B says 我以為…: B did not know. The surprise that follows opens with 誰知道.
What follows is not a result of what B expected. It is a surprise: 誰知道.

items.fallbackRepair: 誰知道 opens the surprise, then 這麼 + the quality.

result.traditional: 我以為很快就可以把房間打掃好，誰知道房間這麼髒。
result.simplified: 我以为很快就可以把房间打扫好，谁知道房间这么脏。
result.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi hěn kuài jiù kěyǐ bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo hǎo, shéi zhīdào fángjiān zhème zāng.
result.english: I thought I could get the room cleaned quickly; who knew the room was this dirty.

segments.traditional: 在台灣，要出租的房子不是都有家具嗎？
segments.simplified: 在台湾，要出租的房子不是都有家具吗？

repairs.note: 難怪 is "no wonder", for something now explained. B was surprised: 誰知道.
After 什麼 + noun, "none at all" takes 都: 什麼家具都沒有.
B is not giving a reason. What follows 我也以為有 is a surprise: 誰知道.

items.fallbackRepair: 誰知道 opens the surprise, then 什麼家具, then 都 before 沒有.

result.traditional: 我也以為有，誰知道我租的房子什麼家具都沒有。
result.simplified: 我也以为有，谁知道我租的房子什么家具都没有。
result.pinyin: Wǒ yě yǐwéi yǒu, shéi zhīdào wǒ zū de fángzi shénme jiājù dōu méiyǒu.
result.english: I thought so too; who knew the place I rented would have no furniture at all.

segments.traditional: 你怎麼沒買到新年去日本的機票？
segments.simplified: 你怎么没买到新年去日本的机票？

segments.traditional: 我十天前就上網訂過票了，
segments.simplified: 我十天前就上网订过票了，

repairs.note: 難怪 is "no wonder", for something now explained. B was surprised: 誰知道.
B could not get a ticket, so the tickets were already gone: 早就賣光了.
A says B did not get a ticket. The surprise is that they were sold out: 賣光.

items.fallbackRepair: 誰知道 opens the surprise, then 早就, then what had happened: 誰知道早就賣光了.

result.traditional: 我十天前就上網訂過票了，誰知道早就賣光了。
result.simplified: 我十天前就上网订过票了，谁知道早就卖光了。
result.pinyin: Wǒ shí tiān qián jiù shàngwǎng dìngguo piào le, shéi zhīdào zǎojiù màiguāng le.
result.english: I went online to book ten days ago; who knew they had long been sold out.

summary: 誰知道 says something happened unexpectedly.
Here it is a question that doesn't need an answer. Put the surprising result after it.

items.title: Grammar 1–4 · Friends from All Over the World

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Friends from All Over the World
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Very Much So: Vs 得很
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Emphasize a high degree, often to disagree with someone’s opinion.
grammarPages.pattern: Vs + 得 + 很
grammarPages.explanation: “得很” expresses a high degree. It is more common in conversations to show the speaker’s emphasis on a certain situation. This pattern is very close to “Vs 死了” and “Vs 得不得了” in meaning, but it is often used to show disapproval of someone’s opinion.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: “得很” expresses a high degree. It is more common in conversations to show the speaker’s emphasis on a certain situation. This pattern is very close to “Vs 死了” and “Vs 得不得了” in meaning, but it is often used to show disapproval of someone’s opinion.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “得很” expresses a high degree. It is more common in conversations to show the speaker’s emphasis on a certain situation. This pattern is very close to “Vs 死了” and “Vs 得不得了” in meaning, but it is often used to show disapproval of someone’s opinion.

text.traditional: 他的個性活潑得很，為什麼你覺得他很保守呢？
text.simplified: 他的个性活泼得很，为什么你觉得他很保守呢？
text.pinyin: Tā de gèxìng huópō de hěn, wèishénme nǐ juéde tā hěn bǎoshǒu ne?
text.english: His personality is very lively. Why do you think he is conservative?

text.traditional: 外國人：臭豆腐太臭了，我一口也不敢吃。台灣人：臭豆腐一點兒都不臭，好吃得很呢！
text.simplified: 外国人：臭豆腐太臭了，我一口也不敢吃。台湾人：臭豆腐一点儿都不臭，好吃得很呢！
text.pinyin: Wàiguórén: Chòu dòufǔ tài chòu le, wǒ yìkǒu yě bù gǎn chī. Táiwān rén: Chòu dòufǔ yìdiǎnr dōu bú chòu, hǎochī de hěn ne!
text.english: Foreigner: Stinky tofu smells so bad; I wouldn’t dare eat even one bite. Taiwanese: Stinky tofu doesn’t smell at all; it’s very tasty!

text.traditional: A：你等一下就要去見新老闆了，怎麼看起來無所謂的樣子。B：我緊張得很，你看不出來嗎？
text.simplified: A：你等一下就要去见新老板了，怎么看起来无所谓的样子。B：我紧张得很，你看不出来吗？
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ děng yíxià jiùyào qù jiàn xīn lǎobǎn le, zěnme kànqǐlái wúsuǒwèi de yàngzi. B: Wǒ jǐnzhāng de hěn, nǐ kàn bù chū lái ma?
text.english: A: You’re about to meet the new boss. Why do you look so unconcerned? B: I’m very nervous. Can’t you tell?

segments.traditional: 我覺得這個香水的味道不錯。
segments.simplified: 我觉得这个香水的味道不错。

repairs.note: He says 可是 and tells her not to buy it, so he finds the smell bad: 臭.
極 needs 了 after it (忙極了). This page's pattern is the quality + 得很.
非常 goes before a quality (非常臭). After it, "extremely" is 得很.

items.fallbackRepair: The quality first, then 得, then 很: 臭得很.

result.traditional: 可是我覺得臭得很！妳最好別買。
result.simplified: 可是我觉得臭得很！你最好别买。
result.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ juéde chòu de hěn! Nǐ zuìhǎo bié mǎi.
result.english: But I think it stinks! You'd better not buy it.

segments.traditional: 這個週末你有空嗎？我們去參觀孔廟吧！
segments.simplified: 这个周末你有空吗？我们去参观孔庙吧！

repairs.note: B does not want to go, so B is not free this weekend: 忙得很.
極 needs 了 after it (忙極了). This page's pattern is the quality + 得很.
地 links a describing word to a verb after it (慢慢地走). After a quality, "extremely" is 得很.

items.fallbackRepair: The quality first, then 得, then 很: 忙得很.

result.traditional: 這個週末我忙得很，我不想去！
result.simplified: 这个周末我忙得很，我不想去！
result.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò wǒ máng de hěn, wǒ bù xiǎng qù!
result.english: I'm extremely busy this weekend; I don't want to go!

segments.traditional: 我覺得小王笨死了，不能把算錢的工作交給他。
segments.simplified: 我觉得小王笨死了，不能把算钱的工作交给他。

repairs.note: B disagrees with A (是嗎？) and praises his work, so B finds him clever.
Vs死了 needs 了 and has no 得. Here the pattern is the quality + 得很.
極 needs 了 after it (忙極了). This page's pattern is the quality + 得很.

items.fallbackRepair: The quality first, then 得, then 很: 聰明得很.

result.traditional: 是嗎？我覺得他聰明得很，而且做事做得又快又好。
result.simplified: 是吗？我觉得他聪明得很，而且做事做得又快又好。
result.pinyin: Shì ma? Wǒ juéde tā cōngmíng de hěn, érqiě zuòshì zuò de yòu kuài yòu hǎo.
result.english: Really? I think he is very clever, and he works both fast and well.

summary: 得很 shows a high degree. It is more common in conversation, to stress a situation.
It is close in meaning to 死了 and 得不得了, but is often used to show disapproval of someone's opinion.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Friends from All Over the World
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say a decision depends on the condition after 看.
grammarPages.pattern: 得看／要看 + condition
grammarPages.explanation: This pattern indicates what someone will do depends on the situation after “看”. “看” is often followed by phrases or nouns, including (1) question word, (2) A not A, (3) two opposite monosyllabic words.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern indicates what someone will do depends on the situation after “看”. “看” is often followed by phrases or nouns, including (1) question word, (2) A not A, (3) two opposite monosyllabic words.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern indicates what someone will do depends on the situation after “看”. “看” is often followed by phrases or nouns, including (1) question word, (2) A not A, (3) two opposite monosyllabic words.

text.traditional: A：你這個週末要加班嗎？B：不知道，得看老闆的決定。
text.simplified: A：你这个周末要加班吗？B：不知道，得看老板的决定。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ zhè ge zhōumò yào jiābān ma? B: Bù zhīdào, děi kàn lǎobǎn de juédìng.
text.english: A: Do you have to work overtime this weekend? B: I don’t know. It depends on the boss’s decision.

text.traditional: A：你什麼冰淇淋都喜歡嗎？B：不一定，要看是哪一種口味的。
text.simplified: A：你什么冰淇淋都喜欢吗？B：不一定，要看是哪一种口味的。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ shénme bīngqílín dōu xǐhuān ma? B: Bù yí dìng, yào kàn shì nǎ yìzhǒng kǒuwèi de.
text.english: A: Do you like every kind of ice cream? B: Not necessarily. It depends on which flavor it is.

text.traditional: A：我暑假想到國外去旅行，你建議去哪裡？B：得看機票價格的高低，便宜的話就去歐洲。
text.simplified: A：我暑假想到国外去旅行，你建议去哪里？B：得看机票价格的高低，便宜的话就去欧洲。
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ shǔjià xiǎngdào guówài qù lǚxíng, nǐ jiànyì qù nǎlǐ? B: Děi kàn jīpiào jiàgé de gāodī, piányí de huà jiù qù Ōuzhōu.
text.english: A: I’m thinking of traveling abroad this summer. Where do you recommend? B: It depends on how much the airfare costs; if it’s cheap, go to Europe.

segments.traditional: 週末你想去海邊走走嗎？
segments.simplified: 周末你想去海边走走吗？

repairs.note: After 得看 comes something still open, as a question: 好不好.
After 得看 the open question is a choice form (好不好), not a 嗎 question.
看到 is seeing something. "It depends on" is 得看.

items.fallbackRepair: 得看 first, then the open question: 得看天氣好不好.

result.traditional: 得看天氣好不好。
result.simplified: 得看天气好不好。
result.pinyin: Děi kàn tiānqì hǎo bù hǎo.
result.english: It depends on whether the weather is good.

segments.traditional: 老闆要你去非洲工作，你願意嗎？
segments.simplified: 老板要你去非洲工作，你愿意吗？

repairs.note: After 要看 comes something still open, as a question: 多久.
要是 means "if". "It depends on" is 要看.
看見 is seeing something. "It depends on" is 要看.

items.fallbackRepair: 要看 first, then the open question: 要看要去多久.

result.traditional: 那要看要去多久。
result.pinyin: Nà yào kàn yào qù duōjiǔ.
result.english: That depends on how long I would have to go for.

segments.traditional: 世界文化日那天，你想跟我一起表演嗎？
segments.simplified: 世界文化日那天，你想跟我一起表演吗？

repairs.note: 什麼的 closes a list of examples. Here the open question is 什麼.
After 得看 the open question uses a question word (什麼), not 嗎.
看到 is seeing something. "It depends on" is 得看.

items.fallbackRepair: 得看 first, then the open question: 得看要表演什麼.

result.traditional: 得看要表演什麼。
result.simplified: 得看要表演什么。
result.pinyin: Děi kàn yào biǎoyǎn shénme.
result.english: It depends on what we would perform.

summary: 得看 or 要看 says what someone will do depends on the situation after 看.
After 看 you can have a phrase or noun, such as a question word, A-not-A, or two opposite one-syllable words.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Friends from All Over the World
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Such As… and So On: 像…什麼的
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Give examples while signaling that the list continues.
grammarPages.pattern: 像 + 2–3 examples + 什麼的
grammarPages.explanation: When the speaker gives examples for further explanation, the “像……什麼的” pattern is often used. “什麼的” implies that there is a long list of examples, but the speaker often gives only 2-3 items due to limited space or time.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: When the speaker gives examples for further explanation, the “像……什麼的” pattern is often used. “什麼的” implies that there is a long list of examples, but the speaker often gives only 2-3 items due to limited space or time.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: When the speaker gives examples for further explanation, the “像……什麼的” pattern is often used. “什麼的” implies that there is a long list of examples, but the speaker often gives only 2-3 items due to limited space or time.

text.traditional: 他會很多種樂器，像鋼琴、吉他、笛子什麼的。
text.simplified: 他会很多种乐器，像钢琴、吉他、笛子什么的。
text.pinyin: Tā huì hěn duō zhǒng yuèqì, xiàng gāngqín, jítā, dízi shénme de.
text.english: He can play many instruments, such as piano, guitar, flute, and so on.

text.traditional: 媽媽準備了很豐富的年夜飯，像蘿蔔糕、水餃、烤鴨什麼的。
text.simplified: 妈妈准备了很丰富的年夜饭，像萝卜糕、水饺、烤鸭什么的。
text.pinyin: Māma zhǔnbèi le hěn fēngfù de niányèfàn, xiàng luóbogāo, shuǐjiǎo, kǎoyā shénme de.
text.english: Mom prepared a very plentiful New Year’s Eve dinner, with things like turnip cake, dumplings, roast duck, and so on.

text.traditional: 台灣的食物，像雞排、水煎包、滷肉飯什麼的，都是很受歡迎的小吃。
text.simplified: 台湾的食物，像鸡排、水煎包、卤肉饭什么的，都是很受欢迎的小吃。
text.pinyin: Táiwān de shíwù, xiàng jīpái, shuǐ jiān bāo, lǔròu fàn shénme de, dōu shì hěn shòu huānyíng de xiǎochī.
text.english: Taiwanese foods such as fried chicken cutlets, pan-fried buns, braised pork rice, and so on are all popular snacks.

repairs.note: The examples are fruit. Cake is not a fruit.
A list of examples closes with 什麼的, not 什麼 alone.
跟 means "with" or "and". Examples open with 像.

items.fallbackRepair: 像 opens the examples and 什麼的 closes them.

result.traditional: 他很喜歡吃水果，像西瓜、香蕉、橘子什麼的。
result.simplified: 他很喜欢吃水果，像西瓜、香蕉、橘子什么的。
result.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuān chī shuǐguǒ, xiàng xīguā, xiāngjiāo, júzi shénme de.
result.english: He loves eating fruit, like watermelon, bananas, tangerines and so on.

segments.traditional: 李教授會說不少國家的語言，
segments.simplified: 李教授会说不少国家的语言，

repairs.note: 好像 means "it seems". Examples open with 像.
A list of examples closes with 什麼的, not 什麼 alone.
和 goes between the last two things, not before or after the list.

items.fallbackRepair: 像 opens the examples and 什麼的 closes them.

result.traditional: 李教授會說不少國家的語言，像英文、日文、法文什麼的，都說得不錯。
result.simplified: 李教授会说不少国家的语言，像英文、日文、法文什么的，都说得不错。
result.pinyin: Lǐ jiàoshòu huì shuō bùshǎo guójiā de yǔyán, xiàng Yīngwén, Rìwén, Fǎwén shénme de, dōu shuō de búcuò.
result.english: Professor Li can speak the languages of quite a few countries, like English, Japanese, French and so on, all quite well.

segments.traditional: 這家店賣很多 3C 產品，
segments.simplified: 这家店卖很多 3C 产品，

repairs.note: 好像 means "it seems". Examples open with 像.
A list of examples closes with 什麼的, not 什麼 alone.
像…一樣 says two things are alike. A list of examples closes with 什麼的.

items.fallbackRepair: 像 opens the examples and 什麼的 closes them.

result.traditional: 這家店賣很多 3C 產品，像手機、筆電、平板什麼的，你可以慢慢看。
result.simplified: 这家店卖很多 3C 产品，像手机、笔电、平板什么的，你可以慢慢看。
result.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn mài hěn duō 3C chǎnpǐn, xiàng shǒujī, bǐdiàn, píngbǎn shénme de, nǐ kěyǐ mànmàn kàn.
result.english: This shop sells a lot of 3C products, like cell phones, laptops, tablets and so on; take your time looking.

summary: 像 ... 什麼的 gives examples to explain further, and shows that the list is long.
Speakers often give only 2 to 3 items because of limited space or time.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Friends from All Over the World
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe an action repeated frequently over a short time.
grammarPages.pattern: V + 來 + V + 去
grammarPages.explanation: In this pattern, “來” and “去” are directional verbs, indicating an action is being repeated with high frequency in a short period of time. It can be used when someone is waiting or walking around. The two verbs here are often the same.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: In this pattern, “來” and “去” are directional verbs, indicating an action is being repeated with high frequency in a short period of time. It can be used when someone is waiting or walking around. The two verbs here are often the same.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: In this pattern, “來” and “去” are directional verbs, indicating an action is being repeated with high frequency in a short period of time. It can be used when someone is waiting or walking around. The two verbs here are often the same.

text.traditional: 他在門口走來走去，好像在等人。
text.simplified: 他在门口走来走去，好像在等人。
text.pinyin: Tā zài ménkǒu zǒu lái zǒu qù, hǎoxiàng zài děng rén.
text.english: He is pacing at the doorway as if he were waiting for someone.

text.traditional: 那三隻小狗跑來跑去，玩得很開心。
text.simplified: 那三只小狗跑来跑去，玩得很开心。
text.pinyin: Nà sān zhī xiǎogǒu pǎo lái pǎo qù, wán de hěn kāixīn.
text.english: Those three puppies run around and play happily.

text.traditional: 我看來看去，最後決定買那個台灣牌子的手機。
text.simplified: 我看来看去，最后决定买那个台湾牌子的手机。
text.pinyin: Wǒ kàn lái kàn qù, zuìhòu juédìng mǎi nà ge Táiwān páizi de shǒujī.
text.english: I looked at them over and over, and finally decided to buy that Taiwanese-brand cellphone.

practice.title: Complete the sentences with the words in the box.

repairs.note: Fish swim in the sea. They do not walk: 游.

items.fallbackRepair: The verb + 來, then the same verb + 去: 游來游去.

result.traditional: 小魚在大海裡游來游去，好自由喔！
result.simplified: 小鱼在大海里游来游去，好自由喔！
result.pinyin: Xiǎo yú zài dàhǎi lǐ yóu lái yóu qù, hǎo zìyóu ō!
result.english: The little fish swim back and forth in the sea, so free!

repairs.note: A snake has no legs to jump with. It crawls: 爬.

items.fallbackRepair: The verb + 來, then the same verb + 去: 爬來爬去.

result.traditional: 動物園的蛇在草地上爬來爬去，好可怕！
result.simplified: 动物园的蛇在草地上爬来爬去，好可怕！
result.pinyin: Dòngwùyuán de shé zài cǎodì shàng pá lái pá qù, hǎo kěpà!
result.english: The snakes at the zoo crawl back and forth on the grass, how scary!

repairs.note: 騎 is for bicycles and horses. A door is pulled: 拉.

items.fallbackRepair: The verb + 來, then the same verb + 去: 拉來拉去.

result.traditional: 那個門被你用力地拉來拉去，一下子就壞了。
result.simplified: 那个门被你用力地拉来拉去，一下子就坏了。
result.pinyin: Nàge mén bèi nǐ yònglì de lā lái lā qù, yíxiàzi jiù huài le.
result.english: You pulled that door back and forth so hard that it broke in no time.

segments.traditional: 一開始那幾個孩子邊玩邊開玩笑，後來
segments.simplified: 一开始那几个孩子边玩边开玩笑，后来

repairs.note: Swimming about does not lead to a fight. What does is pushing each other: 推.

items.fallbackRepair: The verb + 來, then the same verb + 去: 推來推去.

result.traditional: 一開始那幾個孩子邊玩邊開玩笑，後來推來推去，不久就打起來了。
result.simplified: 一开始那几个孩子边玩边开玩笑，后来推来推去，不久就打起来了。
result.pinyin: Yìkāishǐ nà jǐ ge háizi biān wán biān kāiwánxiào, hòulái tuī lái tuī qù, bùjiǔ jiù dǎ qǐlái le.
result.english: At first those children were playing and joking, then they started pushing each other back and forth, and soon they were fighting.

segments.traditional: ，趁沒人的時候把食物偷走了。
segments.simplified: ，趁没人的时候把食物偷走了。

repairs.note: Mice cannot fly. They run about: 跑.

items.fallbackRepair: The verb + 來, then the same verb + 去: 跑來跑去.

result.traditional: 老鼠半夜在廚房裡跑來跑去，趁沒人的時候把食物偷走了。
result.simplified: 老鼠半夜在厨房里跑来跑去，趁没人的时候把食物偷走了。
result.pinyin: Lǎoshǔ bànyè zài chúfáng lǐ pǎo lái pǎo qù, chèn méi rén de shíhòu bǎ shíwù tōuzǒu le.
result.english: The mice ran back and forth in the kitchen in the middle of the night and stole the food while no one was around.

summary: V 來 V 去 shows an action repeated many times in a short time.
It is used when someone is waiting or walking around.
The two verbs are often the same.

dialogue.title: 對話 · 世界各國的朋友 · Friends from All Over the World

text.traditional: （良介和可欣在宿舍門口，聊天）
text.simplified: （良介和可欣在宿舍门口，聊天）
text.pinyin: (Liángjiè hé Kěxīn zài sùshè ménkǒu, liáotiān)
text.english: (In front of the dormitory, Ryosuke and Kexin are chatting.)

text.traditional: 下個星期二中午，華語文中心要舉辦世界文化日，我想請妳跟美心來參加。
text.simplified: 下个星期二中午，华语文中心要举办世界文化日，我想请你跟美心来参加。
text.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqí'èr zhōngwǔ, Huáyǔwén Zhōngxīn yào jǔbàn Shìjiè Wénhuàrì, wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ gēn Měixīn lái cānjiā.
text.english: Next Tuesday noon, the Center of Chinese Language and Culture is going to hold the World Culture Appreciation Day. I would like to invite you and Meixin to participate.

text.traditional: 好玩嗎？活動的內容是什麼？
text.simplified: 好玩吗？活动的内容是什么？
text.pinyin: Hǎowán ma? Huódòng de nèiróng shì shénme?
text.english: Is it fun? What's the content of the event?

text.traditional: 外國學生要擺攤子或表演唱歌跳舞，向大家介紹自己民族文化的特色。
text.simplified: 外国学生要摆摊子或表演唱歌跳舞，向大家介绍自己民族文化的特色。
text.pinyin: Wàiguó xuéshēng yào bǎi tānzi huò biǎoyǎn chànggē tiàowǔ, xiàng dàjiā jièshào zìjǐ mínzú wénhuà de tèsè.
text.english: Foreign students will set up stalls or have dancing and singing performances to introduce the features of their own national cultures.

text.traditional: 聽起來很有意思，你有上次的照片嗎？
text.simplified: 听起来很有意思，你有上次的照片吗？
text.pinyin: Tīngqǐlái hěn yǒuyìsi, nǐ yǒu shàng cì de zhàopiàn ma?
text.english: Sounds interesting. Do you have any photo from last time?

text.traditional: 有啊！妳看，這張照片就是去年日本學生的攤子。他們穿著日本的傳統服裝，向大家介紹日本的食物跟玩具。
text.simplified: 有啊！你看，这张照片就是去年日本学生的摊子。他们穿着日本的传统服装，向大家介绍日本的食物跟玩具。
text.pinyin: Yǒu a! Nǐ kàn, zhè zhāng zhàopiàn jiùshì qùnián Rìběn xuéshēng de tānzi. Tāmen chuān zhe Rìběn de chuántǒng fúzhuāng, xiàng dàjiā jièshào Rìběn de shíwù gēn wánjù.
text.english: I do! Look! This photo shows the stall of Japanese students last year. They were introducing Japanese food and toys in traditional Japanese clothes to everybody.

text.traditional: （美心跟以凡走過來）
text.simplified: （美心跟以凡走过来）
text.pinyin: (Měixīn gēn Yǐfán zǒu guò lái)
text.english: (Meixin and Yifan come over.)

text.traditional: 你們在看什麼啊？（仔細地看著照片）這個東西看起來怪怪的，是吃的嗎？
text.simplified: 你们在看什么啊？（仔细地看着照片）这个东西看起来怪怪的，是吃的吗？
text.pinyin: Nǐmen zài kàn shénme a? (Zǐxì de kàn zhe zhàopiàn) Zhège dōngxi kànqǐlái guài guài de, shì chī de ma?
text.english: What are you looking at? (Looks carefully at the photo.) This stuff looks strange. Is it food?

text.traditional: 這是日本的納豆。我第一次去日本的時候，飯店的早餐有納豆，可是我嚐了一口就不敢吃了。
text.simplified: 这是日本的纳豆。我第一次去日本的时候，饭店的早餐有纳豆，可是我尝了一口就不敢吃了。
text.pinyin: Zhè shì Rìběn de nàdòu. Wǒ dì yī cì qù Rìběn de shíhòu, fàndiàn de zǎocān yǒu nàdòu, kěshì wǒ cháng le yìkǒu jiù bù gǎn chī le.
text.english: This is Japanese Natto. When I went traveling in Japan for the first time, the hotel breakfast had Natto. I had a taste and dared not eat more.

text.traditional: 納豆雖然聞起來有一點兒臭，不過對身體很好。
text.simplified: 纳豆虽然闻起来有一点儿臭，不过对身体很好。
text.pinyin: Nàdòu suīrán wén qǐlái yǒuyìdiǎnr chòu, búguò duì shēntǐ hěn hǎo.
text.english: Although Natto is a bit smelly, it's very good for your body.

text.traditional: 可是上次去夜市的時候，你說臭豆腐臭得很，連一口也不吃！
text.simplified: 可是上次去夜市的时候，你说臭豆腐臭得很，连一口也不吃！
text.pinyin: Kěshì shàng cì qù yèshì de shíhòu, nǐ shuō chòu dòufǔ chòu de hěn, lián yìkǒu yě bù chī!
text.english: But last time when we went to the night market, you said stinky tofu is very smelly, and you didn't even take one bite!

text.traditional: 其實食物好不好吃，得看個人的口味。我很喜歡納豆，可是臭豆腐真的太……
text.simplified: 其实食物好不好吃，得看个人的口味。我很喜欢纳豆，可是臭豆腐真的太……
text.pinyin: Qíshí shíwù hǎo bù hǎo chī, děi kàn gèrén de kǒuwèi. Wǒ hěn xǐhuān nàdòu, kěshì chòu dòufǔ zhēnde tài…
text.english: In fact, whether a kind of food is yummy or not depends on personal tastes. I like Natto very much, but stinky tofu is just too...

text.traditional: 好好好，你們別吵了。良介，文化日那天，有好看的表演嗎？
text.simplified: 好好好，你们别吵了。良介，文化日那天，有好看的表演吗？
text.pinyin: Hǎo hǎohǎo, nǐmen bié chǎo le. Liángjiè, Wénhuà rì nà tiān, yǒu hǎokàn de biǎoyǎn ma?
text.english: Alright, alright! Don't argue. Ryosuke, is there going to be any good performance on the World Culture Appreciation Day?

text.traditional: 有啊！像唱歌、跳舞什麼的，我們日本同學要一邊吹笛子，一邊跳舞。
text.simplified: 有啊！像唱歌、跳舞什么的，我们日本同学要一边吹笛子，一边跳舞。
text.pinyin: Yǒu a! Xiàng chànggē, tiàowǔ shénme de, wǒmen Rìběn tóngxué yào yìbiān chuī dízi, yìbiān tiàowǔ.
text.english: Yes! Like singing, dancing, and so on. Our Japanese classmates are going to play the flute while dancing.

text.traditional: 你們好厲害喔！我昨天經過華語文中心的時候，看到很多外國學生走來走去，說著不同的語言，其中有一個學生用中文跟我說「妳好」，真有意思！
text.simplified: 你们好厉害喔！我昨天经过华语文中心的时候，看到很多外国学生走来走去，说着不同的语言，其中有一个学生用中文跟我说「你好」，真有意思！
text.pinyin: Nǐmen hǎo lìhài o! Wǒ zuótiān jīngguò Huáyǔwén Zhōngxīn de shíhòu, kàndào hěn duō wàiguó xuéshēng zǒu lái zǒu qù, shuō zhe bùtóng de yǔyán, qízhōng yǒu yíge xuéshēng yòng Zhōngwén gēn wǒ shuō “nǐ hǎo”, zhēn yǒuyìsi!
text.english: You are so amazing! Yesterday, when I passed by the Center of Chinese Language and Culture, I saw many foreign students walking around and speaking different languages. One of the students said "Hello" to me in Chinese. Very interesting!

text.traditional: 我下個月也要在華語文中心學中文，希望能把中文學得更好，這樣才能更加了解中華文化。
text.simplified: 我下个月也要在华语文中心学中文，希望能把中文学得更好，这样才能更加了解中华文化。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xià ge yuè yě yào zài Huáyǔwén Zhōngxīn xué Zhōngwén, xīwàng néng bǎ Zhōngwén xué de gèng hǎo, zhèyàng cáinéng gèngjiā liǎojiě Zhōnghuá wénhuà.
text.english: I will also study Chinese at the Center of Chinese Language and Culture next month, hoping to improve my Chinese and in this way, I can understand more about Chinese culture.

text.traditional: 太好了！歡迎你來。每個國家都有特別的風俗習慣，我的同學有亞洲人、歐洲人、非洲人，大家互相交流、學習，就像是一個熱鬧的大家庭。
text.simplified: 太好了！欢迎你来。每个国家都有特别的风俗习惯，我的同学有亚洲人、欧洲人、非洲人，大家互相交流、学习，就像是一个热闹的大家庭。
text.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Huānyíng nǐ lái. Měi ge guójiā dōu yǒu tèbié de fēngsú xíguàn, wǒ de tóngxué yǒu Yàzhōu rén, Ōuzhōu rén, Fēizhōu rén, dàjiā hùxiāng jiāoliú, xuéxí, jiù xiàng shì yíge rènao de dà jiātíng.
text.english: Every country has its own special customs. I have Asian, European and African classmates. We share and learn with each other, just like a big and lively family.

text.traditional: 說了半天，你還沒告訴我們文化日的地點呢！
text.simplified: 说了半天，你还没告诉我们文化日的地点呢！
text.pinyin: Shuō le bàntiān, nǐ háiméi gàosu wǒmen Wénhuà rì de dìdiǎn ne!
text.english: We've been talking for a long time, but you still haven't told us the venue of the World Culture Appreciation Day!

text.traditional: 在學校的大禮堂，就是上次鋼琴社表演的會場。想參加的話，要快點兒去辦公室報名喔！
text.simplified: 在学校的大礼堂，就是上次钢琴社表演的会场。想参加的话，要快点儿去办公室报名喔！
text.pinyin: Zài xuéxiào de dà lǐtáng, jiùshì shàng cì gāngqín shè biǎoyǎn de huìchǎng. Xiǎng cānjiā dehuà, yào kuài diǎnr qù bàngōngshì bàomíng o!
text.english: It's in the auditorium of the school – the place where the piano club performed last time. If you want to participate, hurry up and go to the office to register!

items.title: Grammar 5–6 · Friends from All Over the World

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Friends from All Over the World
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Can or Can’t Compare: 比得上／比不上
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say whether one thing can match or surpass another.
grammarPages.pattern: A + 比得上／比不上 + B
grammarPages.explanation: When drawing a comparison between A and B, if we say “A 比得上 B”, it means that A can compare with B or even surpass B.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: When drawing a comparison between A and B, if we say “A 比得上 B”, it means that A can compare with B or even surpass B.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: When drawing a comparison between A and B, if we say “A 比得上 B”, it means that A can compare with B or even surpass B.

text.traditional: 藍小姐覺得自己的家最溫暖，哪裡都比不上。
text.simplified: 蓝小姐觉得自己的家最温暖，哪里都比不上。
text.pinyin: Lán xiǎojiě juéde zìjǐ de jiā zuì wēnnuǎn, nǎlǐ dōu bǐ bú shàng.
text.english: Ms. Lan thinks her own home is the warmest; nowhere else compares.

text.traditional: 我覺得荷蘭鬆餅好吃極了，只有我奶奶做的甜點比得上。
text.simplified: 我觉得荷兰松饼好吃极了，只有我奶奶做的甜点比得上。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde Hélán sōngbǐng hǎochī jíle, zhǐyǒu wǒ nǎinai zuò de tiándiǎn bǐ de shàng.
text.english: I think Dutch pancakes are delicious; only the desserts my grandmother makes can compare.

text.traditional: 許多台灣人覺得滷肉飯最好吃，其他小吃都比不上。
text.simplified: 许多台湾人觉得卤肉饭最好吃，其他小吃都比不上。
text.pinyin: Xǔduō Táiwān rén juéde lǔròu fàn zuì hǎochī, qítā xiǎochī dōu bǐ bú shàng.
text.english: Many Taiwanese people think braised pork rice is the best; no other snack compares.

segments.traditional: 我媽媽很會做菜，她做的牛肉麵誰都
segments.simplified: 我妈妈很会做菜，她做的牛肉面谁都

repairs.note: Mom is a great cook, so nobody matches her noodles: 比不上.
"Cannot match" is 比不上, with 上.
"Cannot match" is 比不上, with 上.

items.fallbackRepair: 比, then 不, then 上: 比不上.

result.traditional: 我媽媽很會做菜，她做的牛肉麵誰都比不上。
result.simplified: 我妈妈很会做菜，她做的牛肉面谁都比不上。
result.pinyin: Wǒ māma hěn huì zuò cài, tā zuò de niúròu miàn shéi dōu bǐbúshàng.
result.english: My mom is a great cook; nobody can match the beef noodles she makes.

segments.traditional: 中國人認為最偉大的老師是孔子，沒有人
segments.simplified: 中国人认为最伟大的老师是孔子，没有人

repairs.note: 沒有人 is already negative. With 不 as well, everybody would match him. Nobody can: 沒有人比得上他.
"Can match" is 比得上, with 上.

items.fallbackRepair: 比, then 得, then 上, then the person: 比得上他.

result.traditional: 中國人認為最偉大的老師是孔子，沒有人比得上他。
result.simplified: 中国人认为最伟大的老师是孔子，没有人比得上他。
result.pinyin: Zhōngguó rén rènwéi zuì wěidà de lǎoshī shì Kǒngzǐ, méiyǒu rén bǐdeshàng tā.
result.english: Chinese people consider Confucius the greatest teacher; nobody can match him.

segments.traditional: 李小姐覺得非洲人跳舞跳得最棒，
segments.simplified: 李小姐觉得非洲人跳舞跳得最棒，

repairs.note: She thinks they are the best, so the others cannot match them: 比不上.
This says nobody else matches them, so it takes 都, not 才.

items.fallbackRepair: The others first, then 都, then 比不上, then the ones they are compared with.

result.traditional: 李小姐覺得非洲人跳舞跳得最棒，別的地方的人都比不上他們。
result.simplified: 李小姐觉得非洲人跳舞跳得最棒，别的地方的人都比不上他们。
result.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě juéde Fēizhōu rén tiàowǔ tiào de zuì bàng, biéde dìfāng de rén dōu bǐbúshàng tāmen.
result.english: Miss Li thinks Africans are the best dancers; people from other places can't match them.

summary: A 比得上 B means A can compare with B, or is even better.
A 比不上 B says A can't compare with B.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Friends from All Over the World
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Show that a result is possible only when its condition is met.
grammarPages.pattern: 只有 + necessary condition，才 + result
grammarPages.explanation: “只有” is followed by the necessary condition. This pattern emphasizes that only by fulfilling the condition can the result after “才” be achieved.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: “只有” is followed by the necessary condition. This pattern emphasizes that only by fulfilling the condition can the result after “才” be achieved.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “只有” is followed by the necessary condition. This pattern emphasizes that only by fulfilling the condition can the result after “才” be achieved.

text.traditional: 在便利商店買東西，只有滿七十九元，才能得到一張貼紙。
text.simplified: 在便利商店买东西，只有满七十九元，才能得到一张贴纸。
text.pinyin: Zài biànlì shāngdiàn mǎi dōngxi, zhǐyǒu mǎn qīshíjiǔ yuán, cáinéng dédào yì zhāng tiēzhǐ.
text.english: At a convenience store, you can get a sticker only when you spend at least 79 dollars.

text.traditional: 只有報名的學生，才可以參加這個文化日的活動。
text.simplified: 只有报名的学生，才可以参加这个文化日的活动。
text.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu bàomíng de xuéshēng, cái kěyǐ cānjiā zhè ge wénhuà rì de huódòng.
text.english: Only students who registered can take part in this Culture Day event.

text.traditional: 外國人：聽說孔子的知識很豐富，他的哲學思想大家都懂嗎？中國人：我想只有認真研究過他的思想，才能了解那些道理吧。
text.simplified: 外国人：听说孔子的知识很丰富，他的哲学思想大家都懂吗？中国人：我想只有认真研究过他的思想，才能了解那些道理吧。
text.pinyin: Wàiguórén: Tīngshuō Kǒngzǐ de zhīshì hěn fēngfù, tā de zhéxué sīxiǎng dàjiā dōu dǒng ma? Zhōngguó rén: Wǒ xiǎng zhǐyǒu rènzhēn yánjiù guo tā de sīxiǎng, cáinéng liǎojiě nàxiē dàolǐ ba.
text.english: Foreigner: I heard Confucius was very knowledgeable. Does everyone understand his philosophical ideas? Chinese person: I think only by seriously studying his ideas can people understand those principles.

segments.traditional: 你什麼時候回去爺爺奶奶家拜祖先？
segments.simplified: 你什么时候回去爷爷奶奶家拜祖先？

repairs.note: 只有 names the one condition, and its result takes 才, not 就.
只好 means having no other choice. Naming the one time B goes is 只有.
B goes at one time only, so the result takes 才, not 都.

items.fallbackRepair: 只有 before the one condition, 才 before the result.

result.traditional: 平常不去，只有過年的時候才回去。
result.simplified: 平常不去，只有过年的时候才回去。
result.pinyin: Píngcháng bú qù, zhǐyǒu guònián de shíhòu cái huíqù.
result.english: I don't usually go; I only go back at New Year.

segments.traditional: 在台灣，哪裡買得到中美洲的咖啡呢？
segments.simplified: 在台湾，哪里买得到中美洲的咖啡呢？

repairs.note: A asks where it can be bought. B names the one place where it can: 買得到.
只有 names the one condition, and its result takes 才, not 就.
只好 means having no other choice. Naming the one place is 只有.

items.fallbackRepair: 只有 before the one place, then 才, then the result: 只有在百貨公司才買得到.

result.traditional: 只有在百貨公司才買得到。
result.simplified: 只有在百货公司才买得到。
result.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu zài bǎihuò gōngsī cái mǎidedào.
result.english: You can only get it in department stores.

segments.traditional: 我希望有一個美好的未來，您能給我什麼建議嗎？
segments.simplified: 我希望有一个美好的未来，您能给我什么建议吗？

repairs.note: 只有 names the one condition, and its result takes 才, not 就.
A good future comes from working hard while young, not from not working.
只好 means having no other choice. The one condition for a result opens with 只有.

items.fallbackRepair: 只有 before the one condition, 才 before the result.

result.traditional: 只有趁年輕的時候多努力，才會有美好的未來。
result.simplified: 只有趁年轻的时候多努力，才会有美好的未来。
result.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu chèn niánqīng de shíhòu duō nǔlì, cái huì yǒu měihǎo de wèilái.
result.english: Only by working hard while you are young will you have a bright future.

summary: 只有 gives a condition that must be met. The result after 才 happens only if it is met.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 熱鬧的世界文化日！ · The Lively World Culture Appreciation Day!

text.traditional: 華語文中心要舉辦世界文化日，邀請所有的老師、學生來參加。各國學生要照中心的安排，表演有特色的節目。學校也會準備一些簡單的食物，像三明治、水餃等等，歡迎大家來看表演、吃小吃。
text.simplified: 华语文中心要举办世界文化日，邀请所有的老师、学生来参加。各国学生要照中心的安排，表演有特色的节目。学校也会准备一些简单的食物，像三明治、水饺等等，欢迎大家来看表演、吃小吃。
text.pinyin: Huáyǔwén Zhōngxīn yào jǔbàn Shìjiè Wénhuàrì, yāoqǐng suǒyǒu de lǎoshī, xuéshēng lái cānjiā. Gè guó xuéshēng yào zhào Zhōngxīn de ānpái, biǎoyǎn yǒu tèsè de jiémù. Xuéxiào yě huì zhǔnbèi yìxiē jiǎndān de shíwù, xiàng sānmíngzhì, shuǐjiǎo děngděng, huānyíng dàjiā lái kàn biǎoyǎn, chī xiǎochī.
text.english: The Center of Chinese Language and Culture held the World Culture Appreciation Day and all teachers and students were invited to participate. Students from various countries had to give special performances according to the arrangement of the Center. The Center also provided some simple food, such as sandwiches, dumplings, and so on. Everybody was welcome to watch the performances and have some snacks.

text.traditional: 良介要用跳舞的方式，表演日本東北的傳統歌曲；荷蘭同學要介紹鬆餅和啤酒的做法；越南同學想做影片來介紹他們的文化。一開始，良介很擔心跳不好，常常留在學校練習，後來就越跳越好了。
text.simplified: 良介要用跳舞的方式，表演日本东北的传统歌曲；荷兰同学要介绍松饼和啤酒的做法；越南同学想做影片来介绍他们的文化。一开始，良介很担心跳不好，常常留在学校练习，后来就越跳越好了。
text.pinyin: Liángjiè yào yòng tiàowǔ de fāngshì, biǎoyǎn Rìběn Dōngběi de chuántǒng gēqǔ; Hélán tóngxué yào jièshào sōngbǐng hé píjiǔ de zuòfǎ; Yuènán tóngxué xiǎng zuò yǐngpiàn lái jièshào tāmen de wénhuà. Yìkāishǐ, Liángjiè hěn dānxīn tiào bùhǎo, chángcháng liú zài xuéxiào liànxí, hòulái jiù yuè tiào yuè hǎo le.
text.english: Ryosuke was planning to perform traditional songs from northeastern Japan by dancing. Classmates from the Netherlands would introduce how to make Dutch baby pancake and beer. The Vietnamese classmates wanted to produce a video introducing their culture. In the beginning, Ryosuke worried that he could not dance well, so he often stayed in school to practice. Afterwards, he danced better and better.

text.traditional: 文化日當天，華語文中心熱鬧極了，許多人都來看表演，連校長也親自來參加，他站在學生當中，跟大家開心地照相。良介跳舞跳得好極了，大家都拍手叫好呢！表演結束後，良介去參觀各國的攤子，不但喝了葡萄酒、吃了披薩，還穿上韓國的傳統服裝照相。良介也趁這個機會認識了五大洲的朋友，他覺得中美洲人活潑大方、歐洲人很有禮貌、美國人愛說笑話、亞洲人常常微笑；非洲人最會跳舞，誰都比不上他們！
text.simplified: 文化日当天，华语文中心热闹极了，许多人都来看表演，连校长也亲自来参加，他站在学生当中，跟大家开心地照相。良介跳舞跳得好极了，大家都拍手叫好呢！表演结束后，良介去参观各国的摊子，不但喝了葡萄酒、吃了披萨，还穿上韩国的传统服装照相。良介也趁这个机会认识了五大洲的朋友，他觉得中美洲人活泼大方、欧洲人很有礼貌、美国人爱说笑话、亚洲人常常微笑；非洲人最会跳舞，谁都比不上他们！
text.pinyin: Wénhuà rì dāngtiān, Huáyǔwén Zhōngxīn rènao jíle, xǔduō rén dōu lái kàn biǎoyǎn, lián xiàozhǎng yě qīnzì lái cānjiā, tā zhàn zài xuéshēng dāngzhōng, gēn dàjiā kāixīn de zhàoxiàng. Liángjiè tiàowǔ tiào de hǎo jíle, dàjiā dōu pāishǒujiàohǎo ne! Biǎoyǎn jiéshù hòu, Liángjiè qù cānguān gè guó de tānzi, búdàn hē le pútáojiǔ, chī le pīsà, hái chuān shàng Hánguó de chuántǒng fúzhuāng zhàoxiàng. Liángjiè yě chèn zhège jīhuì rènshì le Wǔdàzhōu de péngyǒu, tā juéde Zhōngměizhōu rén huópō dàfāng, Ōuzhōu rén hěn yǒu lǐmào, Měiguó rén ài shuō xiàohuà, Yàzhōu rén chángcháng wéixiào; Fēizhōu rén zuì huì tiàowǔ, shéi dōu bǐ bú shàng tāmen!
text.english: On the World Culture Appreciation Day, the Center of Chinese Language and Culture was bustling with activities. Many people came to watch the performances, and even the President of the university came in person. He stood among students and happily took photos with everybody. Ryosuke danced very well. Everyone applauded and hoorayed. After the performance was finished, Ryosuke visited the stall of each country. He not only drank some grape wine and ate pizza, but also posed for photos in traditional Korean clothes. Ryosuke also took advantage of the opportunity to meet many friends from the five continents. He thought Central Americans are vigorous and generous, Europeans are very polite, Americans love joking, Asians smile very often, and Africans dance the best – nobody can compare with them!

text.traditional: 良介在日本不曾參加過這類的活動，對他來說，這個世界文化日極有意義。除了讓他有機會表現自己，也讓他明白，來台灣不只是學習中文，每個國家、地區的民族都有自己的特色，都有值得學習的地方。只有多看、多聽、多學習，才會發現自己的問題，才有機會讓自己更進步。
text.simplified: 良介在日本不曾参加过这类的活动，对他来说，这个世界文化日极有意义。除了让他有机会表现自己，也让他明白，来台湾不只是学习中文，每个国家、地区的民族都有自己的特色，都有值得学习的地方。只有多看、多听、多学习，才会发现自己的问题，才有机会让自己更进步。
text.pinyin: Liángjiè zài Rìběn bùcéng cānjiā guo zhè lèi de huódòng, duì tā lái shuō, zhège Shìjiè Wénhuàrì jí yǒu yìyì. Chúle ràng tā yǒu jīhuì biǎoxiàn zìjǐ, yě ràng tā míngbái, lái Táiwān bù zhǐ shì xuéxí Zhōngwén, měi ge guójiā, dìqū de mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ de tèsè, dōu yǒu zhídé xuéxí de dìfāng. Zhǐyǒu duō kàn, duō tīng, duō xuéxí, cái huì fāxiàn zìjǐ de wèntí, cái yǒu jīhuì ràng zìjǐ gèng jìnbù.
text.english: Ryosuke never participated in such event in Japan. To him, this World Culture Appreciation Day was extremely meaningful. It gave him a chance to show himself and made him understand that coming to Taiwan is more than just learning Chinese. The ethnic groups from every country and region have their own characteristics and all are worth learning. The most important thing is that only by watching more, listening more and learning more can we find out our own problems and have the opportunity to make more progress.
